title: ABot-PhysWorld: Interactive World Foundation Model for Robotic Manipulation with Physics Alignment
summary: Video-based world models offer a powerful paradigm for embodied simulation and planning, yet state-of-the-art models often generate physically implausible manipulations - such as object penetration and anti-gravity motion - due to training on generic visual data and likelihood-based objectives that ignore physical laws. We present ABot-PhysWorld, a 14B Diffusion Transformer model that generates visually realistic, physically plausible, and action-controllable videos. Built on a curated dataset of three million manipulation clips with physics-aware annotation, it uses a novel DPO-based post-training framework with decoupled discriminators to suppress unphysical behaviors while preserving visual quality. A parallel context block enables precise spatial action injection for cross-embodiment control. To better evaluate generalization, we introduce EZSbench, the first training-independent embodied zero-shot benchmark combining real and synthetic unseen robot-task-scene combinations. It employs a decoupled protocol to separately assess physical realism and action alignment. ABot-PhysWorld achieves new state-of-the-art performance on PBench and EZSbench, surpassing Veo 3.1 and Sora v2 Pro in physical plausibility and trajectory consistency. We will release EZSbench to promote standardized evaluation in embodied video generation.
tldr: ABot-PhysWorld is a physics-aware world model for robotic manipulation that uses a diffusion transformer and DPO training to generate physically plausible videos, achieving state-of-the-art results on new zero-shot benchmarks.
tldr_zh: ABot-PhysWorld是一个基于物理规律的机器人操作世界模型，它使用扩散Transformer和DPO训练来生成符合物理规则的视频，并在新的零样本基准测试中取得了最先进的结果。
summary_zh: 基于视频的世界模型为具身模拟和规划提供了一种强大的范式，然而，由于在通用视觉数据上进行训练以及使用忽略物理定律的基于似然性的目标函数，当前最先进的模型通常会生成物理上不合理的操控——例如物体穿透和反重力运动。我们提出了ABot-PhysWorld，一个140亿参数的扩散Transformer模型，能够生成视觉上逼真、物理上合理且可操作控制的视频。它建立在一个包含三百万带物理感知标注的操控片段的精选数据集之上，并使用一种新颖的基于DPO的后训练框架，该框架采用解耦判别器，以抑制不符合物理规律的行为，同时保持视觉质量。一个并行的上下文块实现了精确的空间动作注入，从而实现跨具身控制。为了更好地评估泛化能力，我们引入了EZSbench，这是第一个训练独立的具身零样本基准，结合了真实和合成的未见机器人-任务-场景组合。它采用解耦协议来分别评估物理真实性和动作对齐。ABot-PhysWorld在PBench和EZSbench上实现了新的最先进性能，在物理合理性和轨迹一致性方面超越了Veo 3.1和Sora v2 Pro。我们将发布EZSbench，以促进具身视频生成中的标准化评估。

title: CATNAV: Cached Vision-Language Traversability for Efficient Zero-Shot Robot Navigation
summary: Navigating unstructured environments requires assessing traversal risk relative to a robot's physical capabilities, a challenge that varies across embodiments. We present CATNAV, a cost-aware traversability navigation framework that leverages multimodal LLMs for zero-shot, embodiment-aware costmap generation without task-specific training. We introduce a visuosemantic caching mechanism that detects scene novelty and reuses prior risk assessments for semantically similar frames, reducing online VLM queries by 85.7%. Furthermore, we introduce a VLM-based trajectory selection module that evaluates proposals through visual reasoning to choose the safest path given behavioral constraints. We evaluate CATNAV on a quadruped robot across indoor and outdoor unstructured environments, comparing against state-of-the-art vision-language-action baselines. Across five navigation tasks, CATNAV achieves 10 percentage point higher average goal-reaching rate and 33% fewer behavioral constraint violations.
tldr: CATNAV uses a cached vision-language traversability framework to improve zero-shot robot navigation by efficiently generating costmaps and selecting safe paths, resulting in higher goal-reaching rates and fewer constraint violations on a quadruped robot.
tldr_zh: CATNAV采用了一种缓存的视觉-语言可穿越性框架，通过有效生成成本图和选择安全路径，来改进零样本机器人导航。在四足机器人上的实验表明，该方法提高了目标到达率并减少了约束违反。
summary_zh: 在非结构化环境中导航需要评估相对于机器人物理能力的穿越风险，这是一个因载体不同而异的挑战。我们提出了CATNAV，一个成本感知的可穿越性导航框架，它利用多模态LLM进行零样本、载体感知的成本图生成，而无需特定任务的训练。我们引入了一种视觉语义缓存机制，用于检测场景的新颖性，并重用先前对语义相似帧的风险评估，从而将在线VLM查询减少了85.7%。此外，我们还引入了一个基于VLM的轨迹选择模块，该模块通过视觉推理评估提案，以在给定行为约束的情况下选择最安全的路径。我们在四足机器人上，于室内和室外非结构化环境中评估了CATNAV，并与最先进的视觉-语言-动作基线进行了比较。在五个导航任务中，CATNAV实现了平均目标到达率提高10个百分点，行为约束违规减少33%。

title: SG-VLA: Learning Spatially-Grounded Vision-Language-Action Models for Mobile Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models show promise for robotic control, yet performance in complex household environments remains sub-optimal. Mobile manipulation requires reasoning about global scene layout, fine-grained geometry, and high-dimensional continuous actions, making standard imitation learning insufficient. We introduce a framework for learning spatially-grounded VLA models that strengthens perception and representation through auxiliary task co-training and multi-modal input enhancement. Our method addresses the challenge of controlling a 13-dimensional action space involving coordinated base motion, arm articulation, and gripper actuation. To enrich spatial understanding, the model incorporates multi-view RGB observations, depth cues, and short temporal history, providing perspectives of both global scene structure and local manipulation context. To improve representation quality, we co-train auxiliary decoders that reconstruct interpretable intermediate signals - including global robot position, joint configurations, grasp affordances, target-object relative pose, and segmentation masks - from shared visual-language features. These objectives provide dense supervision that encourages the backbone to develop spatially grounded, manipulation-aware latent representations. Through extensive evaluation on home rearrangement tasks, our approach achieves consistent improvements across picking, placing, opening, and closing operations, substantially outperforming direct imitation learning. Our findings suggest that spatial grounding through auxiliary and multi-modal learning provides a strong direction for scaling VLA models toward general-purpose domestic robots.
tldr: The paper introduces SG-VLA, a framework for learning spatially-grounded vision-language-action models using multi-modal input enhancement and auxiliary task co-training. It demonstrates improved performance in home rearrangement tasks compared to direct imitation learning.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SG-VLA，一个用于学习空间接地的视觉-语言-动作模型框架，它使用了多模态输入增强和辅助任务的联合训练。 结果表明，与直接模仿学习相比，在家庭物品重排任务中性能得到了提升。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型在机器人控制方面展现出潜力，但在复杂的家庭环境中，其性能仍有不足。移动操作需要推理全局场景布局、细粒度几何信息和高维连续动作，这使得标准模仿学习显得不够。我们介绍一种学习空间定位的VLA模型的框架，该框架通过辅助任务协同训练和多模态输入增强来加强感知和表征能力。我们的方法解决了控制13维动作空间的难题，该动作空间涉及协调的底盘运动、手臂关节运动和夹爪驱动。为了丰富空间理解，该模型整合了多视角RGB观测、深度线索和短期时序历史，提供了全局场景结构和局部操作环境的视角。为了提高表征质量，我们协同训练辅助解码器，这些解码器从共享的视觉-语言特征中重建可解释的中间信号，包括机器人全局位置、关节配置、抓取可供性、目标物体相对姿态和分割掩码。这些目标提供了密集监督，鼓励骨干网络发展空间定位的、操作感知的潜在表征。通过对家庭物品重排任务进行广泛评估，我们的方法在抓取、放置、打开和关闭操作方面都取得了持续的改进，大大优于直接模仿学习。我们的研究结果表明，通过辅助和多模态学习进行空间定位是扩展VLA模型以适应通用家庭机器人的一个强有力的方向。

title: A vision-language model and platform for temporally mapping surgery from video
summary: Mapping surgery is fundamental to developing operative guidelines and enabling autonomous robotic surgery. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) have shown promise in mapping the behaviour of surgeons from videos, yet current models remain narrow in scope, capturing limited behavioural components within single procedures, and offer limited translational value, as they remain inaccessible to practising surgeons. Here we introduce Halsted, a vision-language model trained on the Halsted Surgical Atlas (HSA), one of the most comprehensive annotated video libraries grown through an iterative self-labelling framework and encompassing over 650,000 videos across eight surgical specialties. To facilitate benchmarking, we publicly release HSA-27k, a subset of the Halsted Surgical Atlas. Halsted surpasses previous state-of-the-art models in mapping surgical activity while offering greater comprehensiveness and computational efficiency. To bridge the longstanding translational gap of surgical AI, we develop the Halsted web platform (https://halstedhealth.ai/) to provide surgeons anywhere in the world with the previously-unavailable capability of automatically mapping their own procedures within minutes. By standardizing unstructured surgical video data and making these capabilities directly accessible to surgeons, our work brings surgical AI closer to clinical deployment and helps pave the way toward autonomous robotic surgery.
tldr: This paper introduces Halsted, a vision-language model and platform for mapping surgical procedures from video, trained on a large dataset and offering improved performance and accessibility for surgeons.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了Halsted，一种用于从视频中映射外科手术程序的视觉语言模型和平台，该模型在大型数据集上进行训练，并为外科医生提供改进的性能和可访问性。
summary_zh: 外科手术行为映射对于开发手术指南和实现自主机器人手术至关重要。人工智能（AI）的最新进展已显示出从视频中映射外科医生行为的前景，但目前的模型范围仍然狭窄，仅捕获单一手术中有限的行为组成部分，并且由于外科医生无法访问这些模型，因此转化价值有限。在此，我们介绍 Halsted，这是一个在 Halsted 外科图谱（HSA）上训练的视觉-语言模型，HSA 是通过迭代自标注框架构建的最全面的注释视频库之一，涵盖八个外科专业的超过 65 万个视频。为了方便基准测试，我们公开发布 HSA-27k，它是 Halsted 外科图谱的一个子集。Halsted 在映射外科手术活动方面超越了以往最先进的模型，同时提供了更高的全面性和计算效率。为了弥合外科AI长期存在的转化差距，我们开发了 Halsted 网络平台（https://halstedhealth.ai/），旨在使世界各地的外科医生都能访问之前无法实现的自动映射自身手术流程的能力，只需几分钟即可完成。通过标准化非结构化的手术视频数据并将这些能力直接提供给外科医生，我们的工作使外科 AI 更接近临床部署，并有助于为自主机器人手术铺平道路。

title: CaP-X: A Framework for Benchmarking and Improving Coding Agents for Robot Manipulation
summary: "Code-as-Policy" considers how executable code can complement data-intensive Vision-Language-Action (VLA) methods, yet their effectiveness as autonomous controllers for embodied manipulation remains underexplored. We present CaP-X, an open-access framework for systematically studying Code-as-Policy agents in robot manipulation. At its core is CaP-Gym, an interactive environment in which agents control robots by synthesizing and executing programs that compose perception and control primitives. Building on this foundation, CaP-Bench evaluates frontier language and vision-language models across varying levels of abstraction, interaction, and perceptual grounding. Across 12 models, CaP-Bench reveals a consistent trend: performance improves with human-crafted abstractions but degrades as these priors are removed, exposing a dependence on designer scaffolding. At the same time, we observe that this gap can be mitigated through scaling agentic test-time computation--through multi-turn interaction, structured execution feedback, visual differencing, automatic skill synthesis, and ensembled reasoning--substantially improves robustness even when agents operate over low-level primitives. These findings allow us to derive CaP-Agent0, a training-free framework that recovers human-level reliability on several manipulation tasks in simulation and on real embodiments. We further introduce CaP-RL, showing reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards improves success rates and transfers from sim2real with minimal gap. Together, CaP-X provides a principled, open-access platform for advancing embodied coding agents.
tldr: This paper introduces CaP-X, a framework for benchmarking and improving "Code-as-Policy" agents in robot manipulation, demonstrating the effectiveness of human-crafted abstractions and test-time computation for robust control, and releases CaP-Agent0 and CaP-RL.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了CaP-X，一个用于评估和改进机器人操作中“代码即策略”智能体的框架，展示了人工设计的抽象和测试时计算对鲁棒控制的有效性，并发布了CaP-Agent0和CaP-RL。
summary_zh: “代码即策略”探讨了可执行代码如何补充数据密集的视觉-语言-行动（VLA）方法，但其作为具身操作自主控制器的有效性仍未得到充分探索。我们提出了CaP-X，一个开放访问框架，用于系统地研究机器人操作中的“代码即策略”智能体。其核心是CaP-Gym，一个交互式环境，智能体通过合成和执行包含感知和控制原语的程序来控制机器人。基于此基础，CaP-Bench评估了前沿语言和视觉-语言模型在不同抽象级别、交互和感知基础上的表现。在12个模型中，CaP-Bench揭示了一个一致的趋势：性能随人工设计的抽象而提高，但随着这些先验的移除而降低，暴露出对设计者支架的依赖。与此同时，我们观察到，可以通过扩展智能体运行时的计算——通过多轮交互、结构化执行反馈、视觉差分、自动技能合成和集成推理——来缓解这种差距，即使智能体在低级原语上操作，也能大幅提高鲁棒性。这些发现使我们能够推导出CaP-Agent0，一个无需训练的框架，可以在模拟和真实具身环境中，在多个操作任务上恢复到人类水平的可靠性。我们进一步介绍了CaP-RL，表明通过可验证奖励进行的强化学习可以提高成功率，并以最小的差距从仿真转移到真实环境（sim2real）。总之，CaP-X提供了一个原则性的、开放访问的平台，用于推进具身编码智能体的发展。

title: CoMaTrack: Competitive Multi-Agent Game-Theoretic Tracking with Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Embodied Visual Tracking (EVT), a core dynamic task in embodied intelligence, requires an agent to precisely follow a language-specified target. Yet most existing methods rely on single-agent imitation learning, suffering from costly expert data and limited generalization due to static training environments. Inspired by competition-driven capability evolution, we propose CoMaTrack, a competitive game-theoretic multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that trains agents in a dynamic adversarial setting with competitive subtasks, yielding stronger adaptive planning and interference-resilient strategies. We further introduce CoMaTrack-Bench, the first benchmark for competitive EVT, featuring game scenarios between a tracker and adaptive opponents across diverse environments and instructions, enabling standardized robustness evaluation under active adversarial interactions. Experiments show that CoMaTrack achieves state-of-the-art results on both standard benchmarks and CoMaTrack-Bench. Notably, a 3B VLM trained with our framework surpasses previous single-agent imitation learning methods based on 7B models on the challenging EVT-Bench, achieving 92.1% in STT, 74.2% in DT, and 57.5% in AT. The benchmark code will be available at https://github.com/wlqcode/CoMaTrack-Bench
tldr: The paper introduces CoMaTrack, a competitive multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for Embodied Visual Tracking (EVT) using Vision-Language-Action models, along with a new benchmark (CoMaTrack-Bench) showcasing state-of-the-art results.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文介绍了CoMaTrack，一个用于具身视觉跟踪（EVT）的竞争性多智能体强化学习框架，使用视觉-语言-动作模型，并提出了一个新的基准（CoMaTrack-Bench），展示了最先进的结果。
summary_zh: 具身视觉跟踪(EVT)是具身智能中的一项核心动态任务，需要智能体精确地跟随语言指定的追踪目标。然而，大多数现有方法依赖于单智能体模仿学习，受限于昂贵的专家数据和静态训练环境导致的泛化能力不足。受竞争驱动的能力进化启发，我们提出了CoMaTrack，一种竞争性博弈论多智能体强化学习框架，该框架在具有竞争性子任务的动态对抗环境中训练智能体，从而产生更强的自适应规划能力和抗干扰策略。我们进一步推出了CoMaTrack-Bench，这是首个竞争性 EVT 基准，以追踪器和自适应对手之间在多样化环境和指令下的博弈场景为特色，从而实现了在主动对抗交互下进行标准化鲁棒性评估。实验表明，CoMaTrack 在标准基准和 CoMaTrack-Bench 上均取得了最先进的结果。值得注意的是，使用我们的框架训练的3B VLM 在具有挑战性的EVT-Bench 上超越了先前基于7B模型的单智能体模仿学习方法，在 STT 中达到 92.1%、 DT 中达到74.2%、AT 中达到 57.5%。该基准测试代码将在 https://github.com/wlqcode/CoMaTrack-Bench 上提供。

title: Ego2Web: A Web Agent Benchmark Grounded in Egocentric Videos
summary: Multimodal AI agents are increasingly automating complex real-world workflows that involve online web execution. However, current web-agent benchmarks suffer from a critical limitation: they focus entirely on web-based interaction and perception, lacking grounding in the user's real-world physical surroundings. This limitation prevents evaluation in crucial scenarios, such as when an agent must use egocentric visual perception (e.g., via AR glasses) to recognize an object in the user's surroundings and then complete a related task online. To address this gap, we introduce Ego2Web, the first benchmark designed to bridge egocentric video perception and web agent execution. Ego2Web pairs real-world first-person video recordings with web tasks that require visual understanding, web task planning, and interaction in an online environment for successful completion. We utilize an automatic data-generation pipeline combined with human verification and refinement to curate well-constructed, high-quality video-task pairs across diverse web task types, including e-commerce, media retrieval, knowledge lookup, etc. To facilitate accurate and scalable evaluation for our benchmark, we also develop a novel LLM-as-a-Judge automatic evaluation method, Ego2WebJudge, which achieves approximately 84% agreement with human judgment, substantially higher than existing evaluation methods. Experiments with diverse SoTA agents on our Ego2Web show that their performance is weak, with substantial headroom across all task categories. We also conduct a comprehensive ablation study on task design, highlighting the necessity of accurate video understanding in the proposed task and the limitations of current agents. We hope Ego2Web can be a critical new resource for developing truly capable AI assistants that can seamlessly see, understand, and act across the physical and digital worlds.
tldr: Ego2Web introduces a new benchmark for web agents that incorporates egocentric video perception, addressing the gap between real-world understanding and online task execution, and reveals limitations in current agents.
tldr_zh: Ego2Web 引入了一个新的 Web Agent 基准，它结合了以自我为中心的视频感知，解决了现实世界理解和在线任务执行之间的差距，并揭示了当前 Agent 的局限性。
summary_zh: 多模态人工智能代理正日益自动化涉及在线网络执行的复杂现实世界工作流程。然而，当前的网页代理基准测试存在一个关键缺陷：它们完全侧重于基于网页的交互和感知，缺乏与用户现实物理环境的关联。这一局限性阻碍了在关键场景下的评估，例如当代理必须使用以自我为中心的视觉感知（例如，通过增强现实眼镜）来识别用户周围环境中的物体，然后在线完成相关任务时。为了弥补这一差距，我们推出了 Ego2Web，这是首个旨在桥接以自我为中心的视频感知和网页代理执行的基准测试。Ego2Web 将现实世界的第一人称视频记录与需要视觉理解、网页任务规划以及在线环境中交互的网页任务配对，以成功完成任务。我们利用自动数据生成管道，结合人工验证和改进，来策划跨越各种网页任务类型（包括电子商务、媒体检索、知识查找等）构建良好、高质量的视频-任务对。为了促进我们基准测试的准确和可扩展评估，我们还开发了一种新型的基于大型语言模型的自动评估方法 Ego2WebJudge，该方法与人工判断的吻合度约为 84%，大大高于现有的评估方法。对 Ego2Web 上各种最先进代理的实验表明，它们的性能较弱，在所有任务类别中都有很大的提升空间。我们还对任务设计进行了全面消融研究，突出了所提出的任务中准确视频理解的必要性以及当前代理的局限性。我们希望 Ego2Web 能够成为开发真正有能力的人工智能助手的关键新资源，这些助手可以无缝地跨越物理和数字世界进行观察、理解和行动。

title: VLA-IAP: Training-Free Visual Token Pruning via Interaction Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have rapidly advanced embodied intelligence, enabling robots to execute complex, instruction-driven tasks. However, as model capacity and visual context length grow, the inference cost of VLA systems becomes a major bottleneck for real-world deployment on resource-constrained platforms. Existing visual token pruning methods mainly rely on semantic saliency or simple temporal cues, overlooking the continuous physical interaction, a fundamental property of VLA tasks. Consequently, current approaches often prune visually sparse yet structurally critical regions that support manipulation, leading to unstable behavior during early task phases. To overcome this, we propose a shift toward an explicit Interaction-First paradigm. Our proposed \textbf{training-free} method, VLA-IAP (Interaction-Aligned Pruning), introduces a geometric prior mechanism to preserve structural anchors and a dynamic scheduling strategy that adapts pruning intensity based on semantic-motion alignment. This enables a conservative-to-aggressive transition, ensuring robustness during early uncertainty and efficiency once interaction is locked. Extensive experiments show that VLA-IAP achieves a \textbf{97.8\% success rate} with a \textbf{$1.25\times$ speedup} on the LIBERO benchmark, and up to \textbf{$1.54\times$ speedup} while maintaining performance \textbf{comparable to the unpruned backbone}. Moreover, the method demonstrates superior and consistent performance across multiple model architectures and three different simulation environments, as well as a real robot platform, validating its strong generalization capability and practical applicability. Our project website is: \href{https://chengjt1999.github.io/VLA-IAP.github.io/}{VLA-IAP.com}.
tldr: The paper introduces VLA-IAP, a training-free visual token pruning method for VLA models that leverages interaction alignment to improve inference speed and robustness, showing significant speedups and maintained performance on robotic tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为VLA-IAP的免训练视觉token剪枝方法，用于视觉-语言-动作模型，该方法利用交互对齐来提高推理速度和鲁棒性，在机器人任务上显示出显著的加速和性能保持。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-行为(VLA)模型极大地推动了具身智能的发展，使机器人能够执行复杂的、指令驱动的任务。然而，随着模型容量和视觉上下文长度的增长，VLA系统的推理成本成为在资源受限平台上进行实际部署的主要瓶颈。现有的视觉令牌剪枝方法主要依赖于语义显著性或简单的时序线索，忽略了VLA任务的一个基本属性：连续的物理交互。因此，当前的方法经常剪除视觉上稀疏但结构上至关重要的、支持操作的区域，导致在任务早期阶段出现不稳定的行为。为了克服这一点，我们提出转向一种显式的交互优先范式。我们提出的\textbf{免训练}方法VLA-IAP (交互对齐剪枝)引入了一种几何先验机制来保留结构锚点，以及一种动态调度策略，该策略基于语义-运动对齐来调整剪枝强度。这实现了一种从保守到激进的转变，确保了在早期不确定性期间的鲁棒性，以及在交互锁定后的效率。大量实验表明，VLA-IAP在LIBERO基准测试中实现了\textbf{97.8\%的成功率}和\textbf{1.25倍的加速}，并且在保持与\textbf{未剪枝骨干网络相当}的性能的情况下，最高可达\textbf{1.54倍的加速}。此外，该方法在多种模型架构和三种不同的仿真环境以及一个真实机器人平台上都表现出卓越且一致的性能，验证了其强大的泛化能力和实际适用性。我们的项目网站是：\href{https://chengjt1999.github.io/VLA-IAP.github.io/}{VLA-IAP.com}。

title: Rethinking Token-Level Policy Optimization for Multimodal Chain-of-Thought
summary: Multimodal Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning requires large vision-language models to construct reasoning trajectories that interleave perceptual grounding with multi-step inference. However, existing Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) methods typically optimize reasoning at a coarse granularity, treating CoT uniformly without distinguishing their varying degrees of visual grounding. In this work, we conduct a token-level analysis of multimodal reasoning trajectories and show that successful reasoning is characterized by structured token dynamics reflecting both perceptual grounding and exploratory inference. Building upon this analysis, we propose Perception-Exploration Policy Optimization (PEPO), which derives a perception prior from hidden state similarity and integrates it with token entropy through a smooth gating mechanism to produce token-level advantages. PEPO integrates seamlessly with existing RLVR frameworks such as GRPO and DAPO, requiring neither additional supervision nor auxiliary branches. Extensive experiments across diverse multimodal benchmarks demonstrate consistent and robust improvements over strong RL baselines, spanning geometry reasoning, visual grounding, visual puzzle solving, and few-shot classification, while maintaining stable training dynamics. Code: https://github.com/xzxxntxdy/PEPO
tldr: The paper introduces Perception-Exploration Policy Optimization (PEPO), a token-level policy optimization method for multimodal chain-of-thought reasoning that leverages a perception prior and token entropy to improve performance across various multimodal tasks. It improves on RLVR methods without requiring extra supervision.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了感知-探索策略优化（PEPO），这是一种用于多模态链式思考推理的令牌级策略优化方法，它利用感知先验和令牌熵来提高各种多模态任务的性能。它改进了RLVR方法，而无需额外的监督。
summary_zh: 多模态思维链 (CoT) 推理需要大型视觉语言模型构建推理轨迹，该轨迹将感知基础与多步推理交织在一起。然而，现有的基于可验证奖励的强化学习 (RLVR) 方法通常以粗粒度优化推理，统一对待 CoT，而没有区分它们不同程度的视觉基础。在这项工作中，我们对多模态推理轨迹进行了令牌级分析，表明成功的推理具有结构化的令牌动态特征，反映了感知基础和探索性推理。在此分析的基础上，我们提出了感知-探索策略优化 (PEPO)，它从隐藏状态相似性中推导出感知先验，并通过平滑门控机制将其与令牌熵集成，从而产生令牌级的优势。PEPO 与现有的 RLVR 框架（如 GRPO 和 DAPO）无缝集成，无需额外的监督或辅助分支。在各种多模态基准测试中进行的大量实验表明，相对于强大的 RL 基线，PEPO 实现了持续且稳健的改进，涵盖了几何推理、视觉基础、视觉谜题求解和少样本分类，同时保持了稳定的训练动态。代码：https://github.com/xzxxntxdy/PEPO

title: Off-Policy Value-Based Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Models
summary: Improving data utilization efficiency is critical for scaling reinforcement learning (RL) for long-horizon tasks where generating trajectories is expensive. However, the dominant RL methods for LLMs are largely on-policy: they update each batch of data only once, discard it, and then collect fresh samples, resulting in poor sample efficiency. In this work, we explore an alternative value-based RL framework for LLMs that naturally enables off-policy learning. We propose ReVal, a Bellman-update-based method that combines stepwise signals capturing internal consistency with trajectory-level signals derived from outcome verification. ReVal naturally supports replay-buffer-based training, allowing efficient reuse of past trajectories. Experiments on standard mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that ReVal not only converges faster but also outperforms GRPO in final performance. On DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B, ReVal improves training efficiency and achieves improvement of 2.7% in AIME24 and 4.5% in out-of-domain benchmark GPQA over GRPO. These results suggest that value-based RL is a practical alternative to policy-based methods for LLM training.
tldr: This paper introduces ReVal, a value-based off-policy RL method for training LLMs. It outperforms on-policy methods like GRPO in mathematical reasoning benchmarks with improved sample efficiency.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于价值的LLM离线强化学习方法ReVal。在数学推理基准测试中，它的性能优于GRPO等在线学习方法，并且具有更高的样本效率。
summary_zh: 提高数据利用效率对于扩展强化学习 (RL) 在生成轨迹代价高昂的长程任务中的应用至关重要。然而，目前用于大型语言模型 (LLM) 的主流 RL 方法在很大程度上是同策略的：它们只更新每批数据一次，就将其丢弃，然后收集新的样本，导致样本效率低下。在这项工作中，我们探索了一种用于 LLM 的替代性基于价值的 RL 框架，该框架自然地支持异策略学习。我们提出 ReVal，一种基于贝尔曼更新的方法，它结合了捕捉内部一致性的逐步信号和源自结果验证的轨迹级别信号。ReVal 天然支持基于回放缓冲区的训练，从而可以有效复用过去的轨迹。在标准数学推理基准测试中的实验表明，ReVal 不仅收敛速度更快，而且最终性能优于 GRPO。在 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B 上，ReVal 提高了训练效率，并在 AIME24 上实现了 2.7% 的提升，在领域外基准测试 GPQA 上实现了 4.5% 的提升，均优于 GRPO。这些结果表明，基于价值的 RL 是用于 LLM 训练的策略类方法的切实可行的替代方案。

title: VTAM: Video-Tactile-Action Models for Complex Physical Interaction Beyond VLAs
summary: Video-Action Models (VAMs) have emerged as a promising framework for embodied intelligence, learning implicit world dynamics from raw video streams to produce temporally consistent action predictions. Although such models demonstrate strong performance on long-horizon tasks through visual reasoning, they remain limited in contact-rich scenarios where critical interaction states are only partially observable from vision alone. In particular, fine-grained force modulation and contact transitions are not reliably encoded in visual tokens, leading to unstable or imprecise behaviors. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Video-Tactile Action Model (VTAM), a multimodal world modeling framework that incorporates tactile perception as a complementary grounding signal. VTAM augments a pretrained video transformer with tactile streams via a lightweight modality transfer finetuning, enabling efficient cross-modal representation learning without tactile-language paired data or independent tactile pretraining. To stabilize multimodal fusion, we introduce a tactile regularization loss that enforces balanced cross-modal attention, preventing visual latent dominance in the action model. VTAM demonstrates superior performance in contact-rich manipulation, maintaining a robust success rate of 90 percent on average. In challenging scenarios such as potato chip pick-and-place requiring high-fidelity force awareness, VTAM outperforms the pi 0.5 baseline by 80 percent. Our findings demonstrate that integrating tactile feedback is essential for correcting visual estimation errors in world action models, providing a scalable approach to physically grounded embodied foundation models.
tldr: The paper introduces VTAM, a Video-Tactile-Action Model that integrates tactile feedback into video-based action models for improved performance in contact-rich robotic manipulation tasks, demonstrating significant improvements over vision-only approaches.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了VTAM，一种视频-触觉-动作模型，将触觉反馈集成到基于视频的动作模型中，以提高在富接触机器人操纵任务中的性能，并展示了相对于仅视觉方法的显着改进。
summary_zh: 视频-动作模型 (VAMs) 已成为具身智能领域一个极具前景的框架，它们从原始视频流中学习隐式世界动态，从而产生时间上一致的动作预测。尽管此类模型通过视觉推理在长时程任务中表现出强大的性能，但它们在接触密集型场景中仍然受到限制，在这些场景中，关键的交互状态仅能部分地从视觉中观察到。特别地，精细的力调制和接触转换无法在视觉标记中被可靠地编码，从而导致不稳定或不精确的行为。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了视频-触觉动作模型 (VTAM)，这是一种多模态世界建模框架，它将触觉感知作为一种互补的接地信号纳入其中。VTAM 通过轻量级的模态转移微调来增强预训练的视频 Transformer 与触觉流的连接，从而无需触觉-语言配对数据或独立的触觉预训练即可实现高效的跨模态表征学习。为了稳定多模态融合，我们引入了一种触觉正则化损失，该损失强制执行平衡的跨模态注意力，从而防止视觉潜在特征在动作模型中占据主导地位。 VTAM 在接触密集型操作中表现出卓越的性能，平均保持 90% 的稳健成功率。在诸如需要高保真力感知的薯片拾取放置等具有挑战性的场景中，VTAM 的性能优于 pi 0.5 基线 80%。我们的研究结果表明，整合触觉反馈对于纠正世界动作模型中的视觉估计误差至关重要，为物理接地的具身基础模型提供了一种可扩展的方法。

title: Rectify, Don't Regret: Avoiding Pitfalls of Differentiable Simulation in Trajectory Prediction
summary: Current open-loop trajectory models struggle in real-world autonomous driving because minor initial deviations often cascade into compounding errors, pushing the agent into out-of-distribution states. While fully differentiable closed-loop simulators attempt to address this, they suffer from shortcut learning: the loss gradients flow backward through induced state inputs, inadvertently leaking future ground truth information directly into the model's own previous predictions. The model exploits these signals to artificially avoid drift, non-causally "regretting" past mistakes rather than learning genuinely reactive recovery. To address this, we introduce a detached receding horizon rollout. By explicitly severing the computation graph between simulation steps, the model learns genuine recovery behaviors from drifted states, forcing it to "rectify" mistakes rather than non-causally optimizing past predictions. Extensive evaluations on the nuScenes and DeepScenario datasets show our approach yields more robust recovery strategies, reducing target collisions by up to 33.24% compared to fully differentiable closed-loop training at high replanning frequencies. Furthermore, compared to standard open-loop baselines, our non-differentiable framework decreases collisions by up to 27.74% in dense environments while simultaneously improving multi-modal prediction diversity and lane alignment.
tldr: This paper introduces a non-differentiable receding horizon rollout method for trajectory prediction in autonomous driving to avoid shortcut learning (future information leakage) inherent in fully differentiable closed-loop simulators, leading to more robust recovery and reduced collisions.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文提出了一种用于自动驾驶轨迹预测的非微分递减水平滚动方法，旨在避免完全可微闭环模拟器中固有的“走捷径学习”（即未来信息泄露）问题，从而实现更稳健的恢复并减少碰撞。
summary_zh: 当前开环轨迹模型在真实世界的自动驾驶中表现不佳，因为微小的初始偏差常常会累积成复合误差，将智能体推入分布外状态。虽然全可微闭环模拟器试图解决这个问题，但它们会受到捷径学习的影响：损失梯度通过诱导状态输入反向传播，无意中将未来的真值信息直接泄露到模型先前的预测中。模型利用这些信号来人为地避免漂移，非因果地“后悔”过去的错误，而不是学习真正具有反应性的恢复策略。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了一种分离的滚动视界展开方法。通过显式地切断模拟步骤之间的计算图，模型可以学习从漂移状态中进行真实恢复的行为，迫使其“纠正”错误，而不是非因果地优化过去的预测。在nuScenes和DeepScenario数据集上的大量评估表明，我们的方法产生了更鲁棒的恢复策略，在高重规划频率下，与完全可微的闭环训练相比，目标碰撞减少了高达33.24%。此外，与标准开环基线相比，我们的不可微框架在密集环境中将碰撞减少了高达27.74%，同时提高了多模态预测的多样性和车道对齐。

title: SIMART: Decomposing Monolithic Meshes into Sim-ready Articulated Assets via MLLM
summary: High-quality articulated 3D assets are indispensable for embodied AI and physical simulation, yet 3D generation still focuses on static meshes, leaving a gap in "sim-ready" interactive objects. Most recent articulated object creation methods rely on multi-stage pipelines that accumulate errors across decoupled modules. Alternatively, unified MLLMs offer a single-stage path to joint static asset understanding and sim-ready asset generation. However dense voxel-based 3D tokenization yields long 3D token sequences and high memory overhead, limiting scalability to complex articulated objects. To address this, we propose SIMART, a unified MLLM framework that jointly performs part-level decomposition and kinematic prediction. By introducing a Sparse 3D VQ-VAE, SIMART reduces token counts by 70% vs. dense voxel tokens, enabling high-fidelity multi-part assemblies. SIMART achieves state-of-the-art performance on PartNet-Mobility and in-the-wild AIGC datasets, and enables physics-based robotic simulation.
tldr: SIMART is a unified MLLM framework that decomposes monolithic meshes into sim-ready articulated assets, leveraging a Sparse 3D VQ-VAE to reduce token counts and improve scalability for complex objects, achieving state-of-the-art results on relevant datasets.
tldr_zh: SIMART是一个统一的MLLM框架，可以将整体网格分解为可用于仿真的铰接资产。它利用稀疏3D VQ-VAE来减少token数量并提高复杂对象的可扩展性，并在相关数据集上实现了最先进的结果。
summary_zh: 高质量的可动3D资产对于具身人工智能和物理仿真至关重要，然而3D生成仍然侧重于静态网格，导致“可仿真”交互式对象的缺口。大多数最新的可动对象创建方法依赖于多阶段流水线，这些流水线会在解耦模块中累积误差。或者，统一的MLLM（多模态大型语言模型）提供了一条单阶段路径，可以联合进行静态资产理解和可仿真资产生成。然而，基于密集体素的3D令牌化会产生较长的3D令牌序列和较高的内存开销，从而限制了其向复杂可动对象的可扩展性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了SIMART，一个统一的MLLM框架，可以联合执行部件级分解和运动学预测。通过引入稀疏3D VQ-VAE（向量量化变分自编码器），SIMART相比于密集体素令牌减少了70%的令牌数量，从而能够实现高保真多部件组装。SIMART在PartNet-Mobility数据集和实际AIGC数据集上实现了最先进的性能，并支持基于物理的机器人仿真。

title: Learning Multi-Agent Local Collision-Avoidance for Collaborative Carrying tasks with Coupled Quadrupedal Robots
summary: Robotic collaborative carrying could greatly benefit human activities like warehouse and construction site management. However, coordinating the simultaneous motion of multiple robots represents a significant challenge. Existing works primarily focus on obstacle-free environments, making them unsuitable for most real-world applications. Works that account for obstacles, either overfit to a specific terrain configuration or rely on pre-recorded maps combined with path planners to compute collision-free trajectories. This work focuses on two quadrupedal robots mechanically connected to a carried object. We propose a Reinforcement Learning (RL)-based policy that enables tracking a commanded velocity direction while avoiding collisions with nearby obstacles using only onboard sensing, eliminating the need for precomputed trajectories and complete map knowledge. Our work presents a hierarchical architecture, where a perceptive high-level object-centric policy commands two pretrained locomotion policies. Additionally, we employ a game-inspired curriculum to increase the complexity of obstacles in the terrain progressively. We validate our approach on two quadrupedal robots connected to a bar via spherical joints, benchmarking it against optimization-based and decentralized RL baselines. Our hardware experiments demonstrate the ability of our system to locomote in unknown environments without the need for a map or a path planner. The video of our work is available in the multimedia material.
tldr: This paper presents a reinforcement learning-based approach for collaborative carrying tasks using coupled quadrupedal robots, enabling collision avoidance in unknown environments without precomputed trajectories or maps.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于强化学习的方法，用于使用耦合四足机器人进行协作搬运任务，无需预先计算的轨迹或地图即可在未知环境中避撞。
summary_zh: 机器人协同搬运可以极大地惠及诸如仓库和建筑工地管理之类的人类活动。然而，协调多个机器人的同步运动是一个重大的挑战。现有工作主要集中在无障碍环境中，使其不适用于大多数现实世界的应用。考虑到障碍物的工作要么过度拟合于特定的地形配置，要么依赖于预先记录的地图并结合路径规划器来计算无碰撞轨迹。这项工作专注于两个机械连接到搬运物体的四足机器人。我们提出了一种基于强化学习（RL）的策略，该策略仅使用板载传感即可实现对指令速度方向的跟踪，同时避免与附近障碍物发生碰撞，从而消除了对预先计算的轨迹和完整地图知识的需求。我们的工作提出了一种分层架构，其中一个具有高感知能力的高级对象中心策略指挥两个预训练的运动策略。此外，我们采用了一种受游戏启发的课程，以逐步增加地形中障碍物的复杂性。我们在两个通过球形关节连接到杆的四足机器人上验证了我们的方法，并将其与基于优化的基线和分散式RL基线进行了基准测试。我们的硬件实验证明了我们的系统在未知环境中运动的能力，而无需地图或路径规划器。我们工作的视频可在多媒体材料中找到。

title: A Multimodal Framework for Human-Multi-Agent Interaction
summary: Human-robot interaction is increasingly moving toward multi-robot, socially grounded environments. Existing systems struggle to integrate multimodal perception, embodied expression, and coordinated decision-making in a unified framework. This limits natural and scalable interaction in shared physical spaces. We address this gap by introducing a multimodal framework for human-multi-agent interaction in which each robot operates as an autonomous cognitive agent with integrated multimodal perception and Large Language Model (LLM)-driven planning grounded in embodiment. At the team level, a centralized coordination mechanism regulates turn-taking and agent participation to prevent overlapping speech and conflicting actions. Implemented on two humanoid robots, our framework enables coherent multi-agent interaction through interaction policies that combine speech, gesture, gaze, and locomotion. Representative interaction runs demonstrate coordinated multimodal reasoning across agents and grounded embodied responses. Future work will focus on larger-scale user studies and deeper exploration of socially grounded multi-agent interaction dynamics.
tldr: This paper presents a multimodal framework for human-multi-agent interaction using LLMs for planning and a centralized coordination mechanism for turn-taking, demonstrated with humanoid robots exhibiting coherent interaction via speech, gesture, gaze, and locomotion.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于人机多代理交互的多模态框架，该框架使用LLM进行规划，并使用集中式协调机制进行轮流，并通过人形机器人展示了通过语音、手势、目光和运动进行连贯的交互。
summary_zh: 人机交互正日益转向多机器人、社会嵌入式环境。现有系统难以在统一框架中集成多模态感知、具身表达和协调决策，这限制了共享物理空间中自然且可扩展的交互。我们通过引入一种用于人-多智能体交互的多模态框架来解决这一差距，在该框架中，每个机器人作为自主认知智能体运行，具有集成的多模态感知和基于具身的大语言模型（LLM）驱动的规划。在团队层面，一种中心化的协调机制 регулирует turn-taking и agent participation，以防止语音重叠和行为冲突。我们的框架在两个人形机器人上实现，通过结合语音、手势、目光和运动的交互策略，实现了连贯的多智能体交互。代表性的交互运行展示了跨智能体的协调多模态推理和基于具身的响应。未来的工作将侧重于更大规模的用户研究，以及对社会嵌入式多智能体交互动力学的更深入探索。

title: Efficient Hybrid SE(3)-Equivariant Visuomotor Flow Policy via Spherical Harmonics for Robot Manipulation
summary: While existing equivariant methods enhance data efficiency, they suffer from high computational intensity, reliance on single-modality inputs, and instability when combined with fast-sampling methods. In this work, we propose E3Flow, a novel framework that addresses the critical limitations of equivariant diffusion policies. E3Flow overcomes these challenges, successfully unifying efficient rectified flow with stable, multi-modal equivariant learning for the first time. Our framework is built upon spherical harmonic representations to ensure rigorous SO(3) equivariance. We introduce a novel invariant Feature Enhancement Module (FEM) that dynamically fuses hybrid visual modalities (point clouds and images), injecting rich visual cues into the spherical harmonic features. We evaluate E3Flow on 8 manipulation tasks from the MimicGen and further conduct 4 real-world experiments to validate its effectiveness in physical environments. Simulation results show that E3Flow achieves a 3.12% improvement in average success rate over the state-of-the-art Spherical Diffusion Policy (SDP) while simultaneously delivering a 7x inference speedup. E3Flow thus demonstrates a new and highly effective trade-off between performance, efficiency, and data efficiency for robotic policy learning. Code: https://github.com/zql-kk/E3Flow.
tldr: E3Flow, a novel SE(3)-equivariant visuomotor policy using spherical harmonics, achieves state-of-the-art performance and significant speedup in robot manipulation tasks by fusing multi-modal visual data efficiently.
tldr_zh: E3Flow是一种新的SE(3)-等变视觉运动策略，它使用球谐函数，通过高效融合多模态视觉数据，在机器人操作任务中实现了最先进的性能和显著的加速。
summary_zh: 虽然现有的等变方法提高了数据效率，但它们存在计算强度高、依赖于单模态输入，以及与快速采样方法结合时不稳定等问题。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种名为E3Flow的新型框架，该框架解决了等变扩散策略的关键局限性。E3Flow克服了这些挑战，首次成功地将高效校正流与稳定、多模态等变学习相结合。我们的框架建立在球谐表示之上，以确保严格的SO(3)等变性。我们引入了一种新颖的不变特征增强模块（FEM），该模块动态融合混合视觉模态（点云和图像），将丰富的视觉线索注入到球谐特征中。我们在MimicGen中的8个操作任务上评估了E3Flow，并进一步进行了4个真实世界实验，以验证其在物理环境中的有效性。仿真结果表明，E3Flow在平均成功率方面比最先进的球形扩散策略（SDP）提高了3.12%，同时提供了7倍的推理速度提升。因此，E3Flow展示了机器人策略学习在性能、效率和数据效率之间的一种新的且高效的权衡。代码：https://github.com/zql-kk/E3Flow。

title: AeroScene: Progressive Scene Synthesis for Aerial Robotics
summary: Generative models have shown substantial impact across multiple domains, their potential for scene synthesis remains underexplored in robotics. This gap is more evident in drone simulators, where simulation environments still rely heavily on manual efforts, which are time-consuming to create and difficult to scale. In this work, we introduce AeroScene, a hierarchical diffusion model for progressive 3D scene synthesis. Our approach leverages hierarchy-aware tokenization and multi-branch feature extraction to reason across both global layouts and local details, ensuring physical plausibility and semantic consistency. This makes AeroScene particularly suited for generating realistic scenes for aerial robotics tasks such as navigation, landing, and perching. We demonstrate its effectiveness through extensive experiments on our newly collected dataset and a public benchmark, showing that AeroScene significantly outperforms prior methods. Furthermore, we use AeroScene to generate a large-scale dataset of over 1,000 physics-ready, high fidelity 3D scenes that can be directly integrated into NVIDIA Isaac Sim. Finally, we illustrate the utility of these generated environments on downstream drone navigation tasks. Our code and dataset are publicly available at aioz-ai.github.io/AeroScene/
tldr: AeroScene is a hierarchical diffusion model for generating realistic 3D scenes for aerial robotics, addressing the limitations of manual environment creation in drone simulators and enabling downstream drone navigation tasks.
tldr_zh: AeroScene是一个分层扩散模型，用于生成逼真的三维场景，用于无人机机器人技术，解决了无人机模拟器中手动环境创建的局限性，并支持下游无人机导航任务。
summary_zh: 生成模型已在多个领域展现出显著影响力，但其在机器人场景合成方面的潜力仍未被充分挖掘。在无人机模拟器中，这一差距更为明显，模拟环境仍然严重依赖于手动工作，这导致创建耗时且难以扩展。在这项工作中，我们提出了AeroScene，一个用于渐进式3D场景合成的分层扩散模型。我们的方法利用层级感知标记化和多分支特征提取来推理全局布局和局部细节，从而确保物理合理性和语义一致性。这使得AeroScene特别适用于生成逼真的场景，用于航拍机器人任务，例如导航、着陆和栖息。我们通过在我们新收集的数据集和一个公开基准上的大量实验证明了其有效性，结果表明AeroScene显著优于现有方法。此外，我们使用AeroScene生成了一个超过1,000个物理就绪的高保真3D场景的大规模数据集，这些场景可以直接集成到NVIDIA Isaac Sim中。最后，我们展示了这些生成的环境在下游无人机导航任务中的效用。我们的代码和数据集可在 aioz-ai.github.io/AeroScene/ 公开获取。

title: Path Planning and Reinforcement Learning-Driven Control of On-Orbit Free-Flying Multi-Arm Robots
summary: This paper presents a hybrid approach that integrates trajectory optimization (TO) and reinforcement learning (RL) for motion planning and control of free-flying multi-arm robots in on-orbit servicing scenarios. The proposed system integrates TO for generating feasible, efficient paths while accounting for dynamic and kinematic constraints, and RL for adaptive trajectory tracking under uncertainties. The multi-arm robot design, equipped with thrusters for precise body control, enables redundancy and stability in complex space operations. TO optimizes arm motions and thruster forces, reducing reliance on the arms for stabilization and enhancing maneuverability. RL further refines this by leveraging model-free control to adapt to dynamic interactions and disturbances. The experimental results validated through comprehensive simulations demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed hybrid approach. Two case studies are explored: surface motion with initial contact and a free-floating scenario requiring surface approximation. In both cases, the hybrid method outperforms traditional strategies. In particular, the thrusters notably enhance motion smoothness, safety, and operational efficiency. The RL policy effectively tracks TO-generated trajectories, handling high-dimensional action spaces and dynamic mismatches. This integration of TO and RL combines the strengths of precise, task-specific planning with robust adaptability, ensuring high performance in the uncertain and dynamic conditions characteristic of space environments. By addressing challenges such as motion coupling, environmental disturbances, and dynamic control requirements, this framework establishes a strong foundation for advancing the autonomy and effectiveness of space robotic systems.
tldr: This paper introduces a hybrid trajectory optimization (TO) and reinforcement learning (RL) approach for controlling free-flying multi-arm robots in space, demonstrating improved performance over traditional methods in simulations with surface interaction and free-floating scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种混合轨迹优化（TO）和强化学习（RL）方法，用于控制空间自由飞行多臂机器人。仿真结果表明，在表面交互和自由漂浮场景中，该方法比传统方法表现更好。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种混合方法，该方法结合了轨迹优化（TO）和强化学习（RL），用于在轨服务场景中自由飞行多臂机器人的运动规划与控制。所提出的系统整合了轨迹优化，用于生成可行、高效的路径，同时考虑动力学和运动学约束；并整合了强化学习，用于在不确定性下进行自适应轨迹跟踪。多臂机器人设计配备了推进器，用于精确的本体控制，从而在复杂的空间操作中实现冗余和稳定性。轨迹优化对机械臂运动和推进器推力进行优化，减少了对机械臂稳定性的依赖，并提高了机动性。强化学习通过使用无模型控制来适应动态交互和扰动，进一步优化了这一点。通过全面仿真验证的实验结果表明了所提出的混合方法的有效性和鲁棒性。研究了两个案例：具有初始接触的表面运动，以及需要表面逼近的自由漂浮场景。在这两种情况下，混合方法都优于传统策略。特别是，推进器显著提高了运动的平稳性、安全性和运行效率。强化学习策略有效地跟踪了轨迹优化生成的轨迹，处理了高维动作空间和动态失配。这种轨迹优化与强化学习的集成结合了精确的、特定于任务的规划的优势与强大的适应性，确保了在空间环境特有的不确定和动态条件下实现高性能。通过解决运动耦合、环境干扰和动态控制要求等挑战，该框架为提升空间机器人系统的自主性和有效性奠定了坚实的基础。

title: YOLOv10 with Kolmogorov-Arnold networks and vision-language foundation models for interpretable object detection and trustworthy multimodal AI in computer vision perception
summary: The interpretable object detection capabilities of a novel Kolmogorov-Arnold network framework are examined here. The approach refers to a key limitation in computer vision for autonomous vehicles perception, and beyond. These systems offer limited transparency regarding the reliability of their confidence scores in visually degraded or ambiguous scenes. To address this limitation, a Kolmogorov-Arnold network is employed as an interpretable post-hoc surrogate to model the trustworthiness of the You Only Look Once (Yolov10) detections using seven geometric and semantic features. The additive spline-based structure of the Kolmogorov-Arnold network enables direct visualisation of each feature's influence. This produces smooth and transparent functional mappings that reveal when the model's confidence is well supported and when it is unreliable. Experiments on both Common Objects in Context (COCO), and images from the University of Bath campus demonstrate that the framework accurately identifies low-trust predictions under blur, occlusion, or low texture. This provides actionable insights for filtering, review, or downstream risk mitigation. Furthermore, a bootstrapped language-image (BLIP) foundation model generates descriptive captions of each scene. This tool enables a lightweight multimodal interface without affecting the interpretability layer. The resulting system delivers interpretable object detection with trustworthy confidence estimates. It offers a powerful tool for transparent and practical perception component for autonomous and multimodal artificial intelligence applications.
tldr: This paper introduces a method using Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks to improve the interpretability of YOLOv10 confidence scores by identifying unreliable predictions in degraded visual conditions, coupled with a vision-language model for scene description, enhancing trust in object detection for autonomous systems.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种使用 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络的方法，通过识别退化视觉条件下的不可靠预测来提高 YOLOv10 置信度的可解释性，并结合视觉-语言模型进行场景描述，从而增强自动驾驶系统中目标检测的可信度。
summary_zh: 本文研究了一种新型 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络框架的可解释目标检测能力。该方法针对自动驾驶车辆感知，以及更广泛的计算机视觉领域中的一个关键局限性：在视觉退化或模糊场景中，这些系统对其置信度评分的可靠性提供有限的透明度。为解决此局限性，采用 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络作为一种可解释的后验替代模型，利用七个几何和语义特征对 You Only Look Once (Yolov10) 检测的可靠性进行建模。Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络的加性样条结构可以直接可视化每个特征的影响。这产生了平滑且透明的功能映射，揭示了模型置信度的支撑良好时和不可靠时的情况。在 Common Objects in Context (COCO) 数据集和巴斯大学校园图像上的实验表明，该框架能够准确识别模糊、遮挡或低纹理情况下的低可信度预测。这为过滤、审查或下游风险缓解提供了可操作的见解。此外，一个自举语言-图像 (BLIP) 基础模型生成了每个场景的描述性文本。该工具实现了一种轻量级的多模态接口，且不影响可解释性层。最终系统提供了具有可信置信度估计的可解释目标检测，为自主和多模态人工智能应用提供了一个强大、透明和实用的感知组件。

title: Task-Aware Positioning for Improvisational Tasks in Mobile Construction Robots via an AI Agent with Multi-LMM Modules
summary: Due to the ever-changing nature of construction, many tasks on sites occur in an improvisational manner. Existing mobile construction robot studies remain limited in addressing improvisational tasks, where task-required locations, timing of task occurrence, and contextual information required for task execution are not known in advance. We propose an agent that understands improvisational tasks given in natural language, identifies the task-required location, and positions itself. The agent's functionality was decomposed into three Large Multimodal Model (LMM) modules operating in parallel, enabling the application of LMMs for task interpretation and breakdown, construction drawing-based navigation, and visual reasoning to identify non-predefined task-required locations. The agent was implemented with a quadruped robot and achieved a 92.2% success rate for identifying and positioning at task-required locations across three tests designed to assess improvisational task handling. This study enables mobile construction robots to perform non-predefined tasks autonomously.
tldr: This paper presents an AI agent with multi-LMM modules for a quadruped robot to autonomously perform improvisational tasks in construction sites by interpreting natural language commands, identifying task locations, and positioning itself. The agent achieves a 92.2% success rate in tests.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于多模态大模型(LMM)的人工智能代理，该代理用于四足机器人，通过解释自然语言指令、识别任务位置和自我定位，自主执行建筑工地的临时任务。 该代理在测试中实现了 92.2% 的成功率。
summary_zh: 由于建筑行业瞬息万变的特性，许多现场任务都是以即兴的方式进行的。 现有的移动建筑机器人研究在处理即兴任务方面仍然存在局限性，即任务所需的地点、任务发生的时间以及任务执行所需的上下文信息都是事先未知的。 我们提出了一种代理，该代理能够理解以自然语言给出的即兴任务，识别任务所需的地点，并进行自我定位。 该代理的功能被分解为三个并行运行的大型多模态模型（LMM）模块，从而能够应用LMM进行任务解释和分解、基于施工图的导航以及视觉推理，以识别非预定义的任务所需地点。 该代理在一个四足机器人上实现，并在旨在评估即兴任务处理的三个测试中，实现了 92.2% 的成功率，能够识别任务所需地点并准确定位。 这项研究使移动建筑机器人能够自主执行非预定义的任务。

title: Agile-VLA: Few-Shot Industrial Pose Rectification via Implicit Affordance Anchoring
summary: Deploying Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models on resource-constrained edge platforms encounters a fundamental conflict between high-latency semantic inference and the high-frequency control required for dynamic manipulation. To address the challenge, this paper presents Agile-VLA, a hierarchical framework designed for industrial pose reorientation tasks on edge devices such as the NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano. The core innovation is an Implicit Affordance Anchoring mechanism that directly maps geometric visual cues, specifically centroid and rim keypoint anchors, into structured parametric action primitives, thereby substantially reducing reliance on high-latency semantic inference during closed-loop control. By decoupling perception (10 Hz) from control (50 Hz) via an asynchronous dual-stream architecture, the system effectively mitigates the frequency mismatch inherent in edge-based robot learning. Experimental results on a standard 6-DoF manipulator demonstrate that Agile-VLA achieves robust rectification of complex, irregular workpieces using only 5-shot demonstrations through extrinsic dexterity.
tldr: The paper presents Agile-VLA, a hierarchical framework for industrial pose rectification on edge devices that uses implicit affordance anchoring to reduce reliance on high-latency semantic inference. It achieves robust rectification with few-shot demonstrations by decoupling perception from control.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Agile-VLA，一个用于边缘设备上工业姿态校正的分层框架，它使用隐式可供性锚定来减少对高延迟语义推理的依赖。通过将感知与控制分离，它仅用少量演示就实现了鲁棒的校正。
summary_zh: 在资源受限的边缘平台上部署视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型面临着高延迟语义推理和动态操作所需的高频控制之间的根本冲突。为了应对这一挑战，本文提出了一种名为Agile-VLA的分层框架，专为在NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano等边缘设备上执行工业姿态重定向任务而设计。其核心创新是一种隐式可供性锚定机制，该机制直接将几何视觉线索（特别是质心和轮廓关键点锚点）映射到结构化的参数化动作原语中，从而大幅降低了闭环控制期间对高延迟语义推理的依赖。通过异步双流架构将感知(10 Hz)与控制(50 Hz)解耦，该系统有效缓解了边缘机器人学习中固有的频率不匹配问题。在标准6自由度机械臂上的实验结果表明，Agile-VLA仅通过5次示范即可实现复杂、不规则工件的稳健校正，展现了其外在灵巧性。

title: Grounding Sim-to-Real Generalization in Dexterous Manipulation: An Empirical Study with Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Learning a generalist control policy for dexterous manipulation typically relies on large-scale datasets. Given the high cost of real-world data collection, a practical alternative is to generate synthetic data through simulation. However, the resulting synthetic data often exhibits a significant gap from real-world distributions. While many prior studies have proposed algorithms to bridge the Sim-to-Real discrepancy, there remains a lack of principled research that grounds these methods in real-world manipulation tasks, particularly their performance on generalist policies such as Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. In this study, we empirically examine the primary determinants of Sim-to-Real generalization across four dimensions: multi-level domain randomization, photorealistic rendering, physics-realistic modeling, and reinforcement learning updates. To support this study, we design a comprehensive evaluation protocol to quantify the real-world performance of manipulation tasks. The protocol accounts for key variations in background, lighting, distractors, object types, and spatial features. Through experiments involving over 10k real-world trials, we derive critical insights into Sim-to-Real transfer. To inform and advance future studies, we release both the robotic platforms and the evaluation protocol for public access to facilitate independent verification, thereby establishing a realistic and standardized benchmark for dexterous manipulation policies.
tldr: This paper presents an empirical study on Sim-to-Real transfer for Vision-Language-Action models in dexterous manipulation. It examines the impact of different simulation factors on real-world performance and introduces a comprehensive benchmark for evaluation.
tldr_zh: 本文针对灵巧操作中的视觉-语言-动作模型的 Sim-to-Real 迁移进行了实证研究。它考察了不同仿真因素对真实世界性能的影响，并引入了一个全面的评估基准。
summary_zh: 灵巧操作通用控制策略的学习通常依赖于大规模数据集。考虑到真实世界的数据采集成本高昂，一个可行的替代方案是通过仿真生成合成数据。然而，由此产生的合成数据常常与真实世界分布存在显著差距。虽然许多先前研究已提出算法来弥合Sim-to-Real差异，但仍然缺乏将这些方法扎根于真实世界操作任务中的原则性研究，尤其是它们在通用策略（例如视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型）上的表现。在本研究中，我们通过实证检验跨四个维度（多级域随机化、照片级渲染、物理真实建模和强化学习更新）的Sim-to-Real泛化的主要决定因素。为了支持这项研究，我们设计了一个全面的评估协议，以量化操作任务的真实世界性能。该协议考虑了背景、照明、干扰物、对象类型和空间特征的关键变化。通过涉及超过1万次真实世界试验的实验，我们获得了关于Sim-to-Real迁移的关键见解。为了为未来的研究提供信息并推动其发展，我们公开发布了机器人平台和评估协议，以促进独立验证，从而为灵巧操作策略建立一个现实而标准化的基准。

title: PhotoAgent: A Robotic Photographer with Spatial and Aesthetic Understanding
summary: Embodied agents for creative tasks like photography must bridge the semantic gap between high-level language commands and geometric control. We introduce PhotoAgent, an agent that achieves this by integrating Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) reasoning with a novel control paradigm. PhotoAgent first translates subjective aesthetic goals into solvable geometric constraints via LMM-driven, chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, allowing an analytical solver to compute a high-quality initial viewpoint. This initial pose is then iteratively refined through visual reflection within a photorealistic internal world model built with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). This ``mental simulation'' replaces costly and slow physical trial-and-error, enabling rapid convergence to aesthetically superior results. Evaluations confirm that PhotoAgent excels in spatial reasoning and achieves superior final image quality.
tldr: PhotoAgent uses LMM-driven reasoning and 3D Gaussian Splatting-based mental simulation to enable a robot to take aesthetically pleasing photos by translating high-level language commands into geometric actions. It outperforms trial-and-error methods by enabling rapid convergence to superior results.
tldr_zh: PhotoAgent利用大型多模态模型驱动的推理和基于3D高斯溅射的心理模拟，使机器人能够通过将高级语言命令转化为几何动作来拍摄美观的照片。它通过实现对更优结果的快速收敛而优于试错法。
summary_zh: 用于摄影等创意任务的具身智能体必须弥合高级语言指令与几何控制之间的语义鸿沟。我们介绍 PhotoAgent，该智能体通过将大型多模态模型 (LMM) 的推理与一种新颖的控制范式相结合来实现这一目标。 PhotoAgent 首先通过 LMM 驱动的链式思维 (CoT) 推理，将主观的美学目标转化为可解的几何约束，从而允许分析求解器计算出高质量的初始视点。然后，这个初始姿态通过在利用 3D 高斯溅射 (3DGS) 构建的逼真内部世界模型中进行视觉反射来迭代优化。这种“心理模拟”取代了昂贵且缓慢的物理试错，从而能够快速收敛到美学上更优越的结果。 评估结果证实PhotoAgent 擅长空间推理，并能实现卓越的最终图像质量。

title: DiSCo: Diffusion Sequence Copilots for Shared Autonomy
summary: Shared autonomy combines human user and AI copilot actions to control complex systems such as robotic arms. When a task is challenging, requires high dimensional control, or is subject to corruption, shared autonomy can significantly increase task performance by using a trained copilot to effectively correct user actions in a manner consistent with the user's goals. To significantly improve the performance of shared autonomy, we introduce Diffusion Sequence Copilots (DiSCo): a method of shared autonomy with diffusion policy that plans action sequences consistent with past user actions. DiSCo seeds and inpaints the diffusion process with user-provided actions with hyperparameters to balance conformity to expert actions, alignment with user intent, and perceived responsiveness. We demonstrate that DiSCo substantially improves task performance in simulated driving and robotic arm tasks. Project website: https://sites.google.com/view/disco-shared-autonomy/
tldr: The paper introduces Diffusion Sequence Copilots (DiSCo), a shared autonomy method using diffusion policies to plan action sequences based on user actions, improving performance in simulated driving and robotic arm tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了扩散序列副驾驶 (DiSCo)，一种共享自主方法，使用扩散策略来规划基于用户动作的动作序列，从而提高在模拟驾驶和机器人手臂任务中的性能。
summary_zh: 共享自主结合了人类用户和AI副驾驶的操作来控制复杂的系统，例如机械臂。当任务具有挑战性、需要高维度控制或容易出错时，共享自主可以通过使用训练过的副驾驶以符合用户目标的方式有效地纠正用户操作，从而显著提高任务性能。为了显著提高共享自主的性能，我们引入扩散序列副驾驶（DiSCo）：一种基于扩散策略的共享自主方法，能够规划与过去用户操作一致的动作序列。DiSCo使用用户提供的动作来播种和修复扩散过程，并利用超参数来平衡对专家行为的服从性、与用户意图的对齐以及感知到的响应性。我们证明 DiSCo 在模拟驾驶和机械臂任务中显著提高了任务性能。项目网站：https://sites.google.com/view/disco-shared-autonomy/

title: MAGICIAN: Efficient Long-Term Planning with Imagined Gaussians for Active Mapping
summary: Active mapping aims to determine how an agent should move to efficiently reconstruct an unknown environment. Most existing approaches rely on greedy next-best-view prediction, resulting in inefficient exploration and incomplete scene reconstruction. To address this limitation, we introduce MAGICIAN, a novel long-term planning framework that maximizes accumulated surface coverage gain through Imagined Gaussians, a scene representation derived from a pre-trained occupancy network with strong structural priors. This representation enables efficient computation of coverage gain for any novel viewpoint via fast volumetric rendering, allowing its integration into a tree-search algorithm for long-horizon planning. We update Imagined Gaussians and refine the planned trajectory in a closed-loop manner. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance across indoor and outdoor benchmarks with varying action spaces, demonstrating the critical advantage of long-term planning in active mapping.
tldr: The paper introduces MAGICIAN, a long-term planning framework for active mapping that uses Imagined Gaussians derived from a pre-trained occupancy network to achieve state-of-the-art performance in indoor and outdoor benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了MAGICIAN，一个用于主动地图构建的长期规划框架。它利用从预训练的占据网络导出的Imagined Gaussians来实现室内外基准测试中的最先进性能。
summary_zh: 主动地图构建旨在确定智能体应如何移动，以高效地重建未知环境。现有的大部分方法依赖于贪婪的次优视角预测，导致低效的探索和不完整的场景重建。为了解决这个局限性，我们提出MAGICIAN，一种新颖的长期规划框架，通过想象高斯模型（Imagined Gaussians）最大化累积的表面覆盖增益。想象高斯模型是从预训练的、具备强结构先验的占据网络中获得的场景表示。这种表示能够通过快速体渲染高效地计算任何新视角的覆盖增益，从而可以将其集成到树搜索算法中进行长时域规划。我们以闭环方式更新想象高斯模型并优化规划的轨迹。我们的方法在具有不同动作空间的室内和室外基准测试中实现了最先进的性能，证明了长期规划在主动地图构建中的关键优势。

title: GIFT: Generalizing Intent for Flexible Test-Time Rewards
summary: Robots learn reward functions from user demonstrations, but these rewards often fail to generalize to new environments. This failure occurs because learned rewards latch onto spurious correlations in training data rather than the underlying human intent that demonstrations represent. Existing methods leverage visual or semantic similarity to improve robustness, yet these surface-level cues often diverge from what humans actually care about. We present Generalizing Intent for Flexible Test-Time Rewards (GIFT), a framework that grounds reward generalization in human intent rather than surface cues. GIFT leverages language models to infer high-level intent from user demonstrations by contrasting preferred with non-preferred behaviors. At deployment, GIFT maps novel test states to behaviorally equivalent training states via intent-conditioned similarity, enabling learned rewards to generalize across distribution shifts without retraining. We evaluate GIFT on tabletop manipulation tasks with new objects and layouts. Across four simulated tasks with over 50 unseen objects, GIFT consistently outperforms visual and semantic similarity baselines in test-time pairwise win rate and state-alignment F1 score. Real-world experiments on a 7-DoF Franka Panda robot demonstrate that GIFT reliably transfers to physical settings. Further discussion can be found at https://mit-clear-lab.github.io/GIFT/
tldr: The paper introduces GIFT, a framework that uses language models to infer human intent from robot demonstrations, allowing learned reward functions to generalize to new environments by mapping novel states to behaviorally equivalent training states. Experiments show superior performance compared to visual and semantic similarity baselines, and the method transfers to real world settings.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了GIFT，一个利用语言模型从机器人演示中推断人类意图的框架，通过将新状态映射到行为等效的训练状态，使学习到的奖励函数能够推广到新环境。实验表明，与视觉和语义相似性基线方法相比，其性能更优，且该方法可以迁移到现实世界。
summary_zh: 机器人可以从用户演示中学习奖励函数，但这些奖励通常无法泛化到新的环境中。这种失败的发生是因为学习到的奖励会抓住训练数据中虚假的关联性，而不是演示所代表的潜在人类意图。现有方法利用视觉或语义相似性来提高鲁棒性，然而这些表面层次的线索通常会偏离人类真正关心的内容。我们提出了用于灵活测试时奖励的意图泛化（GIFT），这是一个将奖励泛化建立在人类意图之上，而非表面线索之上的框架。GIFT利用语言模型通过对比偏好行为和非偏好行为，从用户演示中推断出高层次的意图。在部署时，GIFT通过意图条件相似性，将新的测试状态映射到行为等效的训练状态，从而使学习到的奖励能够在不重训的情况下跨领域迁移。我们在具有新物体和布局的桌面操作任务中评估了GIFT。在超过50个未见物体的四个模拟任务中，GIFT在测试时的成对胜率和状态对齐 F1 分数方面始终优于视觉和语义相似性基线。在7自由度Franka Panda机器人上的真实世界实验表明，GIFT可以可靠地迁移到物理环境中。更多讨论请访问https://mit-clear-lab.github.io/GIFT/

title: Learning Sidewalk Autopilot from Multi-Scale Imitation with Corrective Behavior Expansion
summary: Sidewalk micromobility is a promising solution for last-mile transportation, but current learning-based control methods struggle in complex urban environments. Imitation learning (IL) learns policies from human demonstrations, yet its reliance on fixed offline data often leads to compounding errors, limited robustness, and poor generalization. To address these challenges, we propose a framework that advances IL through corrective behavior expansion and multi-scale imitation learning. On the data side, we augment teleoperation datasets with diverse corrective behaviors and sensor augmentations to enable the policy to learn to recover from its own mistakes. On the model side, we introduce a multi-scale IL architecture that captures both short-horizon interactive behaviors and long-horizon goal-directed intentions via horizon-based trajectory clustering and hierarchical supervision. Real-world experiments show that our approach significantly improves robustness and generalization in diverse sidewalk scenarios.
tldr: This paper introduces a multi-scale imitation learning framework with corrective behavior expansion for sidewalk micromobility, improving robustness and generalization in complex urban environments.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个用于人行道微出行的多尺度模仿学习框架，该框架结合了纠正行为扩展，从而提高了在复杂城市环境中的稳定性和泛化能力。
summary_zh: 人行道微型交通是解决最后一英里问题的有前景的方案，但目前基于学习的控制方法在复杂的城市环境中表现不佳。模仿学习 (IL) 从人工演示中学习策略，但其对固定离线数据的依赖常常导致误差累积、鲁棒性受限和泛化能力差。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种框架，通过纠正行为扩展和多尺度模仿学习来改进 IL。在数据方面，我们利用多样化的纠正行为和传感器增强来扩充远程操作数据集，以使策略能够学习从自身错误中恢复。在模型方面，我们引入了一种多尺度 IL 架构，通过基于horizon的轨迹聚类和分层监督，捕捉短期交互行为和长期目标导向意图。真实世界的实验表明，我们的方法显著提高了在各种人行道场景中的鲁棒性和泛化能力。

title: 3DCity-LLM: Empowering Multi-modality Large Language Models for 3D City-scale Perception and Understanding
summary: While multi-modality large language models excel in object-centric or indoor scenarios, scaling them to 3D city-scale environments remains a formidable challenge. To bridge this gap, we propose 3DCity-LLM, a unified framework designed for 3D city-scale vision-language perception and understanding. 3DCity-LLM employs a coarse-to-fine feature encoding strategy comprising three parallel branches for target object, inter-object relationship, and global scene. To facilitate large-scale training, we introduce 3DCity-LLM-1.2M dataset that comprises approximately 1.2 million high-quality samples across seven representative task categories, ranging from fine-grained object analysis to multi-faceted scene planning. This strictly quality-controlled dataset integrates explicit 3D numerical information and diverse user-oriented simulations, enriching the question-answering diversity and realism of urban scenarios. Furthermore, we apply a multi-dimensional protocol based on text-similarity metrics and LLM-based semantic assessment to ensure faithful and comprehensive evaluations for all methods. Extensive experiments on two benchmarks demonstrate that 3DCity-LLM significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods, offering a promising and meaningful direction for advancing spatial reasoning and urban intelligence. The source code and dataset are available at https://github.com/SYSU-3DSTAILab/3D-City-LLM.
tldr: The paper introduces 3DCity-LLM, a framework for multi-modal large language models to understand 3D city-scale environments, accompanied by a new large-scale dataset, 3DCity-LLM-1.2M, and evaluation benchmarks, demonstrating improved performance over existing methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了3DCity-LLM，一个用于多模态大型语言模型理解3D城市规模环境的框架，同时提供了一个新的大型数据集3DCity-LLM-1.2M和评估基准，并展示了相对于现有方法的改进性能。
summary_zh: 尽管多模态大型语言模型擅长以物体为中心或室内场景的任务，但将其扩展到 3D 城市尺度环境仍然是一项艰巨的挑战。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了 3DCity-LLM，这是一个统一的框架，专为 3D 城市尺度视觉-语言感知和理解而设计。3DCity-LLM 采用一种粗到精的特征编码策略，包含三个并行分支，分别用于目标对象、对象间关系和全局场景。为了促进大规模训练，我们引入了 3DCity-LLM-1.2M 数据集，该数据集包含约 120 万个高质量样本，涵盖七个代表性任务类别，范围从细粒度对象分析到多方面场景规划。这个经过严格质量控制的数据集集成了显式的 3D 数值信息和多样化的面向用户的模拟，丰富了城市场景中问答的多样性和真实性。此外，我们应用了一种基于文本相似度指标和基于 LLM 的语义评估的多维度协议，以确保对所有方法进行忠实和全面的评估。在两个基准测试上的大量实验表明，3DCity-LLM 明显优于现有的最先进方法，为推进空间推理和城市智能提供了一个有希望且有意义的方向。源代码和数据集可在 https://github.com/SYSU-3DSTAILab/3D-City-LLM 获取。

title: SortedRL: Accelerating RL Training for LLMs through Online Length-Aware Scheduling
summary: Scaling reinforcement learning (RL) has shown strong promise for enhancing the reasoning abilities of large language models (LLMs), particularly in tasks requiring long chain-of-thought generation. However, RL training efficiency is often bottlenecked by the rollout phase, which can account for up to 70% of total training time when generating long trajectories (e.g., 16k tokens), due to slow autoregressive generation and synchronization overhead between rollout and policy updates. We propose SortedRL, an online length-aware scheduling strategy designed to address this bottleneck by improving rollout efficiency and maintaining training stability. SortedRL reorders rollout samples based on output lengths, prioritizing short samples forming groups for early updates. This enables large rollout batches, flexible update batches, and near on-policy micro-curriculum construction simultaneously. To further accelerate the pipeline, SortedRL incorporates a mechanism to control the degree of off-policy training through a cache-based mechanism, and is supported by a dedicated RL infrastructure that manages rollout and update via a stateful controller and rollout buffer. Experiments using LLaMA-3.1-8B and Qwen-2.5-32B on diverse tasks, including logical puzzles, and math challenges like AIME 24, Math 500, and Minerval, show that SortedRL reduces RL training bubble ratios by over 50%, while attaining 3.9% to 18.4% superior performance over baseline given same amount of data.
tldr: The paper introduces SortedRL, an online length-aware scheduling strategy for RL training of LLMs that prioritizes shorter samples for early updates, leading to improved training efficiency and performance on reasoning and math tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SortedRL，一种LLM强化学习训练的在线长度感知调度策略，它优先处理较短的样本以进行早期更新，从而提高了训练效率并在推理和数学任务上实现了更好的性能。
summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）的规模化已展现出增强大型语言模型（LLM）推理能力的强大潜力，尤其是在需要长链式思考生成的任务中。然而，RL训练效率通常受限于 rollout 阶段，由于缓慢的自回归生成以及 rollout 与策略更新之间的同步开销，在生成长轨迹（例如，16k tokens）时，rollout 阶段可能占据总训练时间的70%以上。我们提出了SortedRL，一种在线长度感知调度策略，旨在通过提高rollout效率并维持训练稳定性来解决这一瓶颈。SortedRL根据输出长度对rollout样本进行重新排序，优先处理短样本，形成分组以进行早期更新。这能够同时实现大型rollout批次、灵活的更新批次，以及近在线微课程构建。为了进一步加速pipeline，SortedRL引入了一种通过基于缓存的机制来控制离策略训练程度的机制，并由专门的RL基础设施提供支持，该基础设施通过有状态的控制器和rollout缓冲区来管理rollout和更新。在使用LLaMA-3.1-8B和Qwen-2.5-32B在多样化任务（包括逻辑谜题和数学挑战，如AIME 24、Math 500和Minerva）上进行的实验表明，SortedRL将RL训练气泡比率降低了50%以上，同时在给定相同数据量的情况下，性能比基线提高了3.9%到18.4%。

title: Neural ODE and SDE Models for Adaptation and Planning in Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
summary: We investigate neural ordinary and stochastic differential equations (neural ODEs and SDEs) to model stochastic dynamics in fully and partially observed environments within a model-based reinforcement learning (RL) framework. Through a sequence of simulations, we show that neural SDEs more effectively capture the inherent stochasticity of transition dynamics, enabling high-performing policies with improved sample efficiency in challenging scenarios. We leverage neural ODEs and SDEs for efficient policy adaptation to changes in environment dynamics via inverse models, requiring only limited interactions with the new environment. To address partial observability, we introduce a latent SDE model that combines an ODE with a GAN-trained stochastic component in latent space. Policies derived from this model provide a strong baseline, outperforming or matching general model-based and model-free approaches across stochastic continuous-control benchmarks. This work demonstrates the applicability of action-conditional latent SDEs for RL planning in environments with stochastic transitions. Our code is available at: https://github.com/ChaoHan-UoS/NeuralRL
tldr: This paper explores the use of neural ODEs and SDEs for modeling stochastic dynamics in model-based RL, demonstrating improved sample efficiency and adaptation capabilities in both fully and partially observed environments.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了神经常微分方程和随机微分方程（neural ODEs and SDEs）在基于模型的强化学习框架中对随机动态的建模，显示了在完全和部分可观测环境中提高样本效率和适应能力。
summary_zh: 我们研究了神经常微分方程和神经随机微分方程（neural ODEs和SDEs），以在基于模型的强化学习（RL）框架内，对完全和部分可观测环境中的随机动力学进行建模。通过一系列仿真，我们表明神经SDEs能更有效地捕捉转移动力学的内在随机性，从而在具有挑战性的场景中实现高性能策略，并提高样本效率。 我们利用神经ODEs和SDEs，通过逆模型有效地将策略适应于环境动力学的变化，并且仅需与新环境进行有限的交互。 为了解决部分可观测性问题，我们引入了一种潜在SDE模型，该模型将ODE与在潜在空间中经GAN训练的随机分量相结合。 从该模型衍生的策略提供了一个强大的基线，在随机连续控制基准测试中优于或匹配一般的基于模型和无模型的策略。 这项工作证明了动作条件潜在SDEs在具有随机转移的环境中用于强化学习规划的适用性。 我们的代码可在以下网址获得：https://github.com/ChaoHan-UoS/NeuralRL

title: MemCollab: Cross-Agent Memory Collaboration via Contrastive Trajectory Distillation
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based agents rely on memory mechanisms to reuse knowledge from past problem-solving experiences. Existing approaches typically construct memory in a per-agent manner, tightly coupling stored knowledge to a single model's reasoning style. In modern deployments with heterogeneous agents, a natural question arises: can a single memory system be shared across different models? We found that naively transferring memory between agents often degrades performance, as such memory entangles task-relevant knowledge with agent-specific biases. To address this challenge, we propose MemCollab, a collaborative memory framework that constructs agent-agnostic memory by contrasting reasoning trajectories generated by different agents on the same task. This contrastive process distills abstract reasoning constraints that capture shared task-level invariants while suppressing agent-specific artifacts. We further introduce a task-aware retrieval mechanism that conditions memory access on task category, ensuring that only relevant constraints are used at inference time. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks demonstrate that MemCollab consistently improves both accuracy and inference-time efficiency across diverse agents, including cross-modal-family settings. Our results show that the collaboratively constructed memory can function as a shared reasoning resource for diverse LLM-based agents.
tldr: The paper introduces MemCollab, a collaborative memory framework for LLM agents that distills agent-agnostic knowledge by contrasting reasoning trajectories, leading to improved performance and efficiency across diverse agents.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了MemCollab，一个用于LLM代理的协同记忆框架，通过对比推理轨迹提取与代理无关的知识，从而提高各种代理的性能和效率。
summary_zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体依赖于记忆机制来重用来自过往问题解决经验的知识。现有的方法通常以每个智能体为单位构建记忆，将存储的知识与单一模型的推理风格紧密耦合。在现代异构智能体的部署中，一个自然的问题是：一个统一的记忆系统能否在不同的模型之间共享？我们发现，简单地在智能体之间转移记忆通常会降低性能，因为这样的记忆会将任务相关的知识与智能体特定的偏差纠缠在一起。为了解决这个挑战，我们提出了 MemCollab，一个协作记忆框架，它通过对比不同智能体在同一任务上生成的推理轨迹来构建与智能体无关的记忆。这种对比过程提炼出抽象的推理约束，这些约束捕获共享的任务级别的不变量，同时抑制了智能体特定的伪影。我们进一步引入了一种任务感知的检索机制，该机制根据任务类别来调节记忆访问，确保在推理时仅使用相关的约束。在数学推理和代码生成基准上的实验表明，MemCollab 在各种智能体（包括跨模态家族设置）中，始终如一地提高了准确性和推理效率。我们的结果表明，协作构建的记忆可以作为各种基于 LLM 的智能体的共享推理资源。

title: Describe-Then-Act: Proactive Agent Steering via Distilled Language-Action World Models
summary: Deploying safety-critical agents requires anticipating the consequences of actions before they are executed. While world models offer a paradigm for this proactive foresight, current approaches relying on visual simulation incur prohibitive latencies, often exceeding several seconds per step. In this work, we challenge the assumption that visual processing is necessary for failure prevention. We show that a trained policy's latent state, combined with its planned actions, already encodes sufficient information to anticipate action outcomes, making visual simulation redundant for failure prevention. To this end, we introduce DILLO (DIstiLLed Language-ActiOn World Model), a fast steering layer that shifts the paradigm from "simulate-then-act" to "describe-then-act." DILLO is trained via cross-modal distillation, where a privileged Vision Language Model teacher annotates offline trajectories and a latent-conditioned Large Language Model student learns to predict semantic outcomes. This creates a text-only inference path, bypassing heavy visual generation entirely, achieving a 14x speedup over baselines. Experiments on MetaWorld and LIBERO demonstrate that DILLO produces high-fidelity descriptions of the next state and is able to steer the policy, improving episode success rate by up to 15 pp and 9.3 pp on average across tasks.
tldr: The paper introduces DILLO, a fast steering layer that uses distilled language-action world models to predict action outcomes and improve policy performance by leveraging a large language model conditioned on the policy's latent state, achieving significant speedups compared to vision-based world models.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种快速导向层 DILLO，它使用提炼的语言-动作世界模型来预测动作结果，并通过利用以策略潜在状态为条件的语言模型来提高策略性能，与基于视觉的世界模型相比，实现了显著的加速。
summary_zh: 部署安全攸关型智能体需要在执行动作之前预测动作的后果。虽然世界模型为此类主动性预测提供了一个范例，但当前依赖视觉模拟的方法会产生令人望而却步的延迟，通常每个步骤超过几秒。在这项工作中，我们挑战了视觉处理对于预防失败是必要的这一假设。我们表明，训练好的策略的潜在状态，以及其计划的动作，已经编码了足够的信息来预测动作结果，从而使得视觉模拟对于预防失败变得冗余。为此，我们引入了 DILLO (DIstiLLed Language-ActiOn World Model，蒸馏语言-动作世界模型)，这是一个快速转向层，它将范式从“模拟-然后-行动”转变为“描述-然后-行动”。DILLO 通过跨模态蒸馏进行训练，其中一个特权视觉语言模型教师标注离线轨迹，而一个潜在状态条件化的大型语言模型学生学习预测语义结果。这创建了一个纯文本推理路径，完全绕过了繁重的视觉生成，实现了比基线方法快 14 倍的速度提升。在 MetaWorld 和 LIBERO 上的实验表明，DILLO 产生了对下一个状态的高保真描述，并且能够引导策略，在任务中的平均成功率提高了高达 15 个百分点和 9.3 个百分点。

title: StateLinFormer: Stateful Training Enhancing Long-term Memory in Navigation
summary: Effective navigation intelligence relies on long-term memory to support both immediate generalization and sustained adaptation. However, existing approaches face a dilemma: modular systems rely on explicit mapping but lack flexibility, while Transformer-based end-to-end models are constrained by fixed context windows, limiting persistent memory across extended interactions. We introduce StateLinFormer, a linear-attention navigation model trained with a stateful memory mechanism that preserves recurrent memory states across consecutive training segments instead of reinitializing them at each batch boundary. This training paradigm effectively approximates learning on infinitely long sequences, enabling the model to achieve long-horizon memory retention. Experiments across both MAZE and ProcTHOR environments demonstrate that StateLinFormer significantly outperforms its stateless linear-attention counterpart and standard Transformer baselines with fixed context windows. Notably, as interaction length increases, persistent stateful training substantially improves context-dependent adaptation, suggesting an enhancement in the model's In-Context Learning (ICL) capabilities for navigation tasks.
tldr: The paper introduces StateLinFormer, a linear-attention based navigation model trained with a stateful memory mechanism to improve long-term memory in navigation tasks, outperforming stateless models and fixed-window Transformers in MAZE and ProcTHOR environments.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 StateLinFormer，一种基于线性注意力的导航模型，它通过有状态的记忆机制进行训练，以提高导航任务中的长期记忆能力。在 MAZE 和 ProcTHOR 环境中，它的表现优于无状态模型和固定窗口 Transformer。
summary_zh: 有效的导航智能依赖于长期记忆，以支持即时泛化和持续适应。然而，现有方法面临一个困境：模块化系统依赖于显式映射，但缺乏灵活性，而基于Transformer的端到端模型受限于固定的上下文窗口，从而限制了跨扩展交互的持久记忆。我们引入了StateLinFormer，一种线性注意力导航模型，它通过一种有状态的记忆机制进行训练，该机制在连续的训练片段中保持循环记忆状态，而不是在每个批次边界重置它们。这种训练范式有效地近似于在无限长的序列上进行学习，使模型能够实现长时程的记忆保持。在MAZE和ProcTHOR环境中的实验表明，StateLinFormer显著优于其无状态线性注意力对应模型和具有固定上下文窗口的标准Transformer基线模型。值得注意的是，随着交互长度的增加，持久的有状态训练显著改善了上下文相关的适应性，表明该模型在导航任务中的上下文学习（ICL）能力得到了增强。

title: Safe Reinforcement Learning with Preference-based Constraint Inference
summary: Safe reinforcement learning (RL) is a standard paradigm for safety-critical decision making. However, real-world safety constraints can be complex, subjective, and even hard to explicitly specify. Existing works on constraint inference rely on restrictive assumptions or extensive expert demonstrations, which is not realistic in many real-world applications. How to cheaply and reliably learn these constraints is the major challenge we focus on in this study. While inferring constraints from human preferences offers a data-efficient alternative, we identify the popular Bradley-Terry (BT) models fail to capture the asymmetric, heavy-tailed nature of safety costs, resulting in risk underestimation. It is still rare in the literature to understand the impacts of BT models on the downstream policy learning. To address the above knowledge gaps, we propose a novel approach namely Preference-based Constrained Reinforcement Learning (PbCRL). We introduce a novel dead zone mechanism into preference modeling and theoretically prove that it encourages heavy-tailed cost distributions, thereby achieving better constraint alignment. Additionally, we incorporate a Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) loss to encourage exploration by cost variances, which is found to benefit policy learning. Further, two-stage training strategy are deployed to lower online labeling burdens while adaptively enhancing constraint satisfaction. Empirical results demonstrate that PbCRL achieves superior alignment with true safety requirements and outperforms the state-of-the-art baselines in terms of safety and reward. Our work explores a promising and effective way for constraint inference in Safe RL, which has great potential in a range of safety-critical applications.
tldr: The paper introduces Preference-based Constrained Reinforcement Learning (PbCRL) for safe RL, addressing the challenge of inferring safety constraints from human preferences by improving preference modeling with a dead zone mechanism and Signal-to-Noise Ratio loss, achieving better constraint alignment and performance.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了基于偏好的约束强化学习（PbCRL），用于安全强化学习。该方法通过改进具有死区机制的偏好建模和信噪比损失，解决了从人类偏好中推断安全约束的难题，实现了更好的约束对齐和性能。
summary_zh: 安全强化学习（RL）是安全攸关决策的标准范式。然而，现实世界的安全约束可能复杂、主观，甚至难以明确指定。现有的约束推断工作依赖于限制性假设或大量的专家演示，这在许多现实应用中是不切实际的。如何经济高效且可靠地学习这些约束是本研究关注的主要挑战。虽然从人类偏好推断约束提供了一种数据高效的替代方案，但我们发现流行的布拉德利-特里（BT）模型无法捕捉安全成本的非对称、重尾特性，从而导致风险低估。文献中仍然很少有对BT模型对下游策略学习的影响的理解。为了解决上述知识差距，我们提出了一种名为基于偏好的约束强化学习（PbCRL）的新方法。我们在偏好建模中引入了一种新的死区机制，并在理论上证明它可以鼓励重尾成本分布，从而实现更好的约束对齐。此外，我们结合了信噪比（SNR）损失来鼓励通过成本方差进行探索，这被发现有益于策略学习。进一步，我们部署了两阶段训练策略，以降低在线标注负担，同时自适应地增强约束满足。实验结果表明，PbCRL在真实安全要求的对齐方面表现优异，并且在安全性和奖励方面优于最先进的基线方法。我们的工作探索了一种有前景且有效的安全强化学习中约束推断的方法，它在一系列安全攸关应用中具有巨大的潜力。

title: EVA: Efficient Reinforcement Learning for End-to-End Video Agent
summary: Video understanding with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remains challenging due to the long token sequences of videos, which contain extensive temporal dependencies and redundant frames. Existing approaches typically treat MLLMs as passive recognizers, processing entire videos or uniformly sampled frames without adaptive reasoning. Recent agent-based methods introduce external tools, yet still depend on manually designed workflows and perception-first strategies, resulting in inefficiency on long videos. We present EVA, an Efficient Reinforcement Learning framework for End-to-End Video Agent, which enables planning-before-perception through iterative summary-plan-action-reflection reasoning. EVA autonomously decides what to watch, when to watch, and how to watch, achieving query-driven and efficient video understanding. To train such agents, we design a simple yet effective three-stage learning pipeline - comprising supervised fine-tuning (SFT), Kahneman-Tversky Optimization (KTO), and Generalized Reward Policy Optimization (GRPO) - that bridges supervised imitation and reinforcement learning. We further construct high-quality datasets for each stage, supporting stable and reproducible training. We evaluate EVA on six video understanding benchmarks, demonstrating its comprehensive capabilities. Compared with existing baselines, EVA achieves a substantial improvement of 6-12% over general MLLM baselines and a further 1-3% gain over prior adaptive agent methods. Our code and model are available at https://github.com/wangruohui/EfficientVideoAgent.
tldr: The paper introduces EVA, an efficient reinforcement learning framework for video understanding using MLLMs, employing a novel training pipeline to enable adaptive, query-driven video processing and demonstrating significant performance improvements over existing methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为EVA的高效强化学习框架，用于使用MLLM进行视频理解。它采用了一种新的训练流程，实现了自适应的、查询驱动的视频处理，并在现有方法上取得了显著的性能提升。
