summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型 (MLLM) 进行视频理解仍然面临挑战，原因在于视频的较长令牌序列包含大量的时序依赖性和冗余帧。现有方法通常将 MLLM 视为被动的识别器，处理整个视频或均匀采样的帧，缺乏自适应推理。最近基于代理的方法引入了外部工具，但仍然依赖于手动设计的工作流程和感知优先策略，导致在长视频上的效率低下。我们提出了 EVA，一个用于端到端视频代理的高效强化学习框架，它通过迭代的总结-计划-行动-反思推理实现感知之前的规划。EVA 自主决定观看什么、何时观看以及如何观看，从而实现查询驱动的高效视频理解。为了训练这样的代理，我们设计了一个简单而有效的三阶段学习流程——包括监督微调 (SFT)、卡尼曼-特沃斯基优化 (KTO) 和广义奖励策略优化 (GRPO) ——它桥接了监督模仿学习和强化学习。我们进一步构建了每个阶段的高质量数据集，支持稳定和可复现的训练。我们在六个视频理解基准测试上评估了 EVA，证明了其全面的能力。与现有基线相比，EVA 比通用 MLLM 基线取得了 6-12% 的显著提升，并且比之前的自适应代理方法进一步提升了 1-3%。我们的代码和模型可在 https://github.com/wangruohui/EfficientVideoAgent 获取。

title: ForestPrune: High-ratio Visual Token Compression for Video Multimodal Large Language Models via Spatial-Temporal Forest Modeling
summary: Due to the great saving of computation and memory overhead, token compression has become a research hot-spot for MLLMs and achieved remarkable progress in image-language tasks. However, for the video, existing methods still fall short of high-ratio token compression. We attribute this shortcoming to the insufficient modeling of temporal and continual video content, and propose a novel and training-free token pruning method for video MLLMs, termed ForestPrune, which achieves effective and high-ratio pruning via Spatial-temporal Forest Modeling. In practice, ForestPrune construct token forests across video frames based on the semantic, spatial and temporal constraints, making an overall comprehension of videos. Afterwards, ForestPrune evaluates the importance of token trees and nodes based on tree depth and node roles, thereby obtaining a globally optimal pruning decision. To validate ForestPrune, we apply it to two representative video MLLMs, namely LLaVA-Video and LLaVA-OneVision, and conduct extensive experiments on a bunch of video benchmarks. The experimental results not only show the great effectiveness for video MLLMs, e.g., retaining 95.8% average accuracy while reducing 90% tokens for LLaVA-OneVision, but also show its superior performance and efficiency than the compared token compression methods, e.g., +10.1% accuracy on MLVU and -81.4% pruning time than FrameFusion on LLaVA-Video.
tldr: The paper introduces ForestPrune, a novel, training-free token pruning method that uses spatial-temporal forest modeling to achieve high-ratio token compression in video MLLMs, demonstrating significant accuracy retention and efficiency gains over existing methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ForestPrune，一种新颖的、无需训练的token剪枝方法，它利用时空森林建模来实现视频多模态大语言模型（MLLM）中的高比例token压缩，并且在保持准确率和效率方面表现出显著的优势。
summary_zh:
摘要：
由于在计算和内存开销方面的巨大节省，令牌压缩已成为多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）的研究热点，并在图像-语言任务中取得了显著进展。然而，对于视频而言，现有方法在高比例令牌压缩方面仍然不足。我们将这一缺点归因于对时域和连续视频内容建模的不足，并提出了一种新颖的、免训练的视频 MLLMs 令牌剪枝方法，称为 ForestPrune，它通过时空森林建模实现有效且高比例的剪枝。在实践中，ForestPrune 基于语义、空间和时间约束构建跨视频帧的令牌森林，从而实现对视频的整体理解。随后，ForestPrune 基于树的深度和节点角色评估令牌树和节点的重要性，从而获得全局最优的剪枝决策。为了验证 ForestPrune，我们将其应用于两个具有代表性的视频 MLLMs，即 LLaVA-Video 和 LLaVA-OneVision，并在大量视频基准数据集上进行了广泛的实验。实验结果不仅表明了其对视频 MLLMs 的巨大有效性，例如，在 LLaVA-OneVision 上减少 90% 的令牌的同时保持 95.8% 的平均准确率，还显示了其优于对比令牌压缩方法的性能和效率，例如，在 LLaVA-Video 上，在 MLVU 上准确率提高 +10.1%，剪枝时间比 FrameFusion 减少 -81.4%。

title: Agent-Sentry: Bounding LLM Agents via Execution Provenance
summary: Agentic computing systems, which autonomously spawn new functionalities based on natural language instructions, are becoming increasingly prevalent. While immensely capable, these systems raise serious security, privacy, and safety concerns. Fundamentally, the full set of functionalities offered by these systems, combined with their probabilistic execution flows, is not known beforehand. Given this lack of characterization, it is non-trivial to validate whether a system has successfully carried out the user's intended task or instead executed irrelevant actions, potentially as a consequence of compromise. In this paper, we propose Agent-Sentry, a framework that attempts to bound agentic systems to address this problem. Our key insight is that agentic systems are designed for specific use cases and therefore need not expose unbounded or unspecified functionalities. Once bounded, these systems become easier to scrutinize. Agent-Sentry operationalizes this insight by uncovering frequent functionalities offered by an agentic system, along with their execution traces, to construct behavioral bounds. It then learns a policy from these traces and blocks tool calls that deviate from learned behaviors or that misalign with user intent. Our evaluation shows that Agent-Sentry helps prevent over 90\% of attacks that attempt to trigger out-of-bounds executions, while preserving up to 98\% of system utility.
tldr: Agent-Sentry bounds agentic systems by learning policies from execution traces to prevent out-of-bounds executions and attacks, while preserving system utility.
tldr_zh: Agent-Sentry通过从执行轨迹中学习策略来约束自主代理系统，防止越界执行和攻击，同时保持系统效用。
summary_zh: 自主计算系统能够根据自然语言指令自主生成新的功能，正变得越来越普遍。尽管这些系统功能强大，但也引发了严重的安全、隐私和安全问题。从根本上讲，这些系统提供的全部功能集合，以及它们的概率执行流程，都是事先未知的。鉴于这种缺乏表征的情况，验证系统是否成功执行了用户的意图任务，或者是否执行了无关的操作（可能是由于受到攻击），将变得非常困难。在本文中，我们提出了 Agent-Sentry，一个旨在约束自主计算系统以解决这个问题的框架。我们的关键见解是，自主计算系统是为特定用例设计的，因此不需要暴露无界的或未指定的功能。一旦受到约束，这些系统就更容易受到审查。Agent-Sentry通过发现自主计算系统提供的常用功能及其执行跟踪来构建行为边界，从而使这一见解得以实现。然后，它从这些跟踪中学习策略，并阻止偏离学习行为或与用户意图不符的工具调用。我们的评估表明，Agent-Sentry有助于阻止超过90%的试图触发越界执行的攻击，同时保留高达98%的系统效用。

title: Agent Audit: A Security Analysis System for LLM Agent Applications
summary:
What should a developer inspect before deploying an LLM agent: the model, the tool code, the deployment configuration, or all three? In practice, many security failures in agent systems arise not from model weights alone, but from the surrounding software stack: tool functions that pass untrusted inputs to dangerous operations, exposed credentials in deployment artifacts, and over-privileged Model Context Protocol (MCP) configurations.
  We present Agent Audit, a security analysis system for LLM agent applications. Agent Audit analyzes Python agent code and deployment artifacts through an agent-aware pipeline that combines dataflow analysis, credential detection, structured configuration parsing, and privilege-risk checks. The system reports findings in terminal, JSON, and SARIF formats, enabling direct integration with local development workflows and CI/CD pipelines. On a benchmark of 22 samples with 42 annotated vulnerabilities, Agent Audit detects 40 vulnerabilities with 6 false positives, substantially improving recall over common SAST baselines while maintaining sub-second scan times. Agent Audit is open source and installable via pip, making security auditing accessible for agent systems.
  In the live demonstration, attendees scan vulnerable agent repositories and observe how Agent Audit identifies security risks in tool functions, prompts, and more. Findings are linked to source locations and configuration paths, and can be exported into VS Code and GitHub Code Scanning for interactive inspection.
tldr: The paper introduces Agent Audit, a security analysis system for LLM agent applications, designed to detect vulnerabilities in tool functions, prompts, and configurations. It demonstrates improved vulnerability detection compared to standard SAST baselines.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个名为 Agent Audit 的安全分析系统，用于 LLM 代理应用程序，旨在检测工具函数、提示和配置中的漏洞。 与标准 SAST 基线相比，它展示了改进的漏洞检测能力。
summary_zh:
在部署LLM Agent前，开发者应该检查什么：模型、工具代码、部署配置，还是全部三者？在实践中，Agent系统中的许多安全故障并非仅仅源于模型权重，而是源于周围的软件栈：将不受信任的输入传递给危险操作的工具函数、部署工件中暴露的凭据，以及过度授权的模型上下文协议（MCP）配置。

  我们提出了Agent Audit，一个用于LLM Agent应用程序的安全分析系统。Agent Audit通过一个Agent感知的流水线分析Python Agent代码和部署工件，该流水线结合了数据流分析、凭据检测、结构化配置解析和权限风险检查。该系统以终端、JSON和SARIF格式报告结果，从而能够直接集成到本地开发工作流和CI/CD流水线中。在一个包含22个样本和42个带标注漏洞的基准测试中，Agent Audit检测到40个漏洞，产生6个假阳性，在保持亚秒级扫描时间的同时，显著提高了相对于常见SAST基线的召回率。Agent Audit是开源的，可以通过pip安装，使得Agent系统的安全审计变得易于访问。

  在现场演示中，与会者可以扫描存在漏洞的Agent仓库，并观察Agent Audit如何识别工具函数、提示等中的安全风险。结果与源代码位置和配置路径相关联，并且可以导出到VS Code和GitHub代码扫描中以进行交互式检查。

title: PhySe-RPO: Physics and Semantics Guided Relative Policy Optimization for Diffusion-Based Surgical Smoke Removal
summary: Surgical smoke severely degrades intraoperative video quality, obscuring anatomical structures and limiting surgical perception. Existing learning-based desmoking approaches rely on scarce paired supervision and deterministic restoration pipelines, making it difficult to perform exploration or reinforcement-driven refinement under real surgical conditions. We propose PhySe-RPO, a diffusion restoration framework optimized through Physics- and Semantics-Guided Relative Policy Optimization. The core idea is to transform deterministic restoration into a stochastic policy, enabling trajectory-level exploration and critic-free updates via group-relative optimization. A physics-guided reward imposes illumination and color consistency, while a visual-concept semantic reward learned from CLIP-based surgical concepts promotes smoke-free and anatomically coherent restoration. Together with a reference-free perceptual constraint, PhySe-RPO produces results that are physically consistent, semantically faithful, and clinically interpretable across synthetic and real robotic surgical datasets, providing a principled route to robust diffusion-based restoration under limited paired supervision.
tldr: This paper introduces PhySe-RPO, a diffusion-based surgical smoke removal framework that leverages physics and semantics guided relative policy optimization for improved video quality in surgical settings with limited paired supervision.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于扩散的PhySe-RPO手术烟雾去除框架，该框架利用物理和语义引导的相对策略优化来提高手术环境中视频的质量，且只需要有限的配对监督。
summary_zh:
以下是译文：

手术烟雾会严重降低术中视频的质量，遮蔽解剖结构并限制手术视野。现有的基于学习的去烟雾方法依赖于稀缺的配对监督信息和确定性的复原流程，这使得在真实手术条件下进行探索或强化驱动的精细化调整变得困难。我们提出了一种基于物理和语义引导的相对策略优化的扩散复原框架PhySe-RPO。其核心思想是将确定性复原转化为随机策略，从而实现轨迹级别的探索，并通过组相对优化进行无评论者的更新。一种物理引导的奖励强制执行光照和颜色一致性，而一种从基于CLIP的手术概念学习到的视觉概念语义奖励则促进无烟雾且解剖学上连贯的复原。结合无需参考的感知约束，PhySe-RPO 在合成和真实的机器人手术数据集上产生了物理上一致、语义上忠实且临床上可解释的结果，为在有限配对监督下实现鲁棒的基于扩散的复原提供了一条原则性的途径。

title: CAPTCHA Solving for Native GUI Agents: Automated Reasoning-Action Data Generation and Self-Corrective Training
summary: GUI agents are rapidly shifting from multi-module pipelines to end-to-end, native vision-language models (VLMs) that perceive raw screenshots and directly interact with digital devices. Despite rapid progress on general GUI tasks, CAPTCHA solving remains a major challenge. On the other hand, although specialized CAPTCHA solving pipelines exist, they cannot handle general GUI tasks. To address this gap, we introduce ReCAP: a CAPTCHA-capable native GUI agent that can robustly solve modern, interactive CAPTCHA challenges, while preserving their performance as a general GUI agent. We first develop a dynamic CAPTCHA system spanning seven representative CAPTCHA types, designed to stress primitive and complementary capabilities for CAPTCHA solving (e.g., robust OCR under heavy noise and text stylization, fine-grained visual understanding, and precise control). Then, we develop an automated data collection and curation pipeline that generates large-scale CAPTCHA interaction trajectories paired with reasoning traces. As CAPTCHA solving often requires multi-step interaction and recovery from intermediate mistakes, we further leverage failed trajectories to construct self-correction data, training agents to reflect on errors and correct their actions online. Across held-out test sets, ReCAP improves CAPTCHA-solving success from roughly 30\% to 80\%, while maintaining strong performance on general GUI-agent benchmarks.
tldr: The paper introduces ReCAP, a native GUI agent capable of solving CAPTCHAs while maintaining performance on general GUI tasks, achieved through automated data generation and self-corrective training.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ReCAP，一个能够解决验证码且同时保持在通用GUI任务上性能的原生GUI智能体，通过自动化数据生成和自我纠正训练实现。
summary_zh: GUI智能体正迅速从多模块流水线转向端到端、原生的视觉-语言模型(VLMs)，这些模型能够感知原始屏幕截图并直接与数字设备交互。尽管通用GUI任务取得了快速进展，CAPTCHA破解仍然是一个主要挑战。另一方面，尽管存在专门的CAPTCHA破解流水线，它们无法处理通用的GUI任务。为了弥合这一差距，我们引入了ReCAP：一种具备CAPTCHA破解能力的原生GUI智能体，它能够稳健地解决现代的、交互式的CAPTCHA挑战，同时保持其作为通用GUI智能体的性能。我们首先开发了一个动态的CAPTCHA系统，涵盖七种具有代表性的CAPTCHA类型，旨在强调破解CAPTCHA所需的原始且互补的能力（例如，在严重噪声和文本样式化下的鲁棒OCR、细粒度的视觉理解以及精确控制）。然后，我们开发了一个自动化的数据收集和管理流水线，生成大规模的CAPTCHA交互轨迹，并配以推理轨迹。由于CAPTCHA破解通常需要多步交互和从中间错误中恢复，我们进一步利用失败的轨迹来构建自我纠正数据，训练智能体反思错误并在线纠正其行为。在保留的测试集上，ReCAP将CAPTCHA破解成功率从大约30%提高到80%，同时在通用GUI智能体基准测试中保持了强大的性能。

title: Stability-Preserving Online Adaptation of Neural Closed-loop Maps
summary: The growing complexity of modern control tasks calls for controllers that can react online as objectives and disturbances change, while preserving closed-loop stability. Recent approaches for improving the performance of nonlinear systems while preserving closed-loop stability rely on time-invariant recurrent neural-network controllers, but offer no principled way to update the controller during operation. Most importantly, switching from one stabilizing policy to another can itself destabilize the closed-loop. We address this problem by introducing a stability-preserving update mechanism for nonlinear, neural-network-based controllers. Each controller is modeled as a causal operator with bounded $\ell_p$-gain, and we derive gain-based conditions under which the controller may be updated online. These conditions yield two practical update schemes, time-scheduled and state-triggered, that guarantee the closed-loop remains $\ell_p$-stable after any number of updates. Our analysis further shows that stability is decoupled from controller optimality, allowing approximate or early-stopped controller synthesis. We demonstrate the approach on nonlinear systems with time-varying objectives and disturbances, and show consistent performance improvements over static and naive online baselines while guaranteeing stability.
tldr: This paper introduces a stability-preserving online update mechanism for neural network controllers, ensuring closed-loop stability during online adaptation to changing objectives and disturbances. It guarantees stability even with controller updates using gain-based conditions.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于神经网络控制器的保稳定性在线更新机制，确保控制系统在适应不断变化的目标和干扰时保持闭环稳定性。它通过基于增益的条件保证了即使在控制器更新的情况下也保持稳定性。
summary_zh:
摘要：
现代控制任务日益复杂，需要控制器能够在线对目标和扰动变化做出反应，同时保持闭环稳定性。 近年来，在保持闭环稳定性的前提下提升非线性系统性能的方法依赖于时不变的循环神经网络控制器，但没有提供在运行期间更新控制器的原则性方法。 最重要的是，从一个稳定策略切换到另一个策略本身可能会使闭环不稳定。 我们通过引入一种针对基于神经网络的非线性控制器的稳定性保持更新机制来解决这个问题。 每个控制器都被建模成一个具有有界$\ell_p$-增益的因果算子，并且我们推导出基于增益的条件，在该条件下，控制器可以在线更新。 这些条件产生了两种实用的更新方案，即时间调度更新和状态触发更新，它们保证闭环在任意数量的更新后仍然是$\ell_p$-稳定的。 我们的分析更进一步表明，稳定性与控制器最优性是解耦的，从而允许近似或提前停止的控制器综合。 我们在具有时变目标和扰动的非线性系统上验证了该方法，并展示了相对于静态和朴素在线基线的持续性能提升，同时保证了稳定性。

title: WildWorld: A Large-Scale Dataset for Dynamic World Modeling with Actions and Explicit State toward Generative ARPG
summary: Dynamical systems theory and reinforcement learning view world evolution as latent-state dynamics driven by actions, with visual observations providing partial information about the state. Recent video world models attempt to learn this action-conditioned dynamics from data. However, existing datasets rarely match the requirement: they typically lack diverse and semantically meaningful action spaces, and actions are directly tied to visual observations rather than mediated by underlying states. As a result, actions are often entangled with pixel-level changes, making it difficult for models to learn structured world dynamics and maintain consistent evolution over long horizons. In this paper, we propose WildWorld, a large-scale action-conditioned world modeling dataset with explicit state annotations, automatically collected from a photorealistic AAA action role-playing game (Monster Hunter: Wilds). WildWorld contains over 108 million frames and features more than 450 actions, including movement, attacks, and skill casting, together with synchronized per-frame annotations of character skeletons, world states, camera poses, and depth maps. We further derive WildBench to evaluate models through Action Following and State Alignment. Extensive experiments reveal persistent challenges in modeling semantically rich actions and maintaining long-horizon state consistency, highlighting the need for state-aware video generation. The project page is https://shandaai.github.io/wildworld-project/.
tldr: The paper introduces WildWorld, a large-scale dataset for action-conditioned world modeling with explicit state annotations derived from Monster Hunter: Wilds, addressing limitations of existing datasets in action diversity and state grounding for learning structured world dynamics.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了WildWorld，一个大规模的、带有显式状态注释的行为条件世界建模数据集，它源自《怪物猎人：荒野》，旨在解决现有数据集在行为多样性和状态关联方面的局限性，以学习结构化的世界动态。
summary_zh: 动态系统理论和强化学习将世界演化视为由动作驱动的潜在状态动力学，而视觉观测则提供关于状态的部分信息。 近期的视频世界模型试图从数据中学习这种动作条件动力学。 然而，现有的数据集很少能满足这一要求：它们通常缺乏多样且语义上有意义的动作空间，并且动作直接与视觉观测相关联，而非由底层状态调节。 由此导致动作经常与像素级变化纠缠在一起，使得模型难以学习结构化的世界动力学，并在长时程内保持一致的演化。 在本文中，我们提出了 WildWorld，一个大规模的、动作条件的世界建模数据集，带有显式的状态标注，自动收集自一个照片级真实的AAA级动作角色扮演游戏（怪物猎人：荒野）。 WildWorld 包含超过 1.08 亿帧，并具有 450 多个动作，包括移动、攻击和技能施放，以及同步的每帧人物骨骼、世界状态、相机姿态和深度图标注。 我们进一步推导出了 WildBench，通过动作跟随和状态对齐来评估模型。 大量的实验揭示了在建模语义丰富的动作和维持长时程状态一致性方面的持续挑战，突出了对状态感知的视频生成的需求。 项目主页为 https://shandaai.github.io/wildworld-project/。

title: SpecEyes: Accelerating Agentic Multimodal LLMs via Speculative Perception and Planning
summary: Agentic multimodal large language models (MLLMs) (e.g., OpenAI o3 and Gemini Agentic Vision) achieve remarkable reasoning capabilities through iterative visual tool invocation. However, the cascaded perception, reasoning, and tool-calling loops introduce significant sequential overhead. This overhead, termed agentic depth, incurs prohibitive latency and seriously limits system-level concurrency. To this end, we propose SpecEyes, an agentic-level speculative acceleration framework that breaks this sequential bottleneck. Our key insight is that a lightweight, tool-free MLLM can serve as a speculative planner to predict the execution trajectory, enabling early termination of expensive tool chains without sacrificing accuracy. To regulate this speculative planning, we introduce a cognitive gating mechanism based on answer separability, which quantifies the model's confidence for self-verification without requiring oracle labels. Furthermore, we design a heterogeneous parallel funnel that exploits the stateless concurrency of the small model to mask the stateful serial execution of the large model, maximizing system throughput. Extensive experiments on V* Bench, HR-Bench, and POPE demonstrate that SpecEyes achieves 1.1-3.35x speedup over the agentic baseline while preserving or even improving accuracy (up to +6.7%), thereby boosting serving throughput under concurrent workloads.
tldr: SpecEyes accelerates agentic multimodal LLMs by using a lightweight model for speculative planning and a cognitive gating mechanism, achieving significant speedups while maintaining or improving accuracy.
tldr_zh: SpecEyes 通过使用轻量级模型进行推测性规划和认知门控机制，加速了 Agentic 多模态 LLM，在保持或提高准确性的同时实现了显著的加速。
summary_zh: 具身多模态大型语言模型 (MLLMs)，例如 OpenAI o3 和 Gemini Agentic Vision，通过迭代的视觉工具调用实现了卓越的推理能力。然而，级联的感知、推理和工具调用循环引入了显著的顺序开销。这种开销，被称为具身深度，会导致过高的延迟并严重限制系统级的并发性。为此，我们提出了 SpecEyes，一种具身层面的推测加速框架，旨在打破这种顺序瓶颈。我们的核心洞察是，一个轻量级的、无工具的 MLLM 可以作为推测规划器来预测执行轨迹，从而能够在不牺牲准确性的前提下提前终止昂贵的工具链。为了调节这种推测规划，我们引入了一种基于答案可分离性的认知门控机制，该机制量化了模型在不需要先知标签的情况下进行自我验证的置信度。此外，我们设计了一种异构并行漏斗，利用小模型的无状态并发性来掩盖大型模型的有状态串行执行，从而最大化系统吞吐量。在 V* Bench、HR-Bench 和 POPE 上的大量实验表明，SpecEyes 比具身基线实现了 1.1-3.35 倍的加速，同时保持甚至提高了准确性（最高达 +6.7%），从而提高了并发工作负载下的服务吞吐量。

title: UniFunc3D: Unified Active Spatial-Temporal Grounding for 3D Functionality Segmentation
summary: Functionality segmentation in 3D scenes requires an agent to ground implicit natural-language instructions into precise masks of fine-grained interactive elements. Existing methods rely on fragmented pipelines that suffer from visual blindness during initial task parsing. We observe that these methods are limited by single-scale, passive and heuristic frame selection. We present UniFunc3D, a unified and training-free framework that treats the multimodal large language model as an active observer. By consolidating semantic, temporal, and spatial reasoning into a single forward pass, UniFunc3D performs joint reasoning to ground task decomposition in direct visual evidence. Our approach introduces active spatial-temporal grounding with a coarse-to-fine strategy. This allows the model to select correct video frames adaptively and focus on high-detail interactive parts while preserving the global context necessary for disambiguation. On SceneFun3D, UniFunc3D achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing both training-free and training-based methods by a large margin with a relative 59.9\% mIoU improvement, without any task-specific training. Code will be released on our project page: https://jiaying.link/unifunc3d.
tldr: UniFunc3D is a unified, training-free framework leveraging multimodal large language models for 3D functionality segmentation, achieving state-of-the-art performance by actively grounding language instructions into precise masks through a coarse-to-fine spatial-temporal reasoning approach.
tldr_zh: UniFunc3D是一个统一的、无需训练的框架，利用多模态大型语言模型进行3D功能分割。它通过粗到细的时空推理方法，将语言指令主动地映射到精确的掩码，从而达到state-of-the-art的性能。
summary_zh: 3D场景中的功能分割需要智能体将隐式的自然语言指令映射到精细交互元素的精确掩码。现有方法依赖于碎片化的流程，在初始任务解析期间遭受视觉缺失的困扰。我们观察到这些方法受限于单尺度、被动式和启发式的帧选择。我们提出UniFunc3D，一个统一且无需训练的框架，将多模态大型语言模型视为主动观察者。通过将语义、时间和空间推理整合到单个前向传递中，UniFunc3D执行联合推理，以将任务分解定位到直接的视觉证据中。我们的方法引入了采用由粗到精策略的主动时空定位。这使得模型能够自适应地选择正确的视频帧，并专注于高细节的交互部分，同时保留消歧所需的全局上下文。在SceneFun3D数据集上，UniFunc3D实现了最先进的性能，以相对59.9%的mIoU提升大幅超越了无需训练和基于训练的方法，且无需任何特定于任务的训练。代码将在我们的项目页面发布：https://jiaying.link/unifunc3d。

title: RealMaster: Lifting Rendered Scenes into Photorealistic Video
summary: State-of-the-art video generation models produce remarkable photorealism, but they lack the precise control required to align generated content with specific scene requirements. Furthermore, without an underlying explicit geometry, these models cannot guarantee 3D consistency. Conversely, 3D engines offer granular control over every scene element and provide native 3D consistency by design, yet their output often remains trapped in the "uncanny valley". Bridging this sim-to-real gap requires both structural precision, where the output must exactly preserve the geometry and dynamics of the input, and global semantic transformation, where materials, lighting, and textures must be holistically transformed to achieve photorealism. We present RealMaster, a method that leverages video diffusion models to lift rendered video into photorealistic video while maintaining full alignment with the output of the 3D engine. To train this model, we generate a paired dataset via an anchor-based propagation strategy, where the first and last frames are enhanced for realism and propagated across the intermediate frames using geometric conditioning cues. We then train an IC-LoRA on these paired videos to distill the high-quality outputs of the pipeline into a model that generalizes beyond the pipeline's constraints, handling objects and characters that appear mid-sequence and enabling inference without requiring anchor frames. Evaluated on complex GTA-V sequences, RealMaster significantly outperforms existing video editing baselines, improving photorealism while preserving the geometry, dynamics, and identity specified by the original 3D control.
tldr: RealMaster leverages video diffusion models with geometric conditioning to lift rendered video into photorealistic video while preserving geometry and dynamics, addressing the sim-to-real gap.
tldr_zh: RealMaster利用视频扩散模型和几何约束将渲染视频提升为照片级真实视频，同时保留几何结构和动态，以解决仿真到现实的差距。
summary_zh: 最先进的视频生成模型能够产生引人注目的照片级真实感，但缺乏精准的控制能力，使其难以将生成内容与特定的场景需求对齐。此外，在没有底层显式几何结构的情况下，这些模型无法保证3D一致性。相反，3D引擎可以对每个场景元素进行精细控制，并天然地提供3D一致性，但它们的输出往往仍停留在“恐怖谷”效应中。弥合这种从模拟到真实的差距需要结构上的精准性，即输出必须完全保留输入的几何结构和动力学特性；以及全局语义变换，即材质、光照和纹理必须被整体转换以实现照片级真实感。我们提出了RealMaster，一种利用视频扩散模型将渲染视频提升为照片级真实视频的方法，同时保持与3D引擎输出的完全对齐。为了训练该模型，我们通过基于锚点的传播策略生成配对数据集，其中首尾帧的真实感被增强，并利用几何条件提示在中间帧中进行传播。然后，我们在这些配对视频上训练一个IC-LoRA（增量控制-LoRA），以将流程的高质量输出提炼成一个能够泛化到超出流程约束的模型，处理序列中途出现的物体和角色，并实现无需锚帧的推理。在复杂的GTA-V序列上进行评估的结果表明，RealMaster显著优于现有的视频编辑基线，在提升照片级真实感的同时，保留了原始3D控制指定的几何结构、动力学特性和身份信息。

title: Unleashing Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models via Textual Representation Guided Reasoning
summary: Existing Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) struggle with 3D spatial reasoning, as they fail to construct structured abstractions of the 3D environment depicted in video inputs. To bridge this gap, drawing inspiration from cognitive theories of allocentric spatial reasoning, we investigate how to enable MLLMs to model and reason over text-based spatial representations of video. Specifically, we introduce Textual Representation of Allocentric Context from Egocentric Video (TRACE), a prompting method that induces MLLMs to generate text-based representations of 3D environments as intermediate reasoning traces for more accurate spatial question answering. TRACE encodes meta-context, camera trajectories, and detailed object entities to support structured spatial reasoning over egocentric videos. Extensive experiments on VSI-Bench and OST-Bench demonstrate that TRACE yields notable and consistent improvements over prior prompting strategies across a diverse range of MLLM backbones, spanning different parameter scales and training schemas. We further present ablation studies to validate our design choices, along with detailed analyses that probe the bottlenecks of 3D spatial reasoning in MLLMs.
tldr: The paper introduces TRACE, a prompting method that enables MLLMs to generate text-based 3D environment representations from videos, improving spatial reasoning and question answering, as demonstrated on VSI-Bench and OST-Bench.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了TRACE，这是一种提示方法，使MLLM能够从视频生成基于文本的3D环境表示，从而提高空间推理和问答能力，并在VSI-Bench和OST-Bench上得到了验证。
summary_zh: 现有的大型多模态语言模型（MLLMs）在3D空间推理方面表现不佳，因为它们无法构建视频输入中所描绘的3D环境的结构化抽象表示。为了弥合这一差距，我们从基于认知理论的以场景为中心的空间推理中汲取灵感，研究如何使MLLMs能够对基于文本的视频空间表示进行建模和推理。具体而言，我们提出了一种提示方法，即从以自我为中心的视频中生成以场景为中心的上下文文本表示 (TRACE)，它引导MLLMs生成基于文本的3D环境表示，作为中间推理过程，从而实现更准确的空间问答。TRACE编码了元上下文、相机轨迹和详细的对象实体，以支持对以自我为中心视频进行的结构化空间推理。在VSI-Bench和OST-Bench上的大量实验表明，TRACE在各种MLLM骨干网络上，跨越不同的参数规模和训练模式，均优于之前的提示策略，并取得了显著且一致的改进。我们进一步进行了消融研究来验证我们的设计选择，并进行了详细分析，以探究MLLMs中3D空间推理的瓶颈。

title: Gaze-Regularized Vision-Language-Action Models for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Despite advances in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, robotic manipulation struggles with fine-grained tasks because current models lack mechanisms for active visual attention allocation. Human gaze naturally encodes intent, planning, and execution patterns -- offering a powerful supervisory signal for guiding robot perception. We introduce a gaze-regularized training framework that aligns VLA models' internal attention with human visual patterns without architectural modifications or inference-time overhead. Our method transforms temporally aggregated gaze heatmaps into patch-level distributions and regularizes the transformer's attention through KL divergence, creating an inductive bias toward task-relevant features while preserving deployment efficiency. When integrated into existing VLA architectures, our approach yields 4-12% improvements across manipulation benchmarks. The gaze-regularized models reach equivalent performance with fewer training steps and maintain robustness under lighting variations and sensor noise. Beyond performance metrics, the learned attention patterns produce interpretable visualizations that mirror human strategies, enhancing trust in robotic systems. Moreover, our framework requires no eye-tracking equipment and applies directly to existing datasets. These results demonstrate that human perceptual priors can significantly accelerate robot learning while improving both task performance and system interpretability.
tldr: This paper introduces a gaze-regularized training framework for Vision-Language-Action models that aligns robot attention with human visual patterns, improving manipulation performance and interpretability without architectural changes or inference overhead.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于注视正则化的视觉-语言-动作模型训练框架，该框架将机器人注意力与人类视觉模式对齐，在不改变架构或增加推理开销的情况下，提高了操控性能和可解释性。
summary_zh: 尽管视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型取得了进展，但机器人操作仍然难以完成精细任务，因为当前的模型缺乏主动视觉注意力分配机制。人类的注视自然地编码了意图、规划和执行模式——为引导机器人感知提供了强大的监督信号。我们提出了一种基于注视正则化的训练框架，该框架使VLA模型的内部注意力与人类视觉模式对齐，而无需架构修改或推理时间开销。我们的方法将时间聚合的注视热图转换成patch级别的分布，并通过KL散度来正则化transformer的注意力，从而在保持部署效率的同时，创建了一种针对任务相关特征的归纳偏置。当集成到现有的VLA架构中时，我们的方法在操作基准测试中产生了4-12%的改进。基于注视正则化的模型以更少的训练步数达到同等性能，并在光照变化和传感器噪声下保持鲁棒性。除了性能指标之外，学习到的注意力模式产生了可解释的可视化结果，这些结果反映了人类的策略，从而增强了对机器人系统的信任。此外，我们的框架不需要眼动追踪设备，可以直接应用于现有数据集。这些结果表明，人类的感知先验可以显著加速机器人学习，同时提高任务性能和系统可解释性。

title: Gaze-Regularized VLMs for Ego-Centric Behavior Understanding
summary: Eye gaze, encompassing fixations and saccades, provides critical insights into human intentions and future actions. This study introduces a gaze-regularized framework that enhances Vision Language Models (VLMs) for egocentric behavior understanding. Unlike existing methods that rely solely on visual data and overlook gaze information, our approach directly incorporates gaze information into the VLM architecture during training. By generating gaze-based queries, the model dynamically focuses on gaze-highlighted regions, while a gaze-regularization mechanism ensures the alignment of model attention with human attention patterns. To better understand how gaze can be effectively integrated into VLMs, we conducted extensive experiments exploring various strategies for incorporating gaze data. These innovations enable the prediction of future events with detailed action descriptions. Experimental results demonstrate a nearly 13 % improvement in semantic scores compared to baseline models not leveraging gaze data, highlighting the effectiveness of our approach. This work establishes a foundation for leveraging the human gaze in VLMs, significantly boosting their predictive capabilities in applications requiring accurate and robust future event prediction.
tldr: This paper introduces a gaze-regularized framework that integrates eye gaze information into Vision Language Models (VLMs) for improved egocentric behavior understanding and future event prediction, achieving a 13% improvement in semantic scores.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种凝视正则化框架，该框架将眼动信息整合到视觉语言模型（VLM）中，以改进以自我为中心的行为理解和未来事件预测，并在语义分数方面提高了13%。
summary_zh: 眼动注视，包括注视点和扫视，为理解人类意图和预测未来行为提供了关键洞见。本研究引入了一种基于眼动注视正则化的框架，用于增强视觉语言模型（VLMs）在自我中心行为理解方面的性能。与仅依赖视觉数据而忽略眼动信息的现有方法不同，我们的方法在训练过程中直接将眼动信息整合到VLM架构中。通过生成基于注视点的查询，模型能够动态地聚焦于注视点突出的区域，同时，注视点正则化机制确保模型注意力与人类注意力模式的一致性。为了更好地理解如何有效地将眼动信息融入VLM，我们进行了广泛的实验，探索了多种整合眼动信息的策略。 这些创新使得模型能够预测未来事件，并且能够生成详细的动作描述。实验结果表明，与未使用眼动数据的基线模型相比，语义分数提升了近13%，突显了我们方法的有效性。这项工作为在VLM中利用人类眼动信息奠定了基础，显著提升了其在需要准确和稳健的未来事件预测的应用中的预测能力。

title: PiCo: Active Manifold Canonicalization for Robust Robotic Visual Anomaly Detection
summary: Industrial deployment of robotic visual anomaly detection (VAD) is fundamentally constrained by passive perception under diverse 6-DoF pose configurations and unstable operating conditions such as illumination changes and shadows, where intrinsic semantic anomalies and physical disturbances coexist and interact. To overcome these limitations, a paradigm shift from passive feature learning to Active Canonicalization is proposed. PiCo (Pose-in-Condition Canonicalization) is introduced as a unified framework that actively projects observations onto a condition-invariant canonical manifold. PiCo operates through a cascaded mechanism. The first stage, Active Physical Canonicalization, enables a robotic agent to reorient objects in order to reduce geometric uncertainty at its source. The second stage, Neural Latent Canonicalization, adopts a three-stage denoising hierarchy consisting of photometric processing at the input level, latent refinement at the feature level, and contextual reasoning at the semantic level, progressively eliminating nuisance factors across representational scales. Extensive evaluations on the large-scale M2AD benchmark demonstrate the superiority of this paradigm. PiCo achieves a state-of-the-art 93.7% O-AUROC, representing a 3.7% improvement over prior methods in static settings, and attains 98.5% accuracy in active closed-loop scenarios. These results demonstrate that active manifold canonicalization is critical for robust embodied perception.
tldr: The paper proposes PiCo, a novel active canonicalization framework for robust robotic visual anomaly detection, achieving state-of-the-art performance by actively reorienting objects and eliminating nuisance factors through a cascaded denoising mechanism.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出 PiCo，一种新颖的主动规范化框架，用于稳健的机器人视觉异常检测。它通过主动重新定向物体并通过级联去噪机制消除干扰因素，从而实现了最先进的性能。
summary_zh: 机器人视觉异常检测（VAD）在工业部署中受到根本制约，原因是其在多样化的6自由度姿态配置和不稳定的运行条件（如光照变化和阴影）下采用被动感知，而内在的语义异常和物理扰动共存并相互作用。为了克服这些局限性，本文提出了一种从被动特征学习到主动规范化的范式转变。PiCo（姿态-条件规范化）被引入作为一个统一的框架，它主动地将观测投影到条件不变的规范流形上。PiCo通过级联机制运行。第一阶段，主动物理规范化，使机器人代理能够重新调整物体的方向，以从源头上减少几何不确定性。第二阶段，神经潜在规范化，采用一个由三个阶段组成的去噪层次结构，包括输入层面的光度处理、特征层面的潜在提炼和语义层面的语境推理，逐步消除跨表征尺度的干扰因素。在大型M2AD基准上的广泛评估证明了这种范式的优越性。PiCo实现了93.7%的最先进O-AUROC，比静态设置下的先前方法提高了3.7%，并在主动闭环场景中达到了98.5%的准确率。这些结果表明，主动流形规范化对于鲁棒的具身感知至关重要。

title: SMSP: A Plug-and-Play Strategy of Multi-Scale Perception for MLLMs to Perceive Visual Illusions
summary: Recent works have shown that Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are highly vulnerable to hidden-pattern visual illusions, where the hidden content is imperceptible to models but obvious to humans. This deficiency highlights a perceptual misalignment between current MLLMs and humans, and also introduces potential safety concerns. To systematically investigate this failure, we introduce IlluChar, a comprehensive and challenging illusion dataset, and uncover a key underlying mechanism for the models' failure: high-frequency attention bias, where the models are easily distracted by high-frequency background textures in illusion images, causing them to overlook hidden patterns. To address the issue, we propose the Strategy of Multi-Scale Perception (SMSP), a plug-and-play framework that aligns with human visual perceptual strategies. By suppressing distracting high-frequency backgrounds, SMSP generates images closer to human perception. Our experiments demonstrate that SMSP significantly improves the performance of all evaluated MLLMs on illusion images, for instance, increasing the accuracy of Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct from 13.0% to 84.0%. Our work provides novel insights into MLLMs' visual perception, and offers a practical and robust solution to enhance it. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Tujz2023/SMSP.
tldr: The paper introduces a method (SMSP) to improve MLLMs' perception of visual illusions by addressing their high-frequency attention bias, proposing a plug-and-play framework that enhances accuracy of MLLMs on illusion datasets.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为SMSP的方法，通过解决多模态大型语言模型 (MLLM) 对高频信息的注意力偏差，来提升其对视觉错觉的感知能力。SMSP是一个即插即用的框架，可以提高 MLLM 在错觉数据集上的准确性。
summary_zh: 近期研究表明，多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）极易受到隐藏模式视觉错觉的影响，即隐藏内容对模型而言难以察觉，但对人类来说却很明显。这一缺陷凸显了当前 MLLM 与人类之间存在的感知不一致性，同时也引入了潜在的安全问题。为了系统地研究这种失败，我们引入了 IlluChar，这是一个全面且具有挑战性的错觉数据集，并揭示了模型失败的一个关键潜在机制：高频注意力偏差，即模型容易被错觉图像中的高频背景纹理分散注意力，从而忽略隐藏的模式。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了多尺度感知策略（SMSP），这是一个与人类视觉感知策略对齐的即插即用框架。通过抑制分散注意力的高频背景，SMSP 生成的图像更接近人类感知。我们的实验表明，SMSP 显著提高了所有被评估的 MLLM 在错觉图像上的性能，例如，将 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 的准确率从 13.0% 提高到 84.0%。我们的工作为 MLLM 的视觉感知提供了新的见解，并提供了一种实用且稳健的解决方案来增强这种感知。我们的代码已在 https://github.com/Tujz2023/SMSP 上公开。

title: Cog3DMap: Multi-View Vision-Language Reasoning with 3D Cognitive Maps
summary: Precise spatial understanding from multi-view images remains a fundamental challenge for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), as their visual representations are predominantly semantic and lack explicit geometric grounding. While existing approaches augment visual tokens with geometric cues from visual geometry models, their MLLM is still required to implicitly infer the underlying 3D structure of the scene from these augmented tokens, limiting its spatial reasoning capability. To address this issue, we introduce Cog3DMap, a framework that recurrently constructs an explicit 3D memory from multi-view images, where each token is grounded in 3D space and possesses both semantic and geometric information. By feeding these tokens into the MLLM, our framework enables direct reasoning over a spatially structured 3D map, achieving state-of-the-art performance on various spatial reasoning benchmarks. Code will be made publicly available.
tldr: Cog3DMap introduces a framework for MLLMs that builds an explicit 3D memory from multi-view images, grounding tokens in 3D space with semantic and geometric information to improve spatial reasoning.
tldr_zh: Cog3DMap 提出了一种 MLLM 框架，该框架从多视图图像构建显式的 3D 记忆，将 tokens 定位在具有语义和几何信息的 3D 空间中，以提高空间推理能力。
summary_zh: 从多视角图像中进行精确的空间理解仍然是多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）面临的一项根本挑战，因为它们的视觉表征主要集中在语义层面，缺乏明确的几何基础。虽然现有方法通过视觉几何模型的几何线索来增强视觉tokens，但仍然需要MLLM从这些增强的tokens中隐式地推断场景的潜在3D结构，这限制了其空间推理能力。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了Cog3DMap，一个从多视角图像中递归构建显式3D记忆的框架。在该框架中，每个token都与3D空间相关联，并具备语义和几何信息。通过将这些tokens输入到MLLM中，我们的框架能够直接对空间结构化的3D地图进行推理，从而在各种空间推理基准测试中实现最先进的性能。代码将会公开发布。

title: WorldMesh: Generating Navigable Multi-Room 3D Scenes via Mesh-Conditioned Image Diffusion
summary: Recent progress in image and video synthesis has inspired their use in advancing 3D scene generation. However, we observe that text-to-image and -video approaches struggle to maintain scene- and object-level consistency beyond a limited environment scale due to the absence of explicit geometry. We thus present a geometry-first approach that decouples this complex problem of large-scale 3D scene synthesis into its structural composition, represented as a mesh scaffold, and realistic appearance synthesis, which leverages powerful image synthesis models conditioned on the mesh scaffold. From an input text description, we first construct a mesh capturing the environment's geometry (walls, floors, etc.), and then use image synthesis, segmentation and object reconstruction to populate the mesh structure with objects in realistic layouts. This mesh scaffold is then rendered to condition image synthesis, providing a structural backbone for consistent appearance generation. This enables scalable, arbitrarily-sized 3D scenes of high object richness and diversity, combining robust 3D consistency with photorealistic detail. We believe this marks a significant step toward generating truly environment-scale, immersive 3D worlds.
tldr: The paper introduces "WorldMesh," a geometry-aware approach for generating consistent and scalable 3D scenes by using a mesh scaffold to guide image diffusion models.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了"WorldMesh"，一种几何感知的方法，通过使用网格骨架引导图像扩散模型，来生成一致且可扩展的3D场景。
summary_zh: 图像和视频合成领域的最新进展激发了它们在推动3D场景生成方面的应用。然而，我们观察到，由于缺乏显式的几何信息，文本到图像和文本到视频的方法难以在有限的环境尺度之外维持场景和对象级别的连贯性。因此，我们提出了一种几何优先的方法，将大规模3D场景合成这一复杂问题解耦为结构组合（表示为网格骨架）和逼真外观合成，后者利用了以网格骨架为条件的强大图像合成模型。从输入的文本描述中，我们首先构建一个网格，捕捉环境的几何结构（墙壁、地板等），然后利用图像合成、分割和对象重建，以逼真的布局将对象填充到网格结构中。该网格骨架随后会被渲染，作为图像合成的条件，为连贯的外观生成提供结构性的主干。这使得能够生成可扩展的、任意尺寸的、具有高度对象丰富性和多样性的3D场景，将强大的3D一致性与照片般真实的细节相结合。我们相信这标志着在生成真正环境尺度的、沉浸式3D世界方面迈出了重要一步。

title: SLARM: Streaming and Language-Aligned Reconstruction Model for Dynamic Scenes
summary: We propose SLARM, a feed-forward model that unifies dynamic scene reconstruction, semantic understanding, and real-time streaming inference. SLARM captures complex, non-uniform motion through higher-order motion modeling, trained solely on differentiable renderings without any flow supervision. Besides, SLARM distills semantic features from LSeg to obtain language-aligned representations. This design enables semantic querying via natural language, and the tight coupling between semantics and geometry further enhances the accuracy and robustness of dynamic reconstruction. Moreover, SLARM processes image sequences using window-based causal attention, achieving stable, low-latency streaming inference without accumulating memory cost. Within this unified framework, SLARM achieves state-of-the-art results in dynamic estimation, rendering quality, and scene parsing, improving motion accuracy by 21%, reconstruction PSNR by 1.6 dB, and segmentation mIoU by 20% over existing methods.
tldr: SLARM is a feed-forward model for dynamic scene reconstruction that unifies semantic understanding and real-time streaming inference, achieving state-of-the-art results without flow supervision and enabling language-based semantic querying.
tldr_zh: SLARM是一个用于动态场景重建的前馈模型，它统一了语义理解和实时流式推理，无需光流监督即可实现最先进的结果，并支持基于语言的语义查询。
summary_zh: 我们提出了 SLARM，一种前馈模型，它统一了动态场景重建、语义理解和实时流式推理。SLARM 通过高阶运动建模捕捉复杂的、非均匀的运动，仅使用可微分渲染进行训练，无需任何光流监督。此外，SLARM 从 LSeg 提炼语义特征以获得与语言对齐的表示。这种设计使得可以通过自然语言进行语义查询，并且语义和几何之间的紧密耦合进一步增强了动态重建的准确性和鲁棒性。此外，SLARM 使用基于窗口的因果注意力处理图像序列，实现了稳定、低延迟的流式推理，而不会累积内存成本。在这个统一的框架内，SLARM 在动态估计、渲染质量和场景解析方面都取得了最先进的结果，相较于现有方法，运动精度提高了 21%，重建 PSNR 提高了 1.6 dB，分割 mIoU 提高了 20%。

title: Know3D: Prompting 3D Generation with Knowledge from Vision-Language Models
summary: Recent advances in 3D generation have improved the fidelity and geometric details of synthesized 3D assets. However, due to the inherent ambiguity of single-view observations and the lack of robust global structural priors caused by limited 3D training data, the unseen regions generated by existing models are often stochastic and difficult to control, which may sometimes fail to align with user intentions or produce implausible geometries. In this paper, we propose Know3D, a novel framework that incorporates rich knowledge from multimodal large language models into 3D generative processes via latent hidden-state injection, enabling language-controllable generation of the back-view for 3D assets. We utilize a VLM-diffusion-based model, where the VLM is responsible for semantic understanding and guidance. The diffusion model acts as a bridge that transfers semantic knowledge from the VLM to the 3D generation model. In this way, we successfully bridge the gap between abstract textual instructions and the geometric reconstruction of unobserved regions, transforming the traditionally stochastic back-view hallucination into a semantically controllable process, demonstrating a promising direction for future 3D generation models.
tldr: Know3D uses a VLM-diffusion model to inject knowledge from vision-language models into 3D generation, enabling language-controllable back-view generation to address the limited control and stochasticity issues in existing models.
tldr_zh: Know3D利用视觉语言模型-扩散模型，将视觉语言模型的知识注入到3D生成中，从而实现语言可控的后视生成，解决了现有模型控制有限和随机性问题。
summary_zh: 3D生成技术的最新进展提高了合成3D资产的逼真度和几何细节。然而，由于单视角观测固有的二义性以及有限的3D训练数据导致的缺乏鲁棒的全局结构先验，现有模型生成的未见区域通常是随机的且难以控制，这有时可能无法与用户意图对齐或产生不合理的几何形状。本文提出Know3D，一种新颖的框架，通过潜在隐状态注入将来自多模态大型语言模型的丰富知识融入3D生成过程，从而实现3D资产后视角的语言可控生成。我们采用基于VLM-扩散的模型，其中VLM负责语义理解和引导。扩散模型充当桥梁，将来自VLM的语义知识传递到3D生成模型。通过这种方式，我们成功地弥合了抽象文本指令与未观测区域的几何重建之间的差距，将传统上随机的后视角幻觉转换为语义可控的过程，为未来的3D生成模型展示了一个有希望的方向。

title: ENC-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal Large Language Models in Electronic Navigational Chart Understanding
summary: Electronic Navigational Charts (ENCs) are the safety-critical backbone of modern maritime navigation, yet it remains unclear whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can reliably interpret them. Unlike natural images or conventional charts, ENCs encode regulations, bathymetry, and route constraints via standardized vector symbols, scale-dependent rendering, and precise geometric structure -- requiring specialized maritime expertise for interpretation. We introduce ENC-Bench, the first benchmark dedicated to professional ENC understanding. ENC-Bench contains 20,490 expert-validated samples from 840 authentic National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) ENCs, organized into a three-level hierarchy: Perception (symbol and feature recognition), Spatial Reasoning (coordinate localization, bearing, distance), and Maritime Decision-Making (route legality, safety assessment, emergency planning under multiple constraints). All samples are generated from raw S-57 data through a calibrated vector-to-image pipeline with automated consistency checks and expert review. We evaluate 10 state-of-the-art MLLMs such as GPT-4o, Gemini 2.5, Qwen3-VL, InternVL-3, and GLM-4.5V, under a unified zero-shot protocol. The best model achieves only 47.88% accuracy, with systematic challenges in symbolic grounding, spatial computation, multi-constraint reasoning, and robustness to lighting and scale variations. By establishing the first rigorous ENC benchmark, we open a new research frontier at the intersection of specialized symbolic reasoning and safety-critical AI, providing essential infrastructure for advancing MLLMs toward professional maritime applications.
tldr: The paper introduces ENC-Bench, a new benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on Electronic Navigational Chart understanding, revealing limitations of state-of-the-art models in this safety-critical domain.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ENC-Bench，这是一个新的基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型在电子海图理解方面的能力，揭示了现有模型在这个安全关键领域的局限性。
summary_zh: 电子航海图（ENCs）是现代航海的关键安全支柱，然而，多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）能否可靠地解读它们仍不清楚。与自然图像或传统海图不同，ENCs通过标准化的矢量符号、比例尺相关的渲染以及精确的几何结构来编码法规、测深信息和航线约束——这需要专业的航海知识才能进行解读。我们推出了ENC-Bench，这是首个专门用于专业ENC理解的基准。 ENC-Bench包含来自美国国家海洋和大气管理局（NOAA）840幅真实ENC的20,490个经过专家验证的样本，并组织成一个三级层次结构：感知（符号和要素识别）、空间推理（坐标定位、方位、距离）和航海决策（航线合法性、安全评估、多重约束下的应急计划）。所有样本均通过校准的矢量到图像的管道从原始S-57数据生成，并进行了自动一致性检查和专家评审。我们评估了10个最先进的MLLM，例如GPT-4o、Gemini 2.5、Qwen3-VL、InternVL-3和GLM-4.5V，采用统一的零样本协议。 最佳模型的准确率仅为47.88％，在符号基础、空间计算、多重约束推理以及对光照和比例变化的鲁棒性方面存在系统性挑战。 通过建立首个严格的ENC基准，我们开启了一个新的研究前沿，它位于专业符号推理和安全关键型AI的交叉点，为推动MLLM走向专业航海应用提供了必要的基础设施。

title: CanViT: Toward Active-Vision Foundation Models
summary: Active computer vision promises efficient, biologically plausible perception through sequential, localized glimpses, but lacks scalable general-purpose architectures and pretraining pipelines. As a result, Active-Vision Foundation Models (AVFMs) have remained unexplored. We introduce CanViT, the first task- and policy-agnostic AVFM. CanViT uses scene-relative RoPE to bind a retinotopic Vision Transformer backbone and a spatiotopic scene-wide latent workspace, the canvas. Efficient interaction with this high-capacity working memory is supported by Canvas Attention, a novel asymmetric cross-attention mechanism. We decouple thinking (backbone-level) and memory (canvas-level), eliminating canvas-side self-attention and fully-connected layers to achieve low-latency sequential inference and scalability to large scenes. We propose a label-free active vision pretraining scheme, policy-agnostic passive-to-active dense latent distillation: reconstructing scene-wide DINOv3 embeddings from sequences of low-resolution glimpses with randomized locations, zoom levels, and lengths. We pretrain CanViT-B from a random initialization on 13.2 million ImageNet-21k scenes -- an order of magnitude more than previous active models -- and 1 billion random glimpses, in 166 hours on a single H100. On ADE20K segmentation, a frozen CanViT-B achieves 38.5% mIoU in a single low-resolution glimpse, outperforming the best active model's 27.6% with 19.5x fewer inference FLOPs and no fine-tuning, as well as its FLOP- or input-matched DINOv3 teacher. Given additional glimpses, CanViT-B reaches 45.9% ADE20K mIoU. On ImageNet-1k classification, CanViT-B reaches 81.2% top-1 accuracy with frozen teacher probes. CanViT generalizes to longer rollouts, larger scenes, and new policies. Our work closes the wide gap between passive and active vision on semantic segmentation and demonstrates the potential of AVFMs as a new research axis.
tldr: The paper introduces CanViT, a novel Active-Vision Foundation Model (AVFM) pre-trained on large-scale data, demonstrating significant performance improvements in semantic segmentation with fewer FLOPs compared to existing active vision models and DINOv3. It also shows good results in ImageNet classification.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了CanViT，一种新型的主动视觉基础模型（AVFM），在大规模数据集上进行了预训练，在语义分割方面表现出显著的性能提升，与现有的主动视觉模型和DINOv3相比，FLOPs更少。它在ImageNet分类方面也表现出良好的结果。
summary_zh: 主动

title: Polaris: A Gödel Agent Framework for Small Language Models through Experience-Abstracted Policy Repair
summary: Gödel agent realize recursive self-improvement: an agent inspects its own policy and traces and then modifies that policy in a tested loop. We introduce Polaris, a Gödel agent for compact models that performs policy repair via experience abstraction, turning failures into policy updates through a structured cycle of analysis, strategy formation, abstraction, and minimal code pat ch repair with conservative checks. Unlike response level self correction or parameter tuning, Polaris makes policy level changes with small, auditable patches that persist in the policy and are reused on unseen instances within each benchmark. As part of the loop, the agent engages in meta reasoning: it explains its errors, proposes concrete revisions to its own policy, and then updates the policy. To enable cumulative policy refinement, we introduce experience abstraction, which distills failures into compact, reusable strategies that transfer to unseen instances. On MGSM, DROP, GPQA, and LitBench (covering arithmetic reasoning, compositional inference, graduate-level problem solving, and creative writing evaluation), a 7-billion-parameter model equipped with Polaris achieves consistent gains over the base policy and competitive baselines.
tldr: The paper introduces Polaris, a Gödel agent framework for small language models that allows them to recursively self-improve by identifying and repairing policy-level errors through experience abstraction. They demonstrate improvements on various reasoning and writing benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个名为Polaris的Gödel智能体框架，用于小型语言模型，它允许模型通过经验抽象识别和修复策略层面的错误，从而实现递归的自我改进。他们在各种推理和写作基准测试中展示了改进。
summary_zh: 哥德尔智能体实现了递归式自我改进：智能体检查自身的策略和轨迹，然后在经过测试的循环中修改该策略。 我们引入Polaris，一种用于紧凑模型的哥德尔智能体，它通过经验抽象执行策略修复，通过结构化的分析、策略制定、抽象和最小代码补丁修复的循环，将失败转化为策略更新，并进行保守性检查。 与响应层面的自我纠正或参数调整不同，Polaris进行策略层面的更改，这些更改通过小的、可审核的补丁持久存在于策略中，并在每个基准测试中未经修改的实例上重复使用。 作为循环的一部分，智能体进行元推理：它解释自己的错误，提出对其自身策略的具体的修改意见，然后更新该策略。 为了实现累积策略改进，我们引入了经验抽象，它将失败提炼成紧凑、可重用的策略，并迁移到未见实例。 在MGSM、DROP、GPQA 和 LitBench（涵盖算术推理、组合推理、研究生水平的问题解决以及创意写作评估）上，配备 Polaris 的 70 亿参数模型在基本策略和竞争性基线上均实现了持续的增益。

title: VLGOR: Visual-Language Knowledge Guided Offline Reinforcement Learning for Generalizable Agents
summary: Combining Large Language Models (LLMs) with Reinforcement Learning (RL) enables agents to interpret language instructions more effectively for task execution. However, LLMs typically lack direct perception of the physical environment, which limits their understanding of environmental dynamics and their ability to generalize to unseen tasks. To address this limitation, we propose Visual-Language Knowledge-Guided Offline Reinforcement Learning (VLGOR), a framework that integrates visual and language knowledge to generate imaginary rollouts, thereby enriching the interaction data. The core premise of VLGOR is to fine-tune a vision-language model to predict future states and actions conditioned on an initial visual observation and high-level instructions, ensuring that the generated rollouts remain temporally coherent and spatially plausible. Furthermore, we employ counterfactual prompts to produce more diverse rollouts for offline RL training, enabling the agent to acquire knowledge that facilitates following language instructions while grounding in environments based on visual cues. Experiments on robotic manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that VLGOR significantly improves performance on unseen tasks requiring novel optimal policies, achieving a success rate over 24% higher than the baseline methods.
tldr: VLGOR uses a vision-language model to generate imaginary rollouts guided by visual and language knowledge for offline RL, improving generalization on robotic manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: VLGOR使用视觉语言模型，通过视觉和语言知识引导生成虚拟轨迹用于离线强化学习，从而提高在机器人操作任务上的泛化能力。
summary_zh: 将大型语言模型(LLM)与强化学习(RL)相结合，能够使智能体更有效地解释语言指令，以执行任务。然而，LLM通常缺乏对物理环境的直接感知，这限制了它们对环境动态的理解以及对未见任务的泛化能力。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了一种视觉-语言知识引导的离线强化学习框架(VLGOR)，该框架整合了视觉和语言知识以生成假想的轨迹数据，从而丰富交互数据。VLGOR的核心前提是微调一个视觉-语言模型，使其能够根据初始视觉观察和高层指令预测未来状态和动作，确保生成的轨迹数据在时间上保持连贯性，在空间上保持合理性。此外，我们采用反事实提示来生成更多样化的轨迹数据，用于离线RL训练，使智能体能够获取有助于遵循语言指令的知识，同时根据视觉线索将知识扎根于环境中。在机器人操作基准测试上的实验表明，VLGOR显著提高了对需要新型最优策略的未见任务的性能，成功率比基线方法高出24%以上。

title: Non-Adversarial Imitation Learning Provably Free of Compounding Errors: The Role of Bellman Constraints
summary: Adversarial imitation learning (AIL) achieves high-quality imitation by mitigating compounding errors in behavioral cloning (BC), but often exhibits training instability due to adversarial optimization. To avoid this issue, a class of non-adversarial Q-based imitation learning (IL) methods, represented by IQ-Learn, has emerged and is widely believed to outperform BC by leveraging online environment interactions. However, this paper revisits IQ-Learn and demonstrates that it provably reduces to BC and suffers from an imitation gap lower bound with quadratic dependence on horizon, therefore still suffering from compounding errors. Theoretical analysis reveals that, despite using online interactions, IQ-Learn uniformly suppresses the Q-values for all actions on states uncovered by demonstrations, thereby failing to generalize. To address this limitation, we introduce a primal-dual framework for distribution matching, yielding a new Q-based IL method, Dual Q-DM. The key mechanism in Dual Q-DM is incorporating Bellman constraints to propagate high Q-values from visited states to unvisited ones, thereby achieving generalization beyond demonstrations. We prove that Dual Q-DM is equivalent to AIL and can recover expert actions beyond demonstrations, thereby mitigating compounding errors. To the best of our knowledge, Dual Q-DM is the first non-adversarial IL method that is theoretically guaranteed to eliminate compounding errors. Experimental results further corroborate our theoretical results.
tldr: This paper identifies limitations in IQ-Learn, a non-adversarial imitation learning method, and introduces Dual Q-DM, a new Q-based IL method incorporating Bellman constraints to provably eliminate compounding errors, achieving performance comparable to AIL without adversarial training instability.
tldr_zh: 本文指出了非对抗模仿学习方法IQ-Learn的局限性，并引入了Dual Q-DM，这是一种新的基于Q的IL方法，它结合了贝尔曼约束，可以证明可以消除复合误差，并在没有对抗训练不稳定性的情况下实现与AIL相当的性能。
summary_zh: 对抗模仿学习 (AIL) 通过缓解行为克隆 (BC) 中的累积误差来实现高质量的模仿，但由于对抗优化，常常表现出训练不稳定性。为了避免这个问题，一类非对抗的基于 Q 值的模仿学习 (IL) 方法，以 IQ-Learn 为代表，已经出现并被广泛认为通过利用在线环境交互优于 BC。然而，本文重新审视了 IQ-Learn，并证明它在理论上会退化为 BC，并且遭受与时间跨度呈二次方关系的模仿差距下界，因此仍然受到累积误差的影响。理论分析表明，尽管使用在线交互，IQ-Learn 一致地抑制了演示数据未覆盖的状态上所有动作的 Q 值，因而未能泛化。为了解决这个局限性，我们引入了一个用于分布匹配的原始-对偶框架，从而产生了一种新的基于 Q 值的 IL 方法，Dual Q-DM。 Dual Q-DM 的关键机制是结合贝尔曼约束，将高 Q 值从已访问状态传播到未访问状态，从而实现超越演示数据的泛化。我们证明 Dual Q-DM 等价于 AIL，并且可以恢复演示数据之外的专家动作，从而缓解累积误差。据我们所知，Dual Q-DM 是第一个在理论上保证消除累积误差的非对抗 IL 方法。实验结果进一步证实了我们的理论结果。

title: Model Predictive Control with Differentiable World Models for Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline Reinforcement Learning (RL) aims to learn optimal policies from fixed offline datasets, without further interactions with the environment. Such methods train an offline policy (or value function), and apply it at inference time without further refinement. We introduce an inference time adaptation framework inspired by model predictive control (MPC) that utilizes a pretrained policy along with a learned world model of state transitions and rewards. While existing world model and diffusion-planning methods use learned dynamics to generate imagined trajectories during training, or to sample candidate plans at inference time, they do not use inference-time information to optimize the policy parameters on the fly. In contrast, our design is a Differentiable World Model (DWM) pipeline that enables endto-end gradient computation through imagined rollouts for policy optimization at inference time based on MPC. We evaluate our algorithm on D4RL continuous-control benchmarks (MuJoCo locomotion tasks and AntMaze), and show that exploiting inference-time information to optimize the policy parameters yields consistent gains over strong offline RL baselines.
tldr: This paper introduces a Differentiable World Model (DWM) pipeline for offline RL that uses model predictive control with differentiable world models to optimize policy parameters at inference time, demonstrating improvements over existing offline RL baselines on D4RL benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于离线RL的可微世界模型（DWM）管道，该管道使用模型预测控制与可微世界模型在推理时优化策略参数，并在D4RL基准测试中展示了优于现有离线RL基线的表现。
summary_zh: 离线强化学习 (RL) 旨在从固定的离线数据集中学习最优策略，无需与环境进行进一步交互。此类方法训练一种离线策略（或价值函数），并在推理时应用该策略，而无需进一步优化。我们介绍了一种受模型预测控制 (MPC) 启发的推理时自适应框架，该框架利用预训练策略以及学习到的状态转移和奖励的世界模型。虽然现有的世界模型和扩散规划方法使用学习到的动态模型在训练期间生成想象轨迹，或者在推理时采样候选计划，但它们不使用推理时信息来动态优化策略参数。相比之下，我们的设计是一种可微分世界模型 (DWM) 流程，它能够通过基于 MPC 的想象展开进行端到端的梯度计算，以便在推理时进行策略优化。我们在 D4RL 连续控制基准（MuJoCo 运动任务和 AntMaze）上评估了我们的算法，结果表明，利用推理时信息来优化策略参数相比于强大的离线 RL 基线，能够产生持续的收益。

title: PHANTOM Hand
summary:
Tendon-driven underactuated hands excel in adaptive grasping but often suffer from kinematic unpredictability and highly non-linear force transmission. This ambiguity limits their ability to perform precise free-motion shaping and deliver reliable payloads for complex manipulation tasks. To address this, we introduce the PHANTOM Hand (Hybrid Precision-Augmented Compliance): a modular, 1:1 human-scale system featuring 6 actuators and 15 degrees of freedom (DoFs).
  We propose a unified framework that bridges the gap between precise analytic shaping and robust compliant grasping. By deriving a sparse mapping from physical geometry and integrating a mechanics-based compensation model, we effectively suppress kinematic drift caused by spring counter-tension and tendon elasticity. This approach achieves sub-degree kinematic reproducibility for free-motion planning while retaining the inherent mechanical compliance required for stable physical interaction.
  Experimental validation confirms the system's capabilities through (1) kinematic analysis verifying sub-degree global accuracy across the workspace; (2) static expressibility tests demonstrating complex hand gestures; (3) diverse grasping experiments covering power, precision, and tool-use categories; and (4) quantitative fingertip force characterization. The results demonstrate that the PHANTOM hand successfully combines analytic kinematic precision with continuous, predictable force output, significantly expanding the payload and dexterity of underactuated hands. To drive the development of the underactuated manipulation ecosystem, all hardware designs and control scripts are fully open-sourced for community engagement.
tldr: The paper introduces the PHANTOM Hand, a novel tendon-driven underactuated hand that combines precise analytic shaping with robust compliant grasping, achieving sub-degree kinematic reproducibility and expanding payload capacity, with open-sourced hardware designs and control scripts.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种新型肌腱驱动的欠驱动手PHANTOM Hand，它结合了精确的解析成形和鲁棒的顺应性抓取，实现了亚度级的运动学重现性并扩展了有效载荷能力，并开源了硬件设计和控制脚本。
summary_zh:
肌腱驱动的欠驱动手在自适应抓取方面表现出色，但通常面临运动学不可预测性和高度非线性力传递的问题。这种模糊性限制了它们执行精确自由运动成形并提供复杂操作任务所需的可靠载荷能力。为解决此问题，我们引入了PHANTOM手（混合精度增强顺应性）：一种模块化、1:1真人尺寸的系统，具有6个驱动器和15个自由度（DoFs）。

  我们提出了一种统一框架，弥合了精确解析成形和稳健顺应抓取之间的差距。通过推导物理几何体的稀疏映射并集成基于力学的补偿模型，我们有效地抑制了由弹簧反张力和肌腱弹性引起的运动学漂移。这种方法在保持稳定物理交互所需固有机械顺应性的同时，实现了自由运动规划的亚度级运动学可重复性。

  实验验证通过以下方式证实了系统的能力：（1）运动学分析验证了整个工作空间内的亚度级全局精度；（2）静态表现力测试展示了复杂的手势；（3）涵盖力量抓取、精细抓取和工具使用类别的多样化抓取实验；以及（4）定量指尖力特性分析。结果表明，PHANTOM手成功地将解析运动学精度与连续、可预测的力输出相结合，显著扩展了欠驱动手的载荷能力和灵巧性。为了推动欠驱动操作生态系统的发展，所有硬件设计和控制脚本都完全开源，以供社区参与。

title: Active Robotic Perception for Disease Detection and Mapping in Apple Trees
summary: Large-scale orchard production requires timely and precise disease monitoring, yet routine manual scouting is labor-intensive and financially impractical at the scale of modern operations. As a result, disease outbreaks are often detected late and tracked at coarse spatial resolutions, typically at the orchard-block level. We present an autonomous mobile active perception system for targeted disease detection and mapping in dormant apple trees, demonstrated on one of the most devastating diseases affecting apple today -- fire blight. The system integrates flash-illuminated stereo RGB sensing, real-time depth estimation, instance-level segmentation, and confidence-aware semantic 3D mapping to achieve precise localization of disease symptoms. Semantic predictions are fused into the volumetric occupancy map representation enabling the tracking of both occupancy and per-voxel semantic confidence, building actionable spatial maps for growers. To actively refine observations within complex canopies, we evaluate three viewpoint planning strategies within a unified perception-action loop: a deterministic geometric baseline, a volumetric next-best-view planner that maximizes unknown-space reduction, and a semantic next-best-view planner that prioritizes low-confidence symptomatic regions. Experiments on a fabricated lab tree and five simulated symptomatic trees demonstrate reliable symptom localization and mapping as a precursor to a field evaluation. In simulation, the semantic planner achieves the highest F1 score (0.6106) after 30 viewpoints, while the volumetric planner achieves the highest ROI coverage (85.82\%). In the lab setting, the semantic planner attains the highest final F1 (0.9058), with both next-best-view planners substantially improving coverage over the baseline.
tldr: This paper presents an autonomous robotic system for detecting and mapping disease symptoms in apple trees using active perception with semantic and volumetric next-best-view planning, demonstrating promising results in both lab and simulated environments.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种自主机器人系统，用于检测和绘制苹果树中的疾病症状，该系统采用主动感知，结合语义和体积的下一最佳视角规划，并在实验室和模拟环境中展示了有希望的结果。
summary_zh: 大规模果园生产需要及时、精确的病害监测，然而，常规的人工侦察耗费大量劳力，并且在现代果园的规模下经济上不切实际。因此，病害爆发往往被延迟发现，并且以粗略的空间分辨率进行跟踪，通常仅限于果园区块级别。我们提出了一种自主移动主动感知系统，用于休眠期苹果树中目标病害的检测和绘图，并在影响苹果最严重的病害之一——火疫病上进行了演示。该系统集成了闪光照明立体RGB传感、实时深度估计、实例级分割和置信度感知语义3D映射，以实现病害症状的精确定位。语义预测被融合到体素占用地图表示中，从而能够跟踪占用情况和每个体素的语义置信度，为种植者构建可操作的空间地图。为了主动优化复杂树冠中的观察结果，我们在统一的感知-行动循环中评估了三种视点规划策略：一种确定性的几何基线，一种最大化未知空间减少的体素下一最佳视点规划器，以及一种优先考虑低置信度症状区域的语义下一最佳视点规划器。在制造的实验室树和五个模拟的症状树上的实验证明了可靠的症状定位和绘图，这是田间评估的前奏。在模拟中，语义规划器在30个视点后实现了最高的F1分数（0.6106），而体素规划器实现了最高的ROI覆盖率（85.82%）。在实验室环境中，语义规划器获得了最高的最终F1（0.9058），并且两种下一最佳视点规划器都显著提高了对基线的覆盖率。

title: AirSimAG: A High-Fidelity Simulation Platform for Air-Ground Collaborative Robotics
summary: As spatial intelligence continues to evolve, heterogeneous multi-agent systems-particularly the collaboration between Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) and Unmanned Ground Vehicles (UGVs), have demonstrated strong potential in complex applications such as search and rescue, urban surveillance, and environmental monitoring. However, existing simulation platforms are primarily designed for single-agent dynamics and lack dedicated frameworks for interactive air-ground collaborative simulation. In this paper, we present AirsimAG, a high-fidelity air-ground collaborative simulation platform built upon an extensively customized AirSim framework. The platform enables synchronized multi-agent simulation and supports heterogeneous sensing and control interfaces for UAV-UGV systems. To demonstrate its capabilities, we design a set of representative air-ground collaborative tasks, including mapping, planning, tracking, formation, and exploration. We further provide quantitative analyses based on these tasks to illustrate the platform effectiveness in supporting multi-agent coordination and cross-modal data consistency. The AirsimAG simulation platform is publicly available at https://github.com/BIULab-BUAA/AirSimAG.
tldr: The paper introduces AirSimAG, a high-fidelity simulation platform built on AirSim for air-ground collaborative robotics, supporting synchronized multi-agent simulation and heterogeneous sensing, and validated with tasks like mapping and exploration.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个名为AirSimAG的高保真仿真平台，该平台基于AirSim构建，用于空地协同机器人，支持同步多智能体仿真和异构传感，并通过地图绘制和探索等任务进行了验证。
summary_zh: 随着空间智能的不断发展，异构多智能体系统——特别是无人机（UAV）和无人地面车辆（UGV）之间的协作，在诸如搜索与救援、城市监控和环境监测等复杂应用中展现出巨大的潜力。然而，现有的仿真平台主要为单智能体动力学设计，缺乏专门用于交互式空地协同仿真的框架。在本文中，我们提出了AirsimAG，这是一个基于广泛定制的AirSim框架构建的高保真空地协同仿真平台。该平台支持同步多智能体仿真，并为UAV-UGV系统提供异构传感和控制接口。为了展示其功能，我们设计了一系列代表性的空地协同任务，包括地图绘制、规划、跟踪、编队和探索。我们进一步基于这些任务提供了定量分析，以说明平台在支持多智能体协调和跨模态数据一致性方面的有效性。AirsimAG仿真平台可在https://github.com/BIULab-BUAA/AirSimAG上公开获取。

title: Tightly-Coupled Radar-Visual-Inertial Odometry
summary: Visual-Inertial Odometry (VIO) is a staple for reliable state estimation on constrained and lightweight platforms due to its versatility and demonstrated performance. However, pertinent challenges regarding robust operation in dark, low-texture, obscured environments complicate the use of such methods. Alternatively, Frequency Modulated Continuous Wave (FMCW) radars, and by extension Radar-Inertial Odometry (RIO), offer robustness to these visual challenges, albeit at the cost of reduced information density and worse long-term accuracy. To address these limitations, this work combines the two in a tightly coupled manner, enabling the resulting method to operate robustly regardless of environmental conditions or trajectory dynamics. The proposed method fuses image features, radar Doppler measurements, and Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) measurements within an Iterated Extended Kalman Filter (IEKF) in real-time, with radar range data augmenting the visual feature depth initialization. The method is evaluated through flight experiments conducted in both indoor and outdoor environments, as well as through challenges to both exteroceptive modalities (such as darkness, fog, or fast flight), thoroughly demonstrating its robustness. The implementation of the proposed method is available at: https://github.com/ntnu-arl/radvio
tldr: This paper presents a tightly-coupled radar-visual-inertial odometry (RadVIO) system that fuses image features, radar Doppler measurements, and IMU data within an IEKF, showing robustness in challenging environments where vision-only or radar-only systems fail.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种紧耦合的雷达-视觉-惯性里程计 (RadVIO) 系统，该系统在 IEKF 中融合了图像特征、雷达多普勒测量和 IMU 数据，在视觉或雷达系统失效的挑战性环境中表现出鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 视觉惯性里程计 (VIO) 因其多功能性和已证实的性能，已成为约束性或轻量级平台上可靠状态估计的主要方法。然而，在黑暗、低纹理、遮挡环境中稳健运行的有关挑战使得此类方法的使用变得复杂。另一种选择是调频连续波 (FMCW) 雷达，及其扩展的雷达惯性里程计 (RIO)，它能够应对上述视觉挑战，但代价是信息密度降低且长期精度较差。为了解决这些局限性，本工作将两者以紧耦合方式结合起来，使生成的方法能够稳健地运行，而不管环境条件或轨迹动态如何。所提出的方法在迭代扩展卡尔曼滤波器 (IEKF) 中实时融合图像特征、雷达多普勒测量和惯性测量单元 (IMU) 测量，雷达距离数据用于增强视觉特征的深度初始化。该方法通过在室内和室外环境中进行的飞行实验进行评估，并针对两种外部感知模态（例如黑暗、雾或快速飞行）的挑战进行评估，充分证明了其稳健性。所提出方法的实现在以下地址可用：https://github.com/ntnu-arl/radvio

title: Learning Actuator-Aware Spectral Submanifolds for Precise Control of Continuum Robots
summary: Continuum robots exhibit high-dimensional, nonlinear dynamics which are often coupled with their actuation mechanism. Spectral submanifold (SSM) reduction has emerged as a leading method for reducing high-dimensional nonlinear dynamical systems to low-dimensional invariant manifolds. Our proposed control-augmented SSMs (caSSMs) extend this methodology by explicitly incorporating control inputs into the state representation, enabling these models to capture nonlinear state-input couplings. Training these models relies solely on controlled decay trajectories of the actuator-augmented state, thereby removing the additional actuation-calibration step commonly needed by prior SSM-for-control methods. We learn a compact caSSM model for a tendon-driven trunk robot, enabling real-time control and reducing open-loop prediction error by 40% compared to existing methods. In closed-loop experiments with model predictive control (MPC), caSSM reduces tracking error by 52%, demonstrating improved performance against Koopman and SSM based MPC and practical deployability on hardware continuum robots.
tldr: The paper introduces control-augmented Spectral Submanifolds (caSSMs) to improve the control of continuum robots by incorporating actuator information directly into the state representation, leading to better prediction accuracy and closed-loop control performance compared to existing methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了控制增强谱子流形 (caSSM)，通过将执行器信息直接纳入状态表示，从而改进连续机器人的控制，与现有方法相比，实现了更高的预测精度和闭环控制性能。
summary_zh:
摘要：
连续体机器人展现出高维、非线性动力学特性，且常常与其驱动机构相耦合。谱子流形 (SSM) 降维已成为一种主导方法，用于将高维非线性动力系统降维到低维不变流形上。我们提出的控制增强型谱子流形 (caSSM) 通过将控制输入显式地纳入状态表示中来扩展该方法，使得这些模型能够捕捉非线性状态-输入耦合。该模型的训练仅依赖于驱动器增强状态的受控衰减轨迹，从而消除了先前基于SSM的控制方法普遍需要的额外驱动标定步骤。我们针对腱驱动的躯干机器人学习了一个紧凑的caSSM模型，实现了实时控制，并与现有方法相比，将开环预测误差降低了 40%。在模型预测控制 (MPC) 的闭环实验中，caSSM 将跟踪误差降低了 52%，证明了其相对于基于Koopman和 SSM的 MPC的性能提升，以及在硬件连续体机器人上的实际部署能力。

title: Learning Safe-Stoppability Monitors for Humanoid Robots
summary:
Emergency stop (E-stop) mechanisms are the de facto standard for robot safety. However, for humanoid robots, abruptly cutting power can itself cause catastrophic failures; instead, an emergency stop must execute a predefined fallback controller that preserves balance and drives the robot toward a minimum-risk condition. This raises a critical question: from which states can a humanoid robot safely execute such a stop?
  In this work, we formalize emergency stopping for humanoids as a policy-dependent safe-stoppability problem and use data-driven approaches to characterize the safe-stoppable envelope. We introduce PRISM (Proactive Refinement of Importance-sampled Stoppability Monitor), a simulation-driven framework that learns a neural predictor for state-level stoppability. PRISM iteratively refines the decision boundary using importance sampling, enabling targeted exploration of rare but safety-critical states. This targeted exploration significantly improves data efficiency while reducing false-safe predictions under a fixed simulation budget. We further demonstrate sim-to-real transfer by deploying the pretrained monitor on a real humanoid platform. Results show that modeling safety as policy-dependent stoppability enables proactive safety monitoring and supports scalable certification of fail-safe behaviors for humanoid robots.
tldr: This paper introduces PRISM, a simulation-driven framework that learns a neural predictor for safe-stoppability in humanoid robots, showing sim-to-real transfer and enabling proactive safety monitoring.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为PRISM的模拟驱动框架，该框架学习用于人形机器人安全停止的神经预测器，展示了从模拟到现实的迁移，并实现了主动安全监控。
summary_zh:
紧急停止（E-stop）机制是机器人安全领域的既定标准。然而，对于人形机器人而言，突然切断电源本身可能会导致灾难性故障；取而代之的是，紧急停止必须执行一个预定义的后备控制器，以保持平衡并将机器人引导至最低风险的状态。这就提出了一个关键问题：人形机器人从哪些状态可以安全地执行这种停止？

在这项工作中，我们将人形机器人的紧急停止形式化为一个策略相关的安全可停止性问题，并使用数据驱动的方法来表征安全可停止包络。我们引入了PRISM（基于重要性采样的可停止性监控的主动细化），这是一个仿真驱动的框架，用于学习状态级别可停止性的神经预测器。PRISM 使用重要性抽样迭代地细化决策边界，从而能够对稀有但安全关键状态进行有针对性的探索。这种有针对性的探索在固定的仿真预算下，显著提高了数据效率，同时减少了错误的安全预测。我们进一步通过在真实人形机器人平台上部署预训练的监控器，展示了从仿真到现实的迁移。结果表明，将安全性建模为策略相关的可停止性，能够实现主动安全监控，并支持对人形机器人故障安全行为的可扩展认证。

title: Parallel OctoMapping: A Scalable Framework for Enhanced Path Planning in Autonomous Navigation
summary: Mapping is essential in robotics and autonomous systems because it provides the spatial foundation for path planning. Efficient mapping enables planning algorithms to generate reliable paths while ensuring safety and adapting in real time to complex environments. Fixed-resolution mapping methods often produce overly conservative obstacle representations that lead to suboptimal paths or planning failures in cluttered scenes. To address this issue, we introduce Parallel OctoMapping (POMP), an efficient OctoMap-based mapping technique that maximizes available free space and supports multi-threaded computation. To the best of our knowledge, POMP is the first method that, at a fixed occupancy-grid resolution, refines the representation of free space while preserving map fidelity and compatibility with existing search-based planners. It can therefore be integrated into existing planning pipelines, yielding higher pathfinding success rates and shorter path lengths, especially in cluttered environments, while substantially improving computational efficiency.
tldr: The paper introduces Parallel OctoMapping (POMP), a novel OctoMap-based mapping technique that refines free space representation while maintaining compatibility with existing planners, leading to improved pathfinding and computational efficiency in cluttered environments.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了并行 OctoMapping (POMP)，这是一种新颖的基于 OctoMap 的地图构建技术，它在保持与现有规划器兼容性的同时改进了自由空间表示，从而提高了在拥挤环境中的路径查找和计算效率。
summary_zh: 地图构建在机器人和自主系统中至关重要，因为它为路径规划提供了空间基础。高效的地图构建使规划算法能够生成可靠的路径，同时确保安全并实时适应复杂环境。固定分辨率的地图构建方法通常会产生过于保守的障碍物表示，从而导致次优路径或在杂乱场景中规划失败。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了并行八叉树地图构建（POMP），一种高效的基于OctoMap的地图构建技术，它可以最大限度地利用可用自由空间并支持多线程计算。据我们所知，POMP是第一个在固定占据栅格分辨率下，精细化自由空间表示，同时保持地图保真度并与现有基于搜索的规划器兼容的方法。因此，它可以集成到现有的规划流程中，从而提高路径规划成功率并缩短路径长度，尤其是在杂乱环境中，同时显著提高计算效率。

title: Energy-Aware Collaborative Exploration for a UAV-UGV Team
summary: We present an energy-aware collaborative exploration framework for a UAV-UGV team operating in unknown environments, where the UAV's energy constraint is modeled as a maximum flight-time limit. The UAV executes a sequence of energy-bounded exploration tours, while the UGV simultaneously explores on the ground and serves as a mobile charging station. Rendezvous is enforced under a shared time budget so that the vehicles meet at the end of each tour before the UAV reaches its flight-time limit. We construct a sparsely coupled air-ground roadmap using a density-aware layered probabilistic roadmap (PRM) and formulate tour selection over the roadmap as coupled orienteering problems (OPs) to maximize information gain subject to the rendezvous constraint. The resulting tours are constructed over collision-validated roadmap edges. We validate our method through simulation studies, benchmark comparisons, and real-world experiments.
tldr: This paper presents an energy-aware collaborative exploration framework for a UAV-UGV team, using a coupled orienteering problem formulation to maximize information gain while considering rendezvous and energy constraints. They validate their approach with simulations and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个无人机-无人车团队的能量感知协同探索框架，采用耦合定向问题公式来最大化信息增益，同时考虑了会合和能量约束。 通过仿真和真实实验验证了该方法。
summary_zh: 我们提出了一个能量感知的无人机-无人地面车辆（UAV-UGV）协同探索框架，用于在未知环境中运行，其中无人机的能量约束被建模为最长飞行时间限制。无人机执行一系列能量约束下的探索行程，而无人地面车辆同时在地面上进行探索，并充当移动充电站。在共享的时间预算下强制执行会合，以便车辆在每次行程结束时会合，且无人机不超过其飞行时间限制。我们使用密度感知的分层概率路线图（PRM）构建了一个稀疏耦合的空中-地面路线图，并将路线图上的行程选择表述为耦合定向运动问题（OP），以在满足会合约束的条件下最大化信息增益。由此产生的行程是在经过碰撞验证的路线图边缘上构建的。我们通过仿真研究、基准比较和实际实验验证了我们的方法。

title: MapForest: A Modular Field Robotics System for Forest Mapping and Invasive Species Localization
summary: Monitoring and controlling invasive tree species across large forests, parks, and trail networks is challenging due to limited accessibility, reliance on manual scouting, and degraded under-canopy GNSS. We present MapForest, a modular field robotics system that transforms multi-modal sensor data into GIS-ready invasive-species maps. Our system features: (i) a compact, platform-agnostic sensing payload that can be rapidly mounted on UAV, bicycle, or backpack platforms, and (ii) a software pipeline comprising LiDAR-inertial mapping, image-based invasive-species detection, and georeferenced map generation. To ensure reliable operation in GNSS-intermittent environments, we enhance a LiDAR-inertial mapping backbone with covariance-aware GNSS factors and robust loss kernels. We train an object detector to detect the Tree-of-Heaven (Ailanthus altissima) from onboard RGB imagery and fuse detections with the reconstructed map to produce geospatial outputs suitable for downstream decision making. We collected a dataset spanning six sites across urban environments, parks, trails, and forests to evaluate individual system modules, and report end-to-end results on two sites containing Tree-of-Heaven. The enhanced mapping module achieved a trajectory deviation error of 1.95 m over a 1.2 km forest traversal, and the Tree-of-Heaven detector achieved an F1 score of 0.653. The datasets and associated tooling are released to support reproducible research in forest mapping and invasive-species monitoring.
tldr: The paper presents MapForest, a modular field robotics system for forest mapping and invasive species localization using LiDAR-inertial mapping and image-based object detection, releasing a dataset and tooling for reproducible research.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍 MapForest，一种用于森林测绘和入侵物种定位的模块化现场机器人系统，该系统使用激光雷达惯性测绘和基于图像的目标检测，并发布数据集和工具以支持可重复的研究。
summary_zh: 由于可达性受限、依赖人工巡查以及林下GNSS信号衰减，在大片森林、公园和步道网络中监测和控制入侵树种极具挑战性。我们提出MapForest，一种模块化现场机器人系统，可以将多模态传感器数据转化为可用于GIS的入侵物种地图。我们的系统包括：（i）一种紧凑的、与平台无关的传感载荷，可以快速安装在无人机、自行车或背包平台上；（ii）一个软件流程，包含LiDAR-惯性映射、基于图像的入侵物种检测和带有地理参考的地图生成。为了确保在GNSS间歇性环境中可靠运行，我们使用协方差感知GNSS因子和鲁棒损失核增强了LiDAR-惯性映射主干网络。我们训练了一个目标检测器，从机载RGB图像中检测臭椿（Ailanthus altissima），并将检测结果与重建的地图融合，从而生成适用于下游决策的空间地理输出。我们收集了一个覆盖城市环境、公园、步道和森林中六个地点的的数据集，用于评估各个系统模块，并报告了在包含臭椿的两个地点的端到端结果。增强的映射模块在1.2公里的森林穿越中实现了1.95米的轨迹偏差误差，臭椿检测器的F1得分为0.653。数据集和相关工具已发布，以支持森林测绘和入侵物种监测中的可复现研究。

title: AgentRAE: Remote Action Execution through Notification-based Visual Backdoors against Screenshots-based Mobile GUI Agents
summary: The rapid adoption of mobile graphical user interface (GUI) agents, which autonomously control applications and operating systems (OS), exposes new system-level attack surfaces. Existing backdoors against web GUI agents and general GenAI models rely on environmental injection or deceptive pop-ups to mislead the agent operation. However, these techniques do not work on screenshots-based mobile GUI agents due to the challenges of restricted trigger design spaces, OS background interference, and conflicts in multiple trigger-action mappings. We propose AgentRAE, a novel backdoor attack capable of inducing Remote Action Execution in mobile GUI agents using visually natural triggers (e.g., benign app icons in notifications). To address the underfitting caused by natural triggers and achieve accurate multi-target action redirection, we design a novel two-stage pipeline that first enhances the agent's sensitivity to subtle iconographic differences via contrastive learning, and then associates each trigger with a specific mobile GUI agent action through a backdoor post-training. Our extensive evaluation reveals that the proposed backdoor preserves clean performance with an attack success rate of over 90% across ten mobile operations. Furthermore, it is hard to visibly detect the benign-looking triggers and circumvents eight representative state-of-the-art defenses. These results expose an overlooked backdoor vector in mobile GUI agents, underscoring the need for defenses that scrutinize notification-conditioned behaviors and internal agent representations.
tldr: The paper introduces AgentRAE, a novel backdoor attack against mobile GUI agents that uses visually subtle triggers (e.g., app icons in notifications) to induce remote action execution, achieving high success rates and evading common defenses.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为AgentRAE的新型后门攻击，该攻击针对移动GUI代理，使用视觉上微妙的触发器（例如，通知中的应用程序图标）来诱导远程操作执行，实现了高成功率并规避了常见的防御。
summary_zh: 移动图形用户界面（GUI）代理的快速普及，它们能够自主控制应用程序和操作系统（OS），暴露出新的系统级攻击面。现有的针对Web GUI代理和通用GenAI模型的后门攻击依赖于环境注入或欺骗性弹窗来误导代理的操作。然而，由于受限触发设计空间、操作系统后台干扰以及多重触发-动作映射冲突等挑战，这些技术不适用于基于截图的移动GUI代理。我们提出 AgentRAE，一种新型后门攻击，能够利用视觉上自然的触发器（例如，通知中的良性应用图标）诱导移动GUI代理中的远程动作执行。为了解决由自然触发器引起的欠拟合问题，并实现精确的多目标动作重定向，我们设计了一种新颖的两阶段流水线，首先通过对比学习增强代理对细微图标差异的敏感性，然后通过后门后训练将每个触发器与特定的移动GUI代理动作相关联。我们的大量评估表明，所提出的后门保留了干净性能，并在十项移动操作中实现了超过 90% 的攻击成功率。 此外，它难以被肉眼检测良性触发器，并规避了八种具有代表性的最先进的防御措施。 这些结果揭示了移动GUI代理中一个被忽视的后门向量，突出了对审查通知条件行为和内部代理表示的防御的必要性。

title: Separating Diagnosis from Control: Auditable Policy Adaptation in Agent-Based Simulations with LLM-Based Diagnostics
summary: Mitigating elderly loneliness requires policy interventions that achieve both adaptability and auditability. Existing methods struggle to reconcile these objectives: traditional agent-based models suffer from static rigidity, while direct large language model (LLM) controllers lack essential traceability. This work proposes a three-layer framework that separates diagnosis from control to achieve both properties simultaneously.
