LLMs operate strictly as diagnostic instruments that assess population state and generate structured risk evaluations, while deterministic formulas with explicit bounds translate these assessments into traceable parameter updates. This separation ensures that every policy decision can be attributed to inspectable rules while maintaining adaptive response to emergent needs. We validate the framework through systematic ablation across five experimental conditions in elderly care simulation. Results demonstrate that explicit control rules outperform end-to-end black-box LLM approaches by 11.7\% while preserving full auditability, confirming that transparency need not compromise adaptive performance.
tldr: The paper proposes a three-layer framework that uses LLMs for diagnostics and deterministic rules for control in agent-based models, achieving both adaptability and auditability in elderly care simulations, outperforming end-to-end LLM approaches.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种三层框架，在基于Agent的模型中使用LLM进行诊断，使用确定性规则进行控制，从而在老年护理模拟中实现适应性和可审计性，优于端到端LLM方法。
summary_zh: 缓解老年人孤独感需要兼具适应性和可审计性的政策干预。现有方法难以兼顾这些目标：传统的基于代理的模型存在静态刚性，而直接的大型语言模型（LLM）控制器缺乏必要的可追溯性。本文提出了一种三层框架，将诊断与控制分离，以同时实现这两个特性。LLM严格地作为诊断工具，评估人群状态并生成结构化的风险评估，而具有明确边界的确定性公式将这些评估转化为可追溯的参数更新。这种分离确保了每个政策决策都可归因于可审查的规则，同时保持对突发需求的适应性。我们通过在老年护理模拟中的五个实验条件下进行系统性消融实验来验证该框架。结果表明，显式控制规则优于端到端的黑盒LLM方法11.7％，同时保留了完全的可审计性，证实了透明性不必以牺牲自适应性能为代价。

title: Learning What Matters Now: Dynamic Preference Inference under Contextual Shifts
summary: Humans often juggle multiple, sometimes conflicting objectives and shift their priorities as circumstances change, rather than following a fixed objective function. In contrast, most computational decision-making and multi-objective RL methods assume static preference weights or a known scalar reward. In this work, we study sequential decision-making problem when these preference weights are unobserved latent variables that drift with context. Specifically, we propose Dynamic Preference Inference (DPI), a cognitively inspired framework in which an agent maintains a probabilistic belief over preference weights, updates this belief from recent interaction, and conditions its policy on inferred preferences. We instantiate DPI as a variational preference inference module trained jointly with a preference-conditioned actor-critic, using vector-valued returns as evidence about latent trade-offs. In queueing, maze, and multi-objective continuous-control environments with event-driven changes in objectives, DPI adapts its inferred preferences to new regimes and achieves higher post-shift performance than fixed-weight and heuristic envelope baselines.
tldr: This paper introduces Dynamic Preference Inference (DPI), a reinforcement learning framework that allows agents to infer and adapt to dynamically changing, unobserved preference weights in multi-objective decision-making, demonstrating improved performance in shifting environments.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了动态偏好推断（DPI），这是一个强化学习框架，允许智能体在多目标决策中推断和适应动态变化的，未观察到的偏好权重，并在不断变化的环境中表现出更高的性能。
summary_zh: 人类常常同时处理多个有时相互冲突的目标，并随着环境变化调整优先级，而不是遵循固定的目标函数。相比之下，大多数计算决策和多目标强化学习方法假设静态偏好权重或已知的标量奖励。在这项工作中，我们研究了当这些偏好权重是随环境漂移的未观察到的潜在变量时的序贯决策问题。具体而言，我们提出动态偏好推断（DPI），这是一个受认知启发的框架，其中智能体维持对偏好权重的概率信念，从最近的交互中更新此信念，并基于推断的偏好来调节其策略。我们通过将 DPI 实例化为一个变分偏好推断模块，并将其与一个偏好条件化的 Actor-Critic 联合训练来实现，使用向量值回报作为关于潜在权衡的证据。在具有事件驱动目标变化的排队、迷宫和多目标连续控制环境中，DPI 将其推断的偏好适应新状态，并获得比固定权重和启发式包络基线更高的状态转移后性能。

title: ABSTRAL: Automatic Design of Multi-Agent Systems Through Iterative Refinement and Topology Optimization
summary: How should multi-agent systems be designed, and can that design knowledge be captured in a form that is inspectable, revisable, and transferable? We introduce ABSTRAL, a framework that treats MAS architecture as an evolving natural-language document, an artifact refined through contrastive trace analysis. Three findings emerge. First, we provide a precise measurement of the multi-agent coordination tax: under fixed turn budgets, ensembles achieve only 26% turn efficiency, with 66% of tasks exhausting the limit, yet still improve over single-agent baselines by discovering parallelizable task decompositions. Second, design knowledge encoded in documents transfers: topology reasoning and role templates learned on one domain provide a head start on new domains, with transferred seeds matching coldstart iteration 3 performance in a single iteration. Third, contrastive trace analysis discovers specialist roles absent from any initial design, a capability no prior system demonstrates. On SOPBench (134 bank tasks, deterministic oracle), ABSTRAL reaches 70% validation / 65.96% test pass rate with a GPT-4o backbone. We release the converged documents as inspectable design rationale.
tldr: The paper introduces ABSTRAL, a framework for automatically designing multi-agent systems using natural language documents evolved through contrastive trace analysis, demonstrating improvements in transfer learning and novel role discovery.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ABSTRAL，一个通过对比轨迹分析演化自然语言文档来自动设计多智能体系统的框架，展示了在迁移学习和新角色发现方面的改进。
summary_zh: 多智能体系统应如何设计？这种设计知识是否能以一种可检查、可修改、可传递的形式被捕获？我们引入了 ABSTRAL，一个将 MAS 架构视为不断演化的自然语言文档的框架，这是一种通过对比轨迹分析进行优化的产物。得出三个发现。首先，我们提供了多智能体协调成本的精确测量：在固定的轮次预算下，集成系统仅达到 26% 的轮次效率，66% 的任务耗尽了轮次限制，但仍然通过发现可并行化的任务分解，优于单智能体基线。其次，文档中编码的设计知识能够转移：在一个领域学习的拓扑推理和角色模板，为新领域提供了先发优势，转移的种子在单次迭代中达到了冷启动第 3 次迭代的性能。第三，对比轨迹分析发现了初始设计中不存在的专家角色，这是之前没有任何系统能够展示的能力。在 SOPBench 上（134 个银行任务，确定性预言机），ABSTRAL 使用 GPT-4o 主干网络实现了 70% 的验证通过率 / 65.96% 的测试通过率。我们将收敛后的文档作为可检查的设计原理发布。

title: WiFi2Cap: Semantic Action Captioning from Wi-Fi CSI via Limb-Level Semantic Alignment
summary: Privacy-preserving semantic understanding of human activities is important for indoor sensing, yet existing Wi-Fi CSI-based systems mainly focus on pose estimation or predefined action classification rather than fine-grained language generation. Mapping CSI to natural-language descriptions remains challenging because of the semantic gap between wireless signals and language and direction-sensitive ambiguities such as left/right limb confusion. We propose WiFi2Cap, a three-stage framework for generating action captions directly from Wi-Fi CSI. A vision-language teacher learns transferable supervision from synchronized video-text pairs, and a CSI student is aligned to the teacher's visual space and text embeddings. To improve direction-sensitive captioning, we introduce a Mirror-Consistency Loss that reduces mirrored-action and left-right ambiguities during cross-modal alignment. A prefix-tuned language model then generates action descriptions from CSI embeddings. We also introduce the WiFi2Cap Dataset, a synchronized CSI-RGB-sentence benchmark for semantic captioning from Wi-Fi signals. Experimental results show that WiFi2Cap consistently outperforms baseline methods on BLEU-4, METEOR, ROUGE-L, CIDEr, and SPICE, demonstrating effective privacy-friendly semantic sensing.
tldr: The paper proposes WiFi2Cap, a framework for generating natural language descriptions of human actions directly from Wi-Fi CSI data, addressing the challenge of privacy-preserving activity understanding. They introduce a novel alignment method and a new dataset for this task.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了WiFi2Cap，一个直接从Wi-Fi CSI数据生成人类行为自然语言描述的框架，解决了保护隐私的活动理解的挑战。他们为此任务引入了一种新的对齐方法和一个新的数据集。
summary_zh:
以下是一篇論文的摘要，翻譯成中文：

保護隱私的人類活動語義理解對於室內感知至關重要，然而現有的基於Wi-Fi CSI的系統主要集中於姿態估計或預定義的動作分類，而非細粒度的語言生成。 將CSI映射到自然語言描述仍然具有挑戰性，因為無線信號和語言之間存在語義鴻溝，以及方向敏感的歧義，例如左/右肢混淆。 我們提出WiFi2Cap，一個三階段框架，用於直接從Wi-Fi CSI生成動作描述。 一個視覺-語言教師從同步的視頻-文本對學習可遷移的監督信息，並且一個CSI學生與教師的可視空間和文本嵌入對齊。 為了改善方向敏感的描述生成，我們引入了鏡像一致性損失，以減少跨模態對齊期間的鏡像動作和左右歧義。 然後，一個前綴調整的語言模型從CSI嵌入生成動作描述。 我們還介紹了WiFi2Cap數據集，這是一個同步的CSI-RGB-句子基準測試，用於從Wi-Fi信號進行語義描述。 實驗結果表明，WiFi2Cap在BLEU-4、METEOR、ROUGE-L、CIDEr和SPICE指標上始終優於基準方法，證明了有效的保護隱私的語義感知。

title: OccAny: Generalized Unconstrained Urban 3D Occupancy
summary: Relying on in-domain annotations and precise sensor-rig priors, existing 3D occupancy prediction methods are limited in both scalability and out-of-domain generalization. While recent visual geometry foundation models exhibit strong generalization capabilities, they were mainly designed for general purposes and lack one or more key ingredients required for urban occupancy prediction, namely metric prediction, geometry completion in cluttered scenes and adaptation to urban scenarios. We address this gap and present OccAny, the first unconstrained urban 3D occupancy model capable of operating on out-of-domain uncalibrated scenes to predict and complete metric occupancy coupled with segmentation features. OccAny is versatile and can predict occupancy from sequential, monocular, or surround-view images. Our contributions are three-fold: (i) we propose the first generalized 3D occupancy framework with (ii) Segmentation Forcing that improves occupancy quality while enabling mask-level prediction, and (iii) a Novel View Rendering pipeline that infers novel-view geometry to enable test-time view augmentation for geometry completion. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OccAny outperforms all visual geometry baselines on 3D occupancy prediction task, while remaining competitive with in-domain self-supervised methods across three input settings on two established urban occupancy prediction datasets. Our code is available at https://github.com/valeoai/OccAny .
tldr: OccAny is a novel urban 3D occupancy prediction model that addresses limitations of existing methods by leveraging visual geometry foundation models and introducing techniques like Segmentation Forcing and Novel View Rendering for improved accuracy and out-of-domain generalization.
tldr_zh: OccAny是一种新颖的城市3D占用预测模型，它通过利用视觉几何基础模型并引入诸如分割强制和新视角渲染等技术来解决现有方法的局限性，从而提高了准确性和领域外泛化能力。
summary_zh: 现有3D占据预测方法依赖领域内标注和精确的传感器坐标先验，在可扩展性和域外泛化能力方面都受到限制。尽管最近的视觉几何基础模型展现出强大的泛化能力，但它们主要为通用目的设计，并且缺乏城市占据预测所需的一个或多个关键要素，即度量预测、在杂乱场景中的几何补全以及对城市场景的适应性。我们弥补了这一差距，并提出了OccAny，这是首个不受约束的城市3D占据模型，能够对域外未校准场景进行操作，以预测和补全度量占据以及分割特征。OccAny具有多功能性，可以从顺序、单目或环视图像中预测占据。我们的贡献有三方面：（i）我们提出了首个通用3D占据框架，具有（ii）分割强制，可在提高占据质量的同时实现掩码级别预测，以及（iii）一种新视角渲染流水线，推断新视角几何，从而实现测试时视角增强以进行几何补全。大量实验表明，OccAny在3D占据预测任务中优于所有视觉几何基线，同时在两个已建立的城市占据预测数据集上，在三种输入设置中与领域内自监督方法保持竞争力。我们的代码可在https://github.com/valeoai/OccAny上获取。

title: UniGRPO: Unified Policy Optimization for Reasoning-Driven Visual Generation
summary: Unified models capable of interleaved generation have emerged as a promising paradigm, with the community increasingly converging on autoregressive modeling for text and flow matching for image generation. To advance this direction, we propose a unified reinforcement learning framework tailored for interleaved generation. We validate our approach on its fundamental unit: a single round of reasoning-driven image generation, where the model first expands the user prompt through reasoning, followed by image synthesis. Formulating this multimodal generation process as a Markov Decision Process with sparse terminal rewards, we introduce UniGRPO to jointly optimize text and image generation policies using GRPO. Adopting a minimalist methodology to avoid over-design, we leverage established training recipes for both modalities by seamlessly integrating standard GRPO for reasoning and FlowGRPO for visual synthesis. To ensure scalability to multi-round interleaved generation, we introduce two critical modifications to the original FlowGRPO: (1) eliminating classifier-free guidance to maintain linear, unbranched rollouts, which is essential for scaling to complex scenarios involving multi-turn interactions and multi-condition generation (e.g., editing); and (2) replacing the standard latent KL penalty with an MSE penalty directly on the velocity fields, providing a more robust and direct regularization signal to mitigate reward hacking effectively. Our experiments demonstrate that this unified training recipe significantly enhances image generation quality through reasoning, providing a robust and scalable baseline for the future post-training of fully interleaved models.
tldr: This paper introduces UniGRPO, a unified reinforcement learning framework for reasoning-driven visual generation, optimizing text and image generation policies jointly with GRPO and FlowGRPO while addressing scalability challenges for multi-round interleaved generation.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了UniGRPO，一个用于推理驱动的视觉生成的统一强化学习框架，利用GRPO和FlowGRPO联合优化文本和图像生成策略，同时解决了多轮交错生成的可扩展性挑战。
summary_zh: 能够进行交错生成的统一模型已经成为一种极具前景的范式，社区越来越倾向于文本的自回归建模和图像生成中的流匹配。为了推动这一方向发展，我们提出了一种为交错生成量身定制的统一强化学习框架。我们在其基本单元上验证了我们的方法：一轮基于推理驱动的图像生成，其中模型首先通过推理扩展用户提示，然后进行图像合成。我们将这种多模态生成过程形式化为一个具有稀疏终点奖励的马尔可夫决策过程，并引入UniGRPO来使用GRPO联合优化文本和图像生成策略。我们采用一种最小化的方法以避免过度设计，通过无缝集成用于推理的标准GRPO和用于视觉合成的FlowGRPO，来利用这两种模态已建立的训练方案。为了确保可扩展到多轮交错生成，我们对原本的FlowGRPO进行了两个关键修改：（1）消除无分类器引导以保持线性、非分支的展开，这对于扩展到涉及多轮交互和多条件生成（例如，编辑）的复杂场景至关重要；（2）用直接作用于速度场的MSE惩罚取代标准的潜在KL惩罚，从而提供更稳健、更直接的正则化信号，以有效缓解奖励窃取。我们的实验表明，这种统一的训练方案显著提高了基于推理的图像生成质量，为未来完全交错模型的后训练提供了一个稳健且可扩展的基线。

title: AgentRVOS: Reasoning over Object Tracks for Zero-Shot Referring Video Object Segmentation
summary: Referring Video Object Segmentation (RVOS) aims to segment a target object throughout a video given a natural language query. Training-free methods for this task follow a common pipeline: a MLLM selects keyframes, grounds the referred object within those frames, and a video segmentation model propagates the results. While intuitive, this design asks the MLLM to make temporal decisions before any object-level evidence is available, limiting both reasoning quality and spatio-temporal coverage. To overcome this, we propose AgentRVOS, a training-free agentic pipeline built on the complementary strengths of SAM3 and a MLLM. Given a concept derived from the query, SAM3 provides reliable perception over the full spatio-temporal extent through generated mask tracks. The MLLM then identifies the target through query-grounded reasoning over this object-level evidence, iteratively pruning guided by SAM3's temporal existence information. Extensive experiments show that AgentRVOS achieves state-of-the-art performance among training-free methods across multiple benchmarks, with consistent results across diverse MLLM backbones. Our project page is available at: https://cvlab-kaist.github.io/AgentRVOS/.
tldr: The paper introduces AgentRVOS, a training-free agentic pipeline for Referring Video Object Segmentation (RVOS) that uses SAM3 to generate mask tracks for objects and an MLLM to reason over these tracks to identify the target object based on a language query, achieving state-of-the-art performance among training-free methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为AgentRVOS的无需训练的Agentic流水线，用于指代视频对象分割（RVOS）。它利用SAM3生成对象的掩码轨迹，并使用MLLM对这些轨迹进行推理，以根据语言查询识别目标对象，从而在无需训练的方法中实现了最先进的性能。
summary_zh: 参考视频对象分割（RVOS）旨在根据自然语言查询分割视频中目标对象。 此任务的免训练方法遵循一个通用流程：多模态大语言模型（MLLM）选择关键帧，在该帧中分割参考对象，然后视频分割模型传播结果。 虽然直观，但此设计要求 MLLM 在任何对象级证据可用之前做出时间决策，限制了推理质量和时空覆盖范围。 为了克服这个问题，我们提出了 AgentRVOS，这是一个建立在 SAM3 和 MLLM 互补优势之上的免训练代理流程。 给定从查询中导出的概念，SAM3 通过生成的掩码轨迹提供在完整时空范围内的可靠感知。 然后，MLLM 通过基于此对象级证据的查询引导推理来识别目标，并由 SAM3 的时间存在信息引导进行迭代修剪。 大量实验表明，AgentRVOS 在多个基准测试中实现了免训练方法中最先进的性能，并且在不同的 MLLM 主干网络上获得了稳定的结果。 我们的项目页面可在以下网址找到：https://cvlab-kaist.github.io/AgentRVOS/。

title: I3DM: Implicit 3D-aware Memory Retrieval and Injection for Consistent Video Scene Generation
summary: Despite remarkable progress in video generation, maintaining long-term scene consistency upon revisiting previously explored areas remains challenging. Existing solutions rely either on explicitly constructing 3D geometry, which suffers from error accumulation and scale ambiguity, or on naive camera Field-of-View (FoV) retrieval, which typically fails under complex occlusions. To overcome these limitations, we propose I3DM, a novel implicit 3D-aware memory mechanism for consistent video scene generation that bypasses explicit 3D reconstruction. At the core of our approach is a 3D-aware memory retrieval strategy, which leverages the intermediate features of a pre-trained Feed-Forward Novel View Synthesis (FF-NVS) model to score view relevance, enabling robust retrieval even in highly occluded scenarios. Furthermore, to fully utilize the retrieved historical frames, we introduce a 3D-aligned memory injection module. This module implicitly warps historical content to the target view and adaptively conditions the generation on reliable warping regions, leading to improved revisit consistency and accurate camera control. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, achieving superior revisit consistency, generation fidelity, and camera control precision.
tldr: The paper introduces I3DM, a novel implicit 3D-aware memory mechanism for consistent video scene generation that bypasses explicit 3D reconstruction and improves revisit consistency and camera control.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了I3DM，一种新颖的隐式3D感知记忆机制，用于一致的视频场景生成，它绕过了显式的3D重建，并提高了重访一致性和摄像头控制。
summary_zh: 尽管视频生成取得了显著进展，但在重新访问先前探索过的区域时，维持长期场景一致性仍然具有挑战性。现有的解决方案要么依赖于显式构建3D几何体，这会遭受误差累积和尺度模糊的困扰，要么依赖于简单的相机视场(FoV)检索，这通常在复杂的遮挡下失效。为了克服这些限制，我们提出I3DM，一种新颖的隐式3D感知记忆机制，用于一致的视频场景生成，其绕过了显式3D重建。我们方法的核心是一种3D感知记忆检索策略，它利用预训练的前馈新视角合成(FF-NVS)模型的中间特征来评估视角相关性，从而即使在高遮挡场景中也能实现鲁棒的检索。此外，为了充分利用检索到的历史帧，我们引入了一个3D对齐的记忆注入模块。该模块将历史内容隐式地扭曲到目标视角，并自适应地根据可靠的扭曲区域进行条件生成，从而提高重访一致性和精确的相机控制。大量的实验表明，我们的方法优于最先进的方法，实现了卓越的重访一致性、生成保真度和相机控制精度。

title: Object Pose Transformer: Unifying Unseen Object Pose Estimation
summary: Learning model-free object pose estimation for unseen instances remains a fundamental challenge in 3D vision. Existing methods typically fall into two disjoint paradigms: category-level approaches predict absolute poses in a canonical space but rely on predefined taxonomies, while relative pose methods estimate cross-view transformations but cannot recover single-view absolute pose. In this work, we propose Object Pose Transformer (\ours{}), a unified feed-forward framework that bridges these paradigms through task factorization within a single model. \ours{} jointly predicts depth, point maps, camera parameters, and normalized object coordinates (NOCS) from RGB inputs, enabling both category-level absolute SA(3) pose and unseen-object relative SE(3) pose. Our approach leverages contrastive object-centric latent embeddings for canonicalization without requiring semantic labels at inference time, and uses point maps as a camera-space representation to enable multi-view relative geometric reasoning. Through cross-frame feature interaction and shared object embeddings, our model leverages relative geometric consistency across views to improve absolute pose estimation, reducing ambiguity in single-view predictions. Furthermore, \ours{} is camera-agnostic, learning camera intrinsics on-the-fly and supporting optional depth input for metric-scale recovery, while remaining fully functional in RGB-only settings. Extensive experiments on diverse benchmarks (NOCS, HouseCat6D, Omni6DPose, Toyota-Light) demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in both absolute and relative pose estimation tasks within a single unified architecture.
tldr: The paper introduces Object Pose Transformer, a unified framework for both category-level absolute pose estimation and unseen-object relative pose estimation by jointly predicting depth, point maps, camera parameters, and NOCS from RGB inputs. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Object Pose Transformer，一个统一的框架，通过从RGB输入中联合预测深度、点云图、相机参数和NOCS，实现类别级别的绝对姿态估计和未见物体的相对姿态估计。 该方法在多个benchmark上实现了最先进的性能。
summary_zh: 学习针对未知实例的无模型物体姿态估计仍然是三维视觉中的一项根本挑战。现有的方法通常属于两种不相交的范式：类别级方法预测在规范空间中的绝对姿态，但依赖于预定义的分类体系，而相对姿态方法估计跨视图变换，但无法恢复单视图的绝对姿态。在这项工作中，我们提出了物体姿态Transformer (\ours{})，一种统一的前馈框架，通过在单个模型中的任务分解来桥接这些范式。\ours{}从RGB输入中联合预测深度、点图、相机参数和归一化物体坐标（NOCS），从而能够实现类别级绝对的SA(3)姿态和未知物体的相对SE(3)姿态。我们的方法利用对比物体中心隐嵌入进行规范化，而无需在推理时使用语义标签，并使用点图作为相机空间表示，从而实现多视图相对几何推理。通过跨帧特征交互和共享的物体嵌入，我们的模型利用跨视图的相对几何一致性来提高绝对姿态估计的性能，从而减少单视图预测中的歧义。此外，\ours{}与相机无关，可以动态学习相机内参，并支持可选的深度输入以恢复度量尺度，同时在仅RGB设置中保持完全功能。在多个多样化的基准数据集（NOCS、HouseCat6D、Omni6DPose、Toyota-Light）上的大量实验表明，在单一的统一架构中，我们的方法在绝对和相对姿态估计任务中都达到了最先进的性能。

title: GO-Renderer: Generative Object Rendering with 3D-aware Controllable Video Diffusion Models
summary: Reconstructing a renderable 3D model from images is a useful but challenging task. Recent feedforward 3D reconstruction methods have demonstrated remarkable success in efficiently recovering geometry, but still cannot accurately model the complex appearances of these 3D reconstructed models. Recent diffusion-based generative models can synthesize realistic images or videos of an object using reference images without explicitly modeling its appearance, which provides a promising direction for object rendering, but lacks accurate control over the viewpoints. In this paper, we propose GO-Renderer, a unified framework integrating the reconstructed 3D proxies to guide the video generative models to achieve high-quality object rendering on arbitrary viewpoints under arbitrary lighting conditions. Our method not only enjoys the accurate viewpoint control using the reconstructed 3D proxy but also enables high-quality rendering in different lighting environments using diffusion generative models without explicitly modeling complex materials and lighting. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GO-Renderer achieves state-of-the-art performance across the object rendering tasks, including synthesizing images on new viewpoints, rendering the objects in a novel lighting environment, and inserting an object into an existing video.
tldr: GO-Renderer integrates 3D proxies with video diffusion models for high-quality, controllable object rendering with novel viewpoints and lighting, outperforming existing methods.
tldr_zh: GO-Renderer集成了3D代理和视频扩散模型，实现了高质量、可控的对象渲染，具有新颖的视角和光照效果，性能优于现有方法。
summary_zh: 从图像重建可渲染的3D模型是一项有用但具有挑战性的任务。 近年来，前馈式3D重建方法在高效恢复几何结构方面表现出显著的成功，但仍然无法准确地建模这些3D重建模型的复杂外观。 近期基于扩散的生成模型能够使用参考图像合成对象的逼真图像或视频，而无需显式地建模其外观，这为对象渲染提供了一个有希望的方向，但缺乏对视点的精确控制。 在本文中，我们提出了GO-Renderer，一个统一的框架，它集成了重建的3D代理，以引导视频生成模型在任意视点和任意光照条件下实现高质量的对象渲染。 我们的方法不仅享有使用重建的3D代理进行准确的视点控制的优势，而且能够利用扩散生成模型在不同的光照环境下进行高质量的渲染，而无需显式地建模复杂的材质和光照。 大量的实验表明，GO-Renderer在对象渲染任务中取得了最先进的性能，包括合成新的视点下的图像、在新的光照环境下渲染对象，以及将对象插入到现有的视频中。

title: Traffic Sign Recognition in Autonomous Driving: Dataset, Benchmark, and Field Experiment
summary: Traffic Sign Recognition (TSR) is a core perception capability for autonomous driving, where robustness to cross-region variation, long-tailed categories, and semantic ambiguity is essential for reliable real-world deployment. Despite steady progress in recognition accuracy, existing traffic sign datasets and benchmarks offer limited diagnostic insight into how different modeling paradigms behave under these practical challenges. We present TS-1M, a large-scale and globally diverse traffic sign dataset comprising over one million real-world images across 454 standardized categories, together with a diagnostic benchmark designed to analyze model capability boundaries. Beyond standard train-test evaluation, we provide a suite of challenge-oriented settings, including cross-region recognition, rare-class identification, low-clarity robustness, and semantic text understanding, enabling systematic and fine-grained assessment of modern TSR models. Using TS-1M, we conduct a unified benchmark across three representative learning paradigms: classical supervised models, self-supervised pretrained models, and multimodal vision-language models (VLMs). Our analysis reveals consistent paradigm-dependent behaviors, showing that semantic alignment is a key factor for cross-region generalization and rare-category recognition, while purely visual models remain sensitive to appearance shift and data imbalance. Finally, we validate the practical relevance of TS-1M through real-scene autonomous driving experiments, where traffic sign recognition is integrated with semantic reasoning and spatial localization to support map-level decision constraints. Overall, TS-1M establishes a reference-level diagnostic benchmark for TSR and provides principled insights into robust and semantic-aware traffic sign perception. Project page: https://guoyangzhao.github.io/projects/ts1m.
tldr: This paper introduces TS-1M, a large-scale and globally diverse traffic sign dataset with a diagnostic benchmark, analyzing different model capabilities for traffic sign recognition, including real-world autonomous driving experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个大规模、全球多样化的交通标志数据集TS-1M，并提供了一个诊断基准，用于分析不同模型在交通标志识别方面的能力，包括实际自动驾驶实验。
summary_zh: 交通标志识别(TSR)是自动驾驶的一项核心感知能力，其中对跨区域变异、长尾类别和语义歧义的鲁棒性对于可靠的实际部署至关重要。尽管识别准确率取得了稳步进展，但现有的交通标志数据集和基准测试在诊断不同建模范式如何在这些实际挑战下表现方面提供的洞察力有限。我们提出了 TS-1M，这是一个大规模且全球多样化的交通标志数据集，包含超过一百万张来自 454 个标准化类别的真实世界图像，以及一个旨在分析模型能力边界的诊断基准。除了标准的训练-测试评估之外，我们还提供了一套面向挑战的设置，包括跨区域识别、罕见类别识别、低清晰度鲁棒性和语义文本理解，从而能够对现代 TSR 模型进行系统且细粒度的评估。我们使用 TS-1M，对三种具有代表性的学习范式进行了统一基准测试：经典监督模型、自监督预训练模型和多模态视觉-语言模型 (VLMs)。我们的分析揭示了一致的、依赖于范式的行为，表明语义对齐是跨区域泛化和罕见类别识别的关键因素，而纯视觉模型仍然对外观变化和数据不平衡敏感。最后，我们通过真实场景自动驾驶实验验证了 TS-1M 的实际相关性，其中交通标志识别与语义推理和空间定位相集成，以支持地图级别的决策约束。总的来说，TS-1M 建立了一个参考级别的 TSR 诊断基准，并为鲁棒且具有语义感知能力的交通标志感知提供了原则性见解。项目主页：https://guoyangzhao.github.io/projects/ts1m。

title: VQ-Jarvis: Retrieval-Augmented Video Restoration Agent with Sharp Vision and Fast Thought
summary: Video restoration in real-world scenarios is challenged by heterogeneous degradations, where static architectures and fixed inference pipelines often fail to generalize. Recent agent-based approaches offer dynamic decision making, yet existing video restoration agents remain limited by insufficient quality perception and inefficient search strategies. We propose VQ-Jarvis, a retrieval-augmented, all-in-one intelligent video restoration agent with sharper vision and faster thought. VQ-Jarvis is designed to accurately perceive degradations and subtle differences among paired restoration results, while efficiently discovering optimal restoration trajectories. To enable sharp vision, we construct VSR-Compare, the first large-scale video paired enhancement dataset with 20K comparison pairs covering 7 degradation types, 11 enhancement operators, and diverse content domains. Based on this dataset, we train a multiple operator judge model and a degradation perception model to guide agent decisions. To achieve fast thought, we introduce a hierarchical operator scheduling strategy that adapts to video difficulty: for easy cases, optimal restoration trajectories are retrieved in a one-step manner from a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) library; for harder cases, a step-by-step greedy search is performed to balance efficiency and accuracy. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VQ-Jarvis consistently outperforms existing methods on complex degraded videos.
tldr: The paper introduces VQ-Jarvis, a retrieval-augmented video restoration agent with enhanced perception and efficient search, utilizing a novel dataset (VSR-Compare) and a hierarchical operator scheduling strategy for effective video restoration in complex scenarios. It combines retrieval with reinforcement learning for video processing.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了VQ-Jarvis，一种检索增强的视频修复智能体，具有增强的感知能力和高效的搜索能力，利用了一个新的数据集(VSR-Compare)和一个分层算子调度策略，用于在复杂场景中进行有效的视频修复。它结合了检索和强化学习用于视频处理。
summary_zh: 真实场景中的视频修复面临着异构退化的挑战，静态架构和固定推理流程通常无法泛化。近年来基于代理的方法提供了动态决策能力，但现有的视频修复代理仍然受限于质量感知不足和搜索策略效率低下。我们提出了VQ-Jarvis，一个检索增强的、一体化的智能视频修复代理，具有更敏锐的视觉和更快的思考速度。VQ-Jarvis的设计旨在准确感知退化情况和配对修复结果之间的细微差异，同时高效地发现最优的修复轨迹。为了实现敏锐的视觉，我们构建了VSR-Compare，这是第一个大型视频配对增强数据集，包含2万个比较对，涵盖7种退化类型、11种增强算子以及各种内容领域。基于该数据集，我们训练了一个多算子评判模型和一个退化感知模型来指导代理决策。为了实现快速思考，我们引入了一种分层算子调度策略，可以适应视频难度：对于简单情况，最佳修复轨迹以一步方式从检索增强生成（RAG）库中检索；对于更困难的情况，执行步进式贪婪搜索，以平衡效率和准确性。大量的实验表明，VQ-Jarvis在复杂退化视频上始终优于现有方法。

title: ForeSea: AI Forensic Search with Multi-modal Queries for Video Surveillance
summary: Despite decades of work, surveillance still struggles to find specific targets across long, multi-camera video. Prior methods -- tracking pipelines, CLIP based models, and VideoRAG -- require heavy manual filtering, capture only shallow attributes, and fail at temporal reasoning. Real-world searches are inherently multimodal (e.g., "When does this person join the fight?" with the person's image), yet this setting remains underexplored. Also, there are no proper benchmarks to evaluate those setting - asking video with multimodal queries. To address this gap, we introduce ForeSeaQA, a new benchmark specifically designed for video QA with image-and-text queries and timestamped annotations of key events. The dataset consists of long-horizon surveillance footage paired with diverse multimodal questions, enabling systematic evaluation of retrieval, temporal grounding, and multimodal reasoning in realistic forensic conditions. Not limited to this benchmark, we propose ForeSea, an AI forensic search system with a 3-stage, plug-and-play pipeline. (1) A tracking module filters irrelevant footage; (2) a multimodal embedding module indexes the remaining clips; and (3) during inference, the system retrieves top-K candidate clips for a Video Large Language Model (VideoLLM) to answer queries and localize events. On ForeSeaQA, ForeSea improves accuracy by 3.5% and temporal IoU by 11.0 over prior VideoRAG models. To our knowledge, ForeSeaQA is the first benchmark to support complex multimodal queries with precise temporal grounding, and ForeSea is the first VideoRAG system built to excel in this setting.
tldr: The paper introduces ForeSeaQA, a new benchmark for video question answering with image-and-text queries in surveillance footage, and ForeSea, an AI forensic search system utilizing a 3-stage pipeline and VideoLLM to address the benchmark.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ForeSeaQA，一个新的针对监控录像中图像和文本查询的视频问答基准，以及ForeSea，一个利用三阶段流程和VideoLLM来解决该基准的AI取证搜索系统。
summary_zh: 尽管经过数十年的研究，监控系统仍然难以在漫长的多摄像头视频中找到特定目标。 先前的方法——跟踪流水线、基于CLIP的模型和VideoRAG——需要大量的人工过滤，仅捕获浅层属性，并且在时间推理方面表现不佳。 现实世界的搜索本质上是多模态的（例如，带有该人图像的“这个人什么时候加入战斗？”），但这种设置仍未得到充分探索。 此外，也没有适当的基准来评估这些设置 - 询问带有多种模态查询的视频。 为了解决这一差距，我们推出了ForeSeaQA，这是一个专门为带有图像和文本查询的视频问答以及关键事件的时间戳注释而设计的新基准。 该数据集由长时程监控视频片段与各种多模态问题配对组成，从而能够在真实的取证条件下系统地评估检索、时间定位和多模态推理。 不仅限于此基准，我们提出了ForeSea，这是一个具有三阶段、即插即用流水线的人工智能取证搜索系统。（1）一个跟踪模块过滤掉无关的视频片段；（2）一个多模态嵌入模块对剩余的片段进行索引；（3）在推理过程中，系统检索前K个候选片段，供视频大语言模型（VideoLLM）回答查询并定位事件。 在ForeSeaQA上，与之前的VideoRAG模型相比，ForeSea将准确率提高了3.5%，时间IoU提高了11.0%。 据我们所知，ForeSeaQA是第一个支持具有精确时间定位的复杂多模态查询的基准，而ForeSea是第一个为在这种设置中表现出色而构建的VideoRAG系统。

title: Predictive Photometric Uncertainty in Gaussian Splatting for Novel View Synthesis
summary: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting have enabled impressive photorealistic novel view synthesis. However, to transition from a pure rendering engine to a reliable spatial map for autonomous agents and safety-critical applications, knowing where the representation is uncertain is as important as the rendering fidelity itself. We bridge this critical gap by introducing a lightweight, plug-and-play framework for pixel-wise, view-dependent predictive uncertainty estimation. Our post-hoc method formulates uncertainty as a Bayesian-regularized linear least-squares optimization over reconstruction residuals. This architecture-agnostic approach extracts a per-primitive uncertainty channel without modifying the underlying scene representation or degrading baseline visual fidelity. Crucially, we demonstrate that providing this actionable reliability signal successfully translates 3D Gaussian splatting into a trustworthy spatial map, further improving state-of-the-art performance across three critical downstream perception tasks: active view selection, pose-agnostic scene change detection, and pose-agnostic anomaly detection.
tldr: This paper introduces a method to estimate pixel-wise uncertainty in 3D Gaussian Splatting, improving its reliability for downstream perception tasks like active view selection and anomaly detection.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种估计 3D 高斯溅射中像素级不确定性的方法，从而提高了其在主动视图选择和异常检测等下游感知任务中的可靠性。
summary_zh: 3D高斯泼溅技术的最新进展实现了令人印象深刻的逼真新视角合成。然而，要从纯粹的渲染引擎过渡到自主智能体和安全攸关应用可靠的空间地图，了解表征的不确定性与渲染保真度本身同等重要。我们通过引入一个轻量级的、即插即用的框架来弥合这一关键差距，该框架用于像素级的、与视角相关的预测不确定性估计。我们的后验方法将不确定性表示为基于重建残差的贝叶斯正则化线性最小二乘优化问题。这种与架构无关的方法提取每个图元的不确定性通道，而无需修改底层场景表示或降低基线视觉保真度。至关重要的是，我们证明了提供这种可操作的可靠性信号能够成功地将3D高斯泼溅转化为可信赖的空间地图，从而进一步提高了在三个关键下游感知任务中的最先进性能：主动视角选择、与姿态无关的场景变化检测以及与姿态无关的异常检测。

title: A Vision Language Model for Generating Procedural Plant Architecture Representations from Simulated Images
summary: Three-dimensional (3D) procedural plant architecture models have emerged as an important tool for simulation-based studies of plant structure and function, extracting plant architectural parameters from field measurements, and for generating realistic plants in computer graphics. However, measuring the architectural parameters and nested structures for these models at the field scales remains prohibitively labor-intensive. We present a novel algorithm that generates a 3D plant architecture from an image, creating a functional structural plant model that reflects organ-level geometric and topological parameters and provides a more comprehensive representation of the plant's architecture. Instead of using 3D sensors or processing multi-view images with computer vision to obtain the 3D structure of plants, we proposed a method that generates token sequences that encode a procedural definition of plant architecture. This work used only synthetic images for training and testing, with exact architectural parameters known, allowing testing of the hypothesis that organ-level architectural parameters could be extracted from image data using a vision-language model (VLM). A synthetic dataset of cowpea plant images was generated using the Helios 3D plant simulator, with the detailed plant architecture encoded in XML files. We developed a plant architecture tokenizer for the XML file defining plant architecture, converting it into a token sequence that a language model can predict. The model achieved a token F1 score of 0.73 during teacher-forced training. Evaluation of the model was performed through autoregressive generation, achieving a BLEU-4 score of 94.00% and a ROUGE-L score of 0.5182. This led to the conclusion that such plant architecture model generation and parameter extraction were possible from synthetic images; thus, future work will extend the approach to real imagery data.
tldr: This paper presents a vision-language model (VLM) that generates 3D plant architecture representations from synthetic images by predicting token sequences encoding procedural plant definitions, demonstrating the feasibility of extracting organ-level architectural parameters from image data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种视觉语言模型 (VLM)，通过预测编码程序化植物定义的token序列，从合成图像中生成3D植物结构表示，证明了从图像数据中提取器官级别结构参数的可行性。
summary_zh: 三维（3D）程序化植物结构模型已成为植物结构和功能模拟研究、从田间测量中提取植物结构参数以及在计算机图形学中生成逼真植物的重要工具。然而，在田间尺度上测量这些模型的结构参数和嵌套结构仍然非常费力。我们提出了一种新算法，可从图像生成 3D 植物结构，创建一个功能性结构植物模型，该模型反映了器官级的几何和拓扑参数，并提供了对植物结构更全面的表示。我们没有使用 3D 传感器或通过计算机视觉处理多视角图像来获得植物的 3D 结构，而是提出了一种生成令牌序列的方法，该序列编码了植物结构的程序化定义。这项工作仅使用合成图像进行训练和测试，并已知确切的结构参数，从而可以测试是否可以使用视觉-语言模型（VLM）从图像数据中提取器官级结构参数。使用 Helios 3D 植物模拟器生成了豇豆植物图像的合成数据集，详细的植物结构编码在 XML 文件中。我们为定义植物结构的 XML 文件开发了一个植物结构令牌化器，将其转换为语言模型可以预测的令牌序列。该模型在教师强制训练期间达到了 0.73 的令牌 F1 值。通过自回归生成对模型进行了评估，实现了 94.00% 的 BLEU-4 得分和 0.5182 的 ROUGE-L 得分。由此得出结论，从合成图像中生成此类植物结构模型和提取参数是可行的；因此，未来的工作将把该方法扩展到真实图像数据。

title: Static Scene Reconstruction from Dynamic Egocentric Videos
summary: Egocentric videos present unique challenges for 3D reconstruction due to rapid camera motion and frequent dynamic interactions. State-of-the-art static reconstruction systems, such as MapAnything, often degrade in these settings, suffering from catastrophic trajectory drift and "ghost" geometry caused by moving hands. We bridge this gap by proposing a robust pipeline that adapts static reconstruction backbones to long-form egocentric video. Our approach introduces a mask-aware reconstruction mechanism that explicitly suppresses dynamic foreground in the attention layers, preventing hand artifacts from contaminating the static map. Furthermore, we employ a chunked reconstruction strategy with pose-graph stitching to ensure global consistency and eliminate long-term drift. Experiments on HD-EPIC and indoor drone datasets demonstrate that our pipeline significantly improves absolute trajectory error and yields visually clean static geometry compared to naive baselines, effectively extending the capability of foundation models to dynamic first-person scenes.
tldr: This paper proposes a pipeline for static scene reconstruction from dynamic egocentric videos by suppressing dynamic foreground and employing chunked reconstruction with pose-graph stitching to improve trajectory accuracy and geometry quality.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种从动态第一人称视角视频中重建静态场景的流程，通过抑制动态前景并采用分块重建和姿态图缝合来提高轨迹精度和几何质量。
summary_zh: 第一人称视角视频因快速的相机运动和频繁的动态交互，给3D重建带来了独特的挑战。诸如MapAnything等当前先进的静态重建系统，在这些场景下表现往往会下降，遭受灾难性的轨迹漂移以及由移动的手造成的“鬼影”几何结构。我们提出了一种稳健的流程，将静态重建骨干网络适配于长格式的第一人称视角视频，从而弥合了这一差距。我们的方法引入了一种掩码感知的重建机制，该机制在注意力层中显式抑制动态前景，防止手部伪影污染静态地图。此外，我们采用分块重建策略，并结合位姿图缝合，以确保全局一致性并消除长期漂移。在HD-EPIC和室内无人机数据集上的实验表明，与简单基线相比，我们的流程显著提高了绝对轨迹误差，并产生了视觉上干净的静态几何结构，从而有效地将基础模型的能力扩展到动态的第一人称场景。

title: End-to-End Efficient RL for Linear Bellman Complete MDPs with Deterministic Transitions
summary: We study reinforcement learning (RL) with linear function approximation in Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) satisfying \emph{linear Bellman completeness} -- a fundamental setting where the Bellman backup of any linear value function remains linear. While statistically tractable, prior computationally efficient algorithms are either limited to small action spaces or require strong oracle assumptions over the feature space. We provide a computationally efficient algorithm for linear Bellman complete MDPs with \emph{deterministic transitions}, stochastic initial states, and stochastic rewards. For finite action spaces, our algorithm is end-to-end efficient; for large or infinite action spaces, we require only a standard argmax oracle over actions. Our algorithm learns an $\varepsilon$-optimal policy with sample and computational complexity polynomial in the horizon, feature dimension, and $1/\varepsilon$.
tldr: This paper presents a computationally efficient, end-to-end RL algorithm for linear Bellman complete MDPs with deterministic transitions, achieving polynomial sample and computational complexity.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种计算高效的端到端强化学习算法，针对具有确定性转移的线性贝尔曼完备MDP，实现了多项式样本和计算复杂度。
summary_zh: 我们研究在满足\emph{线性贝尔曼完备性}的马尔可夫决策过程(MDP)中使用线性函数逼近的强化学习(RL)——这一基本设定下，任何线性价值函数的贝尔曼备份仍然是线性的。虽然在统计上是易处理的，但先前具有计算效率的算法要么局限于小的动作空间，要么需要对特征空间做出强大的预言机假设。我们为具有\emph{确定性转移}、随机初始状态和随机奖励的线性贝尔曼完备MDP提供了一种计算效率高的算法。对于有限动作空间，我们的算法是端到端高效的；对于大或无限动作空间，我们仅需要一个标准的关于动作的argmax预言机。我们的算法能学习到一个$\varepsilon$-最优策略，其样本和计算复杂度在范围、特征维度和$1/\varepsilon$上呈多项式关系。

title: GEM: Guided Expectation-Maximization for Behavior-Normalized Candidate Action Selection in Offline RL
summary: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) can fit strong value functions from fixed datasets, yet reliable deployment still hinges on the action selection interface used to query them. When the dataset induces a branched or multimodal action landscape, unimodal policy extraction can blur competing hypotheses and yield "in-between" actions that are weakly supported by data, making decisions brittle even with a strong critic. We introduce GEM (Guided Expectation-Maximization), an analytical framework that makes action selection both multimodal and explicitly controllable. GEM trains a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) actor via critic-guided, advantage-weighted EM-style updates that preserve distinct components while shifting probability mass toward high-value regions, and learns a tractable GMM behavior model to quantify support. During inference, GEM performs candidate-based selection: it generates a parallel candidate set and reranks actions using a conservative ensemble lower-confidence bound together with behavior-normalized support, where the behavior log-likelihood is standardized within each state's candidate set to yield stable, comparable control across states and candidate budgets. Empirically, GEM is competitive across D4RL benchmarks, and offers a simple inference-time budget knob (candidate count) that trades compute for decision quality without retraining.
tldr: The paper introduces GEM, a Guided Expectation-Maximization framework for action selection in offline RL that uses a GMM actor and behavior-normalized candidate selection to improve decision quality in multimodal action landscapes.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为GEM的离线强化学习框架，它使用引导期望最大化方法进行动作选择，利用高斯混合模型（GMM）做为actor，并通过行为归一化的候选动作选择来提高多模态动作场景下的决策质量。
summary_zh: 离线强化学习(RL)可以从固定数据集中拟合出强大的价值函数，但可靠部署仍然取决于用于查询这些函数的动作选择接口。当数据集引入分支或多模态的动作空间时，单峰策略提取会模糊竞争性假设，并产生数据支持薄弱的“中间”动作，即使具有强大的评论家网络，决策也变得脆弱。我们引入了GEM（引导期望最大化），这是一个分析框架，使动作选择既多模态又显式可控。GEM通过评论家引导的、优势加权的EM式更新，训练高斯混合模型（GMM）策略网络，从而保留不同的成分，同时将概率质量转移到高价值区域，并学习易于处理的GMM行为模型以量化支持度。在推理过程中，GEM执行基于候选集的选择：它生成一个并行的候选集，并使用保守的集成置信下界以及行为归一化支持度对动作进行重新排序，其中每个状态候选集内的行为对数似然被标准化，以在不同状态和候选预算下产生稳定、可比的控制。实验表明，GEM在D4RL基准测试中具有竞争力，并提供了一个简单的推理时预算旋钮（候选计数），该旋钮无需重新训练即可在计算和决策质量之间进行权衡。

title: PinPoint: Monocular Needle Pose Estimation for Robotic Suturing via Stein Variational Newton and Geometric Residuals
summary: Reliable estimation of surgical needle 3D position and orientation is essential for autonomous robotic suturing, yet existing methods operate almost exclusively under stereoscopic vision. In monocular endoscopic settings, common in transendoscopic and intraluminal procedures, depth ambiguity and rotational symmetry render needle pose estimation inherently ill-posed, producing a multimodal distribution over feasible configurations, rather than a single, well-grounded estimate. We present PinPoint, a probabilistic variational inference framework that treats this ambiguity directly, maintaining a distribution of pose hypotheses rather than suppressing it. PinPoint combines monocular image observations with robot-grasp constraints through analytical geometric likelihoods with closed-form Jacobians. This framework enables efficient Gauss-Newton preconditioning in a Stein Variational Newton inference, where second-order particle transport deterministically moves particles toward high-probability regions while kernel-based repulsion preserves diversity in the multimodal structure. On real needle-tracking sequences, PinPoint reduces mean translational error by 80% (down to 1.00 mm) and rotational error by 78% (down to 13.80°) relative to a particle-filter baseline, with substantially better-calibrated uncertainty. On induced-rotation sequences, where monocular ambiguity is most severe, PinPoint maintains a bimodal posterior 84% of the time, almost three times the rate of the particle filter baseline, correctly preserving the alternative hypothesis rather than committing prematurely to one mode. Suturing experiments in ex vivo tissue demonstrate stable tracking through intermittent occlusion, with average errors during occlusion of 1.34 mm in translation and 19.18° in rotation, even when the needle is fully embedded.
tldr: The paper introduces PinPoint, a novel monocular needle pose estimation framework for robotic suturing that utilizes Stein Variational Newton inference and geometric residuals to address depth ambiguity and rotational symmetry challenges, achieving significant error reduction and improved uncertainty calibration compared to baseline methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了PinPoint，一种用于机器人缝合的新型单目针姿态估计框架，利用Stein变分牛顿推理和几何残差来解决深度模糊和旋转对称性挑战，与基线方法相比，实现了显著的误差减少和改善的不确定性校准。
summary_zh: 外科手术缝合针3D位置和姿态的可靠估计对于自主机器人缝合至关重要，然而，现有方法几乎完全在立体视觉下运行。在单目内窥镜环境中，常见于经内窥镜和管腔内手术，深度模糊和旋转对称性使得针的姿态估计本质上成为一个病态问题，产生一个可行配置上的多峰分布，而不是单一、良好确定的估计。我们提出PinPoint，一个概率变分推断框架，直接处理这种模糊性，保持姿态假设的分布，而不是抑制它。PinPoint通过具有闭式雅可比矩阵的解析几何似然性，结合单目图像观测和机器人抓取约束。该框架支持Stein变分牛顿推断中的高效高斯-牛顿预处理，其中二阶粒子传输将粒子确定性地移动到高概率区域，而基于核的排斥力保持多峰结构的多样性。在真实的针跟踪序列上，PinPoint相对于粒子滤波器基线，其平均平移误差减少了80%（降至1.00毫米），旋转误差减少了78%（降至13.80°），并具有明显更好的校准不确定性。在诱导旋转序列中，单目模糊性最为严重，PinPoint保持双峰后验的频率为84%，几乎是粒子滤波器基线的三倍，正确地保留了替代假设，而不是过早地承诺一种模式。在离体组织中的缝合实验表明，在间歇性遮挡下实现了稳定的跟踪，即使针完全嵌入时，遮挡期间的平均平移误差为1.34毫米，旋转误差为19.18°。

title: Fleet-Level Battery-Health-Aware Scheduling for Autonomous Mobile Robots
summary: Autonomous mobile robot fleets must coordinate task allocation and charging under limited shared resources, yet most battery aware planning methods address only a single robot. This paper extends degradation cost aware task planning to a multi robot setting by jointly optimizing task assignment, service sequencing, optional charging decisions, charging mode selection, and charger access while balancing degradation across the fleet. The formulation relies on reduced form degradation proxies grounded in the empirical battery aging literature, capturing both charging mode dependent wear and idle state of charge dependent aging; the bilinear idle aging term is linearized through a disaggregated piecewise McCormick formulation. Tight big M values derived from instance data strengthen the LP relaxation. To manage scalability, we propose a hierarchical matheuristic in which a fleet level master problem coordinates assignments, routes, and charger usage, while robot level subproblems whose integer part decomposes into trivially small independent partition selection problems compute route conditioned degradation schedules. Systematic experiments compare the proposed method against three baselines: a rule based nearest available dispatcher, an energy aware formulation that enforces battery feasibility without modeling degradation, and a charger unaware formulation that accounts for degradation but ignores shared charger capacity limits.
tldr: This paper addresses battery-health-aware task scheduling for autonomous mobile robot fleets by jointly optimizing task assignment, charging, and degradation across the fleet using a hierarchical matheuristic approach.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种针对自主移动机器人集群的电池健康感知任务调度方法，通过分层数学启发式方法联合优化任务分配、充电和整个集群的电池衰减。
summary_zh: 自主移动机器人集群需要在有限的共享资源下协调任务分配和充电，但大多数电池感知规划方法仅针对单个机器人。本文通过联合优化任务分配、服务排序、可选充电决策、充电模式选择和充电器访问，同时平衡整个集群的电池损耗，将面向损耗成本的任务规划扩展到多机器人环境。该公式依赖于基于经验电池老化文献的简化形式的损耗代理，捕捉了充电模式相关的损耗以及空闲状态下的电量相关老化；双线性空闲老化项通过分离的分段McCormick公式进行线性化。从实例数据导出的严格的Big M值强化了LP松弛。为了管理可扩展性，我们提出了一种分层元启发式方法，其中集群层面的主问题协调分配、路线和充电器使用，而机器人层面的子问题（其整数部分分解为微不足道的独立分区选择问题）计算路线条件下的损耗计划。系统性实验将所提出的方法与三个基线进行比较：基于规则的最近可用调度器、在不建模损耗的情况下强制执行电池可行性的能量感知公式，以及考虑损耗但忽略共享充电器容量限制的充电器非感知公式。

title: Allometric Scaling Laws for Bipedal Robots
summary: Scaling the design of robots up or down remains a fundamental challenge. While biological systems follow well-established isometric and allometric scaling laws relating mass, stride frequency, velocity, and torque, it is unclear how these relationships translate to robotic systems. In this paper, we generate similar allometric scaling laws for bipedal robots across three orders of magnitude in leg length. First, we conduct a review of legged robots from the literature and extract empirical relationships between leg length (L), body length, mass, and speed. These data show that robot mass scales more closely to L^2, in contrast to the L^3 scaling predicted by isometric scaling. We then perform controlled simulation studies in Drake using three variants of real quasi-passive, hip-actuated walkers with different foot geometries and control strategies. We evaluate the performance of each design scaled with leg length, L. Across all robots, walking velocity follows the expected L^(1/2) trend from dynamic similarity. Minimum required torque scales more closely with m*L than the isometric model of m*L^2. Foot geometry scaled proportionally with L^1. These results provide new insight into how robot designs allometrically scale to different sizes, and how that scaling is different from isometric or biological scaling laws.
tldr: This paper investigates allometric scaling laws for bipedal robots, revealing deviations from isometric and biological scaling, specifically in mass and torque scaling with leg length.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了双足机器人的异速生长比例定律，揭示了与等速生长和生物比例的不同之处，特别是在质量和扭矩随腿长的比例关系方面。
summary_zh: 缩放机器人设计的尺寸仍然是一个根本性的挑战。虽然生物系统遵循既定的等距缩放和异速生长缩放规律，将质量、步频、速度和扭矩联系起来，但尚不清楚这些关系如何转化为机器人系统。在本文中，我们为腿长跨越三个数量级的双足机器人生成了类似的异速生长缩放规律。首先，我们回顾了文献中的腿式机器人，并提取了腿长（L）、身体长度、质量和速度之间的经验关系。这些数据显示，机器人质量更接近于L^2缩放，这与等距缩放预测的L^3缩放形成对比。然后，我们利用Drake，对三种具有不同足端几何形状和控制策略的真实准被动、髋关节驱动的步行机器人的变体进行受控仿真研究。我们评估了每种设计随腿长L缩放后的性能。在所有机器人中，行走速度都符合动力相似性所预测的L^(1/2)趋势。所需最小扭矩的缩放更接近于m*L，而不是m*L^2的等距模型。足端几何形状与L^1成比例缩放。这些结果为机器人设计如何异速生长地缩放到不同尺寸提供了新的见解，以及这种缩放与等距缩放或生物缩放规律有何不同。

title: Biased Error Attribution in Multi-Agent Human-AI Systems Under Delayed Feedback
summary: Human decision-making is strongly influenced by cognitive biases, particularly under conditions of uncertainty and risk. While prior work has examined bias in single-step decisions with immediate outcomes and in human interaction with a single autonomous agent, comparatively little attention has been paid to decision-making under delayed outcomes involving multiple AI agents, where decisions at each step affect subsequent states. In this work, we study how delayed outcomes shape decision-making and responsibility attribution in a multi-agent human-AI task. Using a controlled game-based experiment, we analyze how participants adjust their behavior following positive and negative outcomes. We observe asymmetric responses to gains and losses, with stronger corrective adjustments after negative outcomes. Importantly, participants often fail to correctly identify the actions that caused failure and misattribute responsibility across AI agents, leading to systematic revisions of decisions that are weakly related to the underlying causes of poor performance. We refer to this phenomenon as a form of attribution bias, manifested as biased error attribution under delayed feedback. Our findings highlight how cognitive biases can be amplified in human-AI systems with delayed outcomes and multiple autonomous agents, underscoring the need for decision-support systems that better support causal understanding and learning over time.
tldr: This paper investigates how humans attribute responsibility in multi-agent human-AI systems with delayed feedback, revealing biased error attribution and highlighting the need for improved decision-support systems for causal understanding.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了在多智能体人机系统中，人类如何在延迟反馈下进行责任归因，揭示了有偏误的错误归因，并强调了改进决策支持系统以促进因果理解的必要性。
summary_zh: 人类决策深受认知偏差的影响，尤其是在不确定性和风险条件下。以往的研究主要集中于具有即时结果的单步决策以及人与单个自主智能体的交互中的偏差，而对涉及多个AI智能体的延迟结果下的决策行为关注较少，在这种情况下，每一步的决策都会影响后续状态。在这项工作中，我们研究了在多智能体人机协作任务中，延迟结果如何影响决策行为和责任归因。通过一项受控的基于游戏的实验，我们分析了参与者在经历积极和消极结果后如何调整其行为。我们观察到对收益和损失的反应不对称，在消极结果后会进行更强的修正性调整。重要的是，参与者经常无法正确识别导致失败的行为，并在AI智能体之间错误地进行责任归因，从而导致对与性能不佳的根本原因关联性较弱的决策进行系统性修正。我们将这种现象称为一种归因偏差，表现为在延迟反馈下有偏差的误差归因。我们的研究结果强调了在具有延迟结果和多个自主智能体的智能人机系统中，认知偏差是如何被放大的，这突显了对决策支持系统的需求，该系统能够更好地支持因果理解和长期学习。

title: AscendOptimizer: Episodic Agent for Ascend NPU Operator Optimization
summary: AscendC (Ascend C) operator optimization on Huawei Ascend neural processing units (NPUs) faces a two-fold knowledge bottleneck: unlike the CUDA ecosystem, there are few public reference implementations to learn from, and performance hinges on a coupled two-part artifact - a host-side tiling program that orchestrates data movement and a kernel program that schedules and pipelines instructions. We present AscendOptimizer, an episodic agent that bootstraps this missing expertise by turning execution into experience. On the host side, AscendOptimizer performs profiling-in-the-loop evolutionary search to discover valid and high-performing tiling and data-movement configurations directly from hardware feedback. On the kernel side, it mines transferable optimization motifs by rewinding optimized kernels - systematically de-optimizing them to synthesize instructive "bad-to-good" trajectories - and distills these motifs into a retrievable experience bank for guided rewriting. By alternating host tuning and kernel rewriting in a closed loop, AscendOptimizer steadily expands feasibility and pushes latency down. On a benchmark of 127 real AscendC operators, AscendOptimizer achieves a 1.19x geometric-mean speedup over the open-source baseline, with 49.61% of operators outperforming their references, outperforming strong agent and search baselines.
tldr: The paper introduces AscendOptimizer, an episodic agent for optimizing AscendC operators on Huawei NPUs by using reinforcement learning and evolutionary search for host-side tuning and kernel rewriting, achieving significant speedups compared to the open-source baseline.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了AscendOptimizer，一个episodic agent，通过强化学习和进化搜索来优化华为NPU上的AscendC算子，针对host端的调优和kernel的重写，与开源基线相比，实现了显著的加速。
summary_zh: 华为Ascend神经处理单元(NPU)上的AscendC算子优化面临着双重知识瓶颈：与CUDA生态系统不同，可供学习的公开参考实现很少，且性能取决于耦合的两部分制品—主机端分块程序（负责协调数据移动）和内核程序（负责调度和流水线指令）。我们提出了AscendOptimizer，一个情景智能体，通过将执行转化为经验来引导填补缺失的专业知识。在主机端，AscendOptimizer执行环路内分析的进化搜索，直接从硬件反馈中发现有效且高性能的分块和数据移动配置。在内核端，它通过回溯优化后的内核来挖掘可迁移的优化模式—系统性地对其进行去优化，以合成具有指导意义的“由坏到好”的轨迹—并将这些模式提炼成可检索的经验库，用于指导重写。通过在闭环中交替进行主机调优和内核重写，AscendOptimizer稳步扩展可行性并降低延迟。在一个包含127个真实AscendC算子的基准测试中，AscendOptimizer实现了相对于开源基线1.19倍的几何平均加速，其中49.61%的算子性能优于其参考实现，并优于强大的智能体和搜索基线。

title: Causal Discovery in Action: Learning Chain-Reaction Mechanisms from Interventions
summary: Causal discovery is challenging in general dynamical systems because, without strong structural assumptions, the underlying causal graph may not be identifiable even from interventional data. However, many real-world systems exhibit directional, cascade-like structure, in which components activate sequentially and upstream failures suppress downstream effects. We study causal discovery in such chain-reaction systems and show that the causal structure is uniquely identifiable from blocking interventions that prevent individual components from activating. We propose a minimal estimator with finite-sample guarantees, achieving exponential error decay and logarithmic sample complexity. Experiments on synthetic models and diverse chain-reaction environments demonstrate reliable recovery from a few interventions, while observational heuristics fail in regimes with delayed or overlapping causal effects.
tldr: This paper introduces a method for causal discovery in chain-reaction systems using blocking interventions, demonstrating unique identifiability and efficient recovery with few interventions.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种在链式反应系统中进行因果发现的方法，通过阻塞干预，证明了唯一可识别性，并通过少量干预实现了高效恢复。
summary_zh: 因果发现在一般动力学系统中极具挑战性，因为在缺乏强结构性假设的情况下，即使是干预数据也可能无法识别潜在的因果图。然而，许多现实世界系统表现出方向性的、级联式结构，其中组件按顺序激活，上游故障抑制下游效应。我们研究在这种链式反应系统中的因果发现，并证明因果结构可以从阻止单个组件激活的阻断干预中唯一地识别出来。我们提出一个具有有限样本保证的最小估计器，可实现指数级误差衰减和对数级样本复杂度。在合成模型和各种链式反应环境中的实验表明，可以通过少量干预可靠地恢复因果结构，而当因果效应存在延迟或重叠时，观察启发式方法则会失效。

title: Gau-Occ: Geometry-Completed Gaussians for Multi-Modal 3D Occupancy Prediction
summary: 3D semantic occupancy prediction is crucial for autonomous driving. While multi-modal fusion improves accuracy over vision-only methods, it typically relies on computationally expensive dense voxel or BEV tensors. We present Gau-Occ, a multi-modal framework that bypasses dense volumetric processing by modeling the scene as a compact collection of semantic 3D Gaussians. To ensure geometric completeness, we propose a LiDAR Completion Diffuser (LCD) that recovers missing structures from sparse LiDAR to initialize robust Gaussian anchors. Furthermore, we introduce Gaussian Anchor Fusion (GAF), which efficiently integrates multi-view image semantics via geometry-aligned 2D sampling and cross-modal alignment. By refining these compact Gaussian descriptors, Gau-Occ captures both spatial consistency and semantic discriminability. Extensive experiments across challenging benchmarks demonstrate that Gau-Occ achieves state-of-the-art performance with significant computational efficiency.
tldr: Gau-Occ is a multi-modal 3D occupancy prediction framework using semantic 3D Gaussians, enhanced by LiDAR completion and efficient cross-modal fusion, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy with reduced computation. It replaces computationally expensive voxel processing with a compact representation.
tldr_zh: Gau-Occ 是一种多模态 3D 语义占据预测框架，它使用语义 3D 高斯分布，并通过激光雷达补全和高效的跨模态融合来增强性能，以更低的计算成本实现了最先进的精度。它用紧凑的表示来取代计算量大的体素处理。
summary_zh: 3D语义占据预测对于自动驾驶至关重要。虽然多模态融合相比仅使用视觉的方法能够提高准确率，但它通常依赖于计算成本高昂的密集体素或BEV张量。我们提出了Gau-Occ，一种多模态框架，通过将场景建模为紧凑的语义3D高斯集合来绕过密集体积处理。为了确保几何完整性，我们提出了一种激光雷达补全扩散器（LCD），它可以从稀疏激光雷达中恢复缺失的结构，从而初始化稳健的高斯锚点。此外，我们引入了高斯锚点融合（GAF），它通过几何对齐的2D采样和跨模态对齐来高效地整合多视角图像语义。通过优化这些紧凑的高斯描述符，Gau-Occ能够捕捉空间一致性和语义可区分性。在具有挑战性的基准测试中进行的大量实验表明，Gau-Occ实现了最先进的性能，同时具有显著的计算效率。

title: FullCircle: Effortless 3D Reconstruction from Casual 360$^\circ$ Captures
summary: Radiance fields have emerged as powerful tools for 3D scene reconstruction. However, casual capture remains challenging due to the narrow field of view of perspective cameras, which limits viewpoint coverage and feature correspondences necessary for reliable camera calibration and reconstruction. While commercially available 360$^\circ$ cameras offer significantly broader coverage than perspective cameras for the same capture effort, existing 360$^\circ$ reconstruction methods require special capture protocols and pre-processing steps that undermine the promise of radiance fields: effortless workflows to capture and reconstruct 3D scenes. We propose a practical pipeline for reconstructing 3D scenes directly from raw 360$^\circ$ camera captures. We require no special capture protocols or pre-processing, and exhibit robustness to a prevalent source of reconstruction errors: the human operator that is visible in all 360$^\circ$ imagery. To facilitate evaluation, we introduce a multi-tiered dataset of scenes captured as raw dual-fisheye images, establishing a benchmark for robust casual 360$^\circ$ reconstruction. Our method significantly outperforms not only vanilla 3DGS for 360$^\circ$ cameras but also robust perspective baselines when perspective cameras are simulated from the same capture, demonstrating the advantages of 360$^\circ$ capture for casual reconstruction. Additional results are available at: https://theialab.github.io/fullcircle
tldr: The paper introduces FullCircle, a method for 3D scene reconstruction from casual 360° captures, which is robust to human presence and doesn't require special capture protocols or pre-processing, along with a new dataset for evaluation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了FullCircle，一种从随意360°拍摄中进行3D场景重建的方法。该方法对人物存在具有鲁棒性，并且不需要特殊的拍摄协议或预处理。同时，论文还提供了一个新的数据集用于评估。
summary_zh: 辐射场已成为强大的3D场景重建工具。然而，由于透视相机视野狭窄，限制了视角覆盖范围以及可靠相机标定和重建所需的特征对应关系，随意拍摄仍然具有挑战性。虽然市售的360°相机在相同的拍摄工作量下，比透视相机提供更广阔的覆盖范围，但现有的360°重建方法需要特殊的拍摄协议和预处理步骤，这破坏了辐射场的承诺：轻松地捕获和重建3D场景的工作流程。我们提出了一种实用的流水线，可以直接从原始360°相机拍摄重建3D场景。我们不需要特殊的拍摄协议或预处理，并且对一种常见的重建错误来源具有鲁棒性：出现在所有360°图像中的操作人员。为了方便评估，我们引入了一个多层数据集，其中包含了以原始双鱼眼图像捕获的场景，从而为鲁棒的随意360°重建建立了一个基准。我们的方法不仅显著优于针对360°相机的原始3D高斯泼溅，而且在从相同拍摄模拟透视相机时，也优于稳健的透视基线，表明了360°拍摄在随意重建方面的优势。更多结果请访问：https://theialab.github.io/fullcircle

title: A Schrödinger Eigenfunction Method for Long-Horizon Stochastic Optimal Control
summary: High-dimensional stochastic optimal control (SOC) becomes harder with longer planning horizons: existing methods scale linearly in the horizon $T$, with performance often deteriorating exponentially. We overcome these limitations for a subclass of linearly-solvable SOC problems-those whose uncontrolled drift is the gradient of a potential. In this setting, the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation reduces to a linear PDE governed by an operator $\mathcal{L}$. We prove that, under the gradient drift assumption, $\mathcal{L}$ is unitarily equivalent to a Schrödinger operator $\mathcal{S} = -Δ+ \mathcal{V}$ with purely discrete spectrum, allowing the long-horizon control to be efficiently described via the eigensystem of $\mathcal{L}$. This connection provides two key results: first, for a symmetric linear-quadratic regulator (LQR), $\mathcal{S}$ matches the Hamiltonian of a quantum harmonic oscillator, whose closed-form eigensystem yields an analytic solution to the symmetric LQR with \emph{arbitrary} terminal cost. Second, in a more general setting, we learn the eigensystem of $\mathcal{L}$ using neural networks. We identify implicit reweighting issues with existing eigenfunction learning losses that degrade performance in control tasks, and propose a novel loss function to mitigate this. We evaluate our method on several long-horizon benchmarks, achieving an order-of-magnitude improvement in control accuracy compared to state-of-the-art methods, while reducing memory usage and runtime complexity from $\mathcal{O}(Td)$ to $\mathcal{O}(d)$.
tldr: This paper presents a novel method for high-dimensional stochastic optimal control (SOC) problems using a Schrödinger Eigenfunction approach, achieving significant improvements in long-horizon control accuracy and efficiency compared to existing methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种使用薛定谔特征函数方法解决高维随机最优控制（SOC）问题的新方法，与现有方法相比，在长程控制精度和效率方面取得了显著提升。
summary_zh: 高维随机最优控制(SOC)随着规划时域 $T$ 的增长而变得更加困难：现有方法与时域 $T$ 成线性关系，且性能通常呈指数级下降。我们克服了线性可解 SOC 问题的一个子类的这些限制，该子类的无控漂移是一个势的梯度。在这种情况下，哈密顿-雅可比-贝尔曼方程简化为一个由算子 $\mathcal{L}$ 控制的线性 PDE。我们证明，在梯度漂移假设下，$\mathcal{L}$ 与一个具有纯粹离散谱系的薛定谔算子 $\mathcal{S} = -Δ+ \mathcal{V}$ 酉等价，从而允许通过 $\mathcal{L}$ 的本征系统有效描述长时域控制。这种联系提供了两个关键结果：首先，对于一个对称的线性二次调节器 (LQR)，$\mathcal{S}$ 与量子谐振子的哈密顿量相匹配，其封闭形式本征系统产生对称LQR的解析解，且具有\emph{任意}终端代价。其次，在更一般的设置中，我们使用神经网络学习 $\mathcal{L}$ 的本征系统。我们发现现有本征函数学习损失存在隐式重加权问题，这降低了控制任务的性能，并提出了一种新的损失函数来缓解这个问题。我们在几个长时域基准上评估了我们的方法，与最先进的方法相比，控制精度提高了一个数量级，同时将内存使用和运行时间复杂度从 $\mathcal{O}(Td)$ 降低到 $\mathcal{O}(d)$。

title: Planning over MAPF Agent Dependencies via Multi-Dependency PIBT
summary: Modern Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) algorithms must plan for hundreds to thousands of agents in congested environments within a second, requiring highly efficient algorithms. Priority Inheritance with Backtracking (PIBT) is a popular algorithm capable of effectively planning in such situations. However, PIBT is constrained by its rule-based planning procedure and lacks generality because it restricts its search to paths that conflict with at most one other agent. This limitation also applies to Enhanced PIBT (EPIBT), a recent extension of PIBT. In this paper, we describe a new perspective on solving MAPF by planning over agent dependencies. Taking inspiration from PIBT's priority inheritance logic, we define the concept of agent dependencies and propose Multi-Dependency PIBT (MD-PIBT) that searches over agent dependencies. MD-PIBT is a general framework where specific parameterizations can reproduce PIBT and EPIBT. At the same time, alternative configurations yield novel planning strategies that are not expressible by PIBT or EPIBT. Our experiments demonstrate that MD-PIBT effectively plans for as many as 10,000 homogeneous agents under various kinodynamic constraints, including pebble motion, rotation motion, and differential drive robots with speed and acceleration limits. We perform thorough evaluations on different variants of MAPF and find that MD-PIBT is particularly effective in MAPF with large agents.
tldr: The paper introduces Multi-Dependency PIBT (MD-PIBT), a new MAPF algorithm that generalizes and improves upon PIBT and EPIBT by planning over agent dependencies, showing effectiveness in large-scale scenarios with various kinodynamic constraints.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种新的多智能体路径规划算法MD-PIBT，它通过规划智能体依赖关系来泛化和改进PIBT和EPIBT，并在各种运动约束的大规模场景中显示出有效性。
summary_zh: 现代多智能体路径规划 (MAPF) 算法必须在一秒内为拥堵环境中的数百乃至数千个智能体进行规划，这需要高效的算法。 具有回溯功能的优先级继承 (PIBT) 是一种流行的算法，能够在这种情况下有效地进行规划。 然而，PIBT 受限于其基于规则的规划过程，并且缺乏通用性，因为它将其搜索限制在与最多一个其他智能体冲突的路径上。 这种限制也适用于 PIBT 的最新扩展版本，即增强型 PIBT (EPIBT)。 在本文中，我们描述了一种通过规划智能体依赖关系来解决 MAPF 的新视角。 受 PIBT 的优先级继承逻辑的启发，我们定义了智能体依赖关系的概念，并提出了在智能体依赖关系上进行搜索的多重依赖 PIBT (MD-PIBT)。 MD-PIBT 是一个通用框架，特定的参数化可以重现 PIBT 和 EPIBT。 同时，其他的配置会产生 PIBT 或 EPIBT 无法表达的新的规划策略。 我们的实验表明，MD-PIBT 能够有效地为多达 10,000 个具有各种运动学约束的同质智能体进行规划，包括卵石运动、旋转运动以及具有速度和加速度限制的差速驱动机器人。 我们对 MAPF 的不同变体进行了彻底的评估，并发现 MD-PIBT 在具有大型智能体的 MAPF 中特别有效。

title: Edge Radar Material Classification Under Geometry Shifts
summary: Material awareness can improve robotic navigation and interaction, particularly in conditions where cameras and LiDAR degrade. We present a lightweight mmWave radar material classification pipeline designed for ultra-low-power edge devices (TI IWRL6432), using compact range-bin intensity descriptors and a Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) for real-time inference. While the classifier reaches a macro-F1 of 94.2\% under the nominal training geometry, we observe a pronounced performance drop under realistic geometry shifts, including sensor height changes and small tilt angles. These perturbations induce systematic intensity scaling and angle-dependent radar cross section (RCS) effects, pushing features out of distribution and reducing macro-F1 to around 68.5\%. We analyze these failure modes and outline practical directions for improving robustness with normalization, geometry augmentation, and motion-aware features.
tldr: This paper presents a radar-based material classification system for edge devices, highlighting performance degradation under geometry shifts and suggesting methods to improve robustness. It focuses on a practical robotics challenge with a concrete, real-world sensor.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于边缘设备的基于雷达的材料分类系统，强调了几何位移下的性能下降，并提出了提高鲁棒性的方法。它侧重于一个实际的机器人挑战，采用了一种具体的现实世界传感器。
summary_zh: 材料感知可以提高机器人的导航和交互能力，尤其是在摄像头和激光雷达性能下降的情况下。我们提出了一种轻量级的毫米波雷达材料分类流水线，专为超低功耗边缘设备（TI IWRL6432）设计，它利用紧凑的距离单元强度描述符和一个多层感知机（MLP）进行实时推理。虽然分类器在标称训练几何条件下达到了94.2%的宏平均F1值，但我们观察到在真实的几何变化下，包括传感器高度变化和微小倾斜角度，性能显著下降。这些扰动会导致系统的强度缩放和角度相关的雷达散射截面（RCS）效应，将特征推出分布范围，并将宏平均F1值降低到大约68.5%。我们分析了这些失效模式，并概述了通过标准化、几何增强和运动感知特征来提高鲁棒性的实用方向。

title: Strain-Parameterized Coupled Dynamics and Dual-Camera Visual Servoing for Aerial Continuum Manipulators
summary: Tendon-driven aerial continuum manipulators (TD-ACMs) combine the maneuverability of uncrewed aerial vehicles (UAVs) with the compliance of lightweight continuum robots (CRs). Existing coupled dynamic modeling approaches for TD-ACMs incur high computational costs and do not explicitly account for aerial platform underactuation. To address these limitations, this paper presents a generalized dynamic formulation of a coupled TD-ACM with an underactuated base. The proposed approach integrates a strain-parameterized Cosserat rod model with a rigid-body model of the UAV into a unified Lagrangian ordinary differential equation (ODE) framework on $\mathrm{SE}(3)$, thereby eliminating computationally intensive symbolic derivations. Building upon the developed model, a robust dual-camera image-based visual servoing (IBVS) scheme is introduced. The proposed controller mitigates the field-of-view (FoV) limitations of conventional IBVS, compensates for attitude-induced image motion caused by UAV lateral dynamics, and incorporates a low-level adaptive controller to address modeling uncertainties with formal stability guarantees. Extensive simulations and experimental validation on a compact custom-built prototype demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed framework in real-world scenarios.
tldr: This paper presents a dynamic model and visual servoing control scheme for tendon-driven aerial continuum manipulators, addressing computational cost and underactuation challenges. They validate their approach with simulations and experiments on a custom-built prototype.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于腱驱动空中连续体机械臂的动态模型和视觉伺服控制方案，解决了计算成本和欠驱动的挑战。他们通过仿真和定制的原型实验验证了该方法的有效性。
summary_zh: 肌腱驱动空中连续体机械臂（TD-ACMs）结合了无人机（UAVs）的机动性和轻量级连续体机器人（CRs）的顺应性。现有的TD-ACMs耦合动力学建模方法计算成本高昂，且没有显式考虑空中平台的欠驱动特性。为了克服这些局限性，本文提出了一种具有欠驱动基座的耦合TD-ACM的广义动力学公式。该方法将应变参数化的科塞尔杆模型与无人机的刚体模型集成到一个统一的$\mathrm{SE}(3)$上的拉格朗日常微分方程（ODE）框架中，从而消除了计算密集型的符号推导。基于所建立的模型，引入了一种鲁棒的双目视觉图像伺服（IBVS）方案。所提出的控制器缓解了传统IBVS的视场（FoV）限制，补偿了由无人机横向动力学引起的姿态感应图像运动，并结合了一个低级自适应控制器，以解决具有形式稳定保证的建模不确定性。在紧凑型定制原型机上的大量仿真和实验验证表明，所提出的框架在实际场景中的有效性和鲁棒性。

title: Design Guidelines for Nonlinear Kalman Filters via Covariance Compensation
summary: Nonlinear extensions of the Kalman filter (KF), such as the extended Kalman filter (EKF) and the unscented Kalman filter (UKF), are indispensable for state estimation in complex dynamical systems, yet the conditions for a nonlinear KF to provide robust and accurate estimations remain poorly understood. This work proposes a theoretical framework that identifies the causes of failure and success in certain nonlinear KFs and establishes guidelines for their improvement. Central to our framework is the concept of covariance compensation: the deviation between the covariance predicted by a nonlinear KF and that of the EKF. With this definition and detailed theoretical analysis, we derive three design guidelines for nonlinear KFs: (i) invariance under orthogonal transformations, (ii) sufficient covariance compensation beyond the EKF baseline, and (iii) selection of compensation magnitude that favors underconfidence. Both theoretical analysis and empirical validation confirm that adherence to these principles significantly improves estimation accuracy, whereas fixed parameter choices commonly adopted in the literature are often suboptimal. The codes and the proofs for all the theorems in this paper are available at https://github.com/Shida-Jiang/Guidelines-for-Nonlinear-Kalman-Filters.
tldr: This paper proposes a theoretical framework and design guidelines based on covariance compensation for improving the robustness and accuracy of nonlinear Kalman filters, showing that adhering to these guidelines improves estimation accuracy significantly.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个理论框架和基于协方差补偿的设计指南, 用于提高非线性卡尔曼滤波器的鲁棒性和准确性, 表明遵循这些指南可以显著提高估计精度。
summary_zh: 卡尔曼滤波（KF）的非线性扩展，例如扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）和无迹卡尔曼滤波（UKF），对于复杂动力系统中的状态估计至关重要，然而，非线性KF能够提供稳健和准确估计的条件仍然知之甚少。本研究提出了一个理论框架，旨在识别某些非线性 KF 失败和成功的原因，并建立改进它们的指导原则。我们框架的核心是协方差补偿的概念：即非线性KF预测的协方差与EKF预测的协方差之间的偏差。基于此定义和详细的理论分析，我们推导出非线性 KF 的三个设计指导原则：（i）正交变换下的不变性，（ii）超过 EKF 基线的充分的协方差补偿，以及（iii）选择倾向于低置信度的补偿幅度。理论分析和实证验证均证实，遵守这些原则可显著提高估计精度，而文献中常用的固定参数选择通常是次优的。本文所有定理的代码和证明可在 https://github.com/Shida-Jiang/Guidelines-for-Nonlinear-Kalman-Filters 获取。

title: DecompGrind: A Decomposition Framework for Robotic Grinding via Cutting-Surface Planning and Contact-Force Adaptation
summary: Robotic grinding is widely used for shaping workpieces in manufacturing, but it remains difficult to automate this process efficiently. In particular, efficiently grinding workpieces of different shapes and material hardness is challenging because removal resistance varies with local contact conditions. Moreover, it is difficult to achieve accurate estimation of removal resistance and analytical modeling of shape transition, and learning-based approaches often require large amounts of training data to cover diverse processing conditions. To address these challenges, we decompose robotic grinding into two components: removal-shape planning and contact-force adaptation. Based on this formulation, we propose DecompGrind, a framework that combines Global Cutting-Surface Planning (GCSP) and Local Contact-Force Adaptation (LCFA). GCSP determines removal shapes through geometric analysis of the current and target shapes without learning, while LCFA learns a contact-force adaptation policy using bilateral control-based imitation learning during the grinding of each removal shape. This decomposition restricts learning to local contact-force adaptation, allowing the policy to be learned from a small number of demonstrations, while handling global shape transition geometrically. Experiments using a robotic grinding system and 3D-printed workpieces demonstrate efficient robotic grinding of workpieces having different shapes and material hardness while maintaining safe levels of contact force.
tldr: The paper introduces DecompGrind, a framework that decomposes robotic grinding into global cutting-surface planning and local contact-force adaptation, enabling efficient grinding of diverse workpieces with limited training data.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了DecompGrind，一个将机器人磨削分解为全局切割面规划和局部接触力适应的框架，从而能够在训练数据有限的情况下高效地磨削各种工件。
summary_zh: 机器人磨削广泛应用于制造中工件的成形，但实现该过程的有效自动化仍然困难。特别是，高效磨削具有不同形状和材料硬度的工件极具挑战性，因为去除阻力随局部接触条件而变化。此外，难以实现去除阻力的精确估计和形状过渡的分析建模，而基于学习的方法通常需要大量的训练数据来覆盖各种加工条件。为了应对这些挑战，我们将机器人磨削分解为两个组成部分：去除形状规划和接触力自适应。基于这个公式，我们提出了 DecompGrind，一个结合了全局切削面规划 (GCSP) 和局部接触力自适应 (LCFA) 的框架。GCSP 通过对当前和目标形状的几何分析来确定去除形状，而无需学习，LCFA 则在每个去除形状的磨削过程中，使用基于双边控制的模仿学习来学习接触力自适应策略。这种分解将学习限制在局部接触力自适应，使得策略能够从少量演示中学习，同时通过几何方式处理全局形状过渡。使用机器人磨削系统和 3D 打印工件进行的实验表明，能够在保持安全接触力水平的同时，对具有不同形状和材料硬度的工件进行高效的机器人磨削。

title: Instrument-Splatting++: Towards Controllable Surgical Instrument Digital Twin Using Gaussian Splatting
summary: High-quality and controllable digital twins of surgical instruments are critical for Real2Sim in robot-assisted surgery, as they enable realistic simulation, synthetic data generation, and perception learning under novel poses. We present Instrument-Splatting++, a monocular 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) framework that reconstructs surgical instruments as a fully controllable Gaussian asset with high fidelity. Our pipeline starts with part-wise geometry pretraining that injects CAD priors into Gaussian primitives and equips the representation with part-aware semantic rendering. Built on the pretrained model, we propose a semantics-aware pose estimation and tracking (SAPET) method to recover per-frame 6-DoF pose and joint angles from unposed endoscopic videos, where a gripper-tip network trained purely from synthetic semantics provides robust supervision and a loose regularization suppresses singular articulations. Finally, we introduce Robust Texture Learning (RTL), which alternates pose refinement and robust appearance optimization, mitigating pose noise during texture learning. The proposed framework can perform pose estimation and learn realistic texture from unposed videos. We validate our method on sequences extracted from EndoVis17/18, SAR-RARP, and an in-house dataset, showing superior photometric quality and improved geometric accuracy over state-of-the-art baselines. We further demonstrate a downstream keypoint detection task where unseen-pose data augmentation from our controllable instrument Gaussian improves performance.
tldr: The paper introduces Instrument-Splatting++, a 3D Gaussian Splatting framework for creating controllable digital twins of surgical instruments from monocular endoscopic videos, enabling realistic simulation and synthetic data generation for robot-assisted surgery.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了 Instrument-Splatting++，一个基于 3D 高斯溅射的框架，用于从单目内窥镜视频创建可控的手术器械数字孪生体，从而为机器人辅助手术实现逼真的模拟和合成数据生成。
summary_zh: 手术器械高质量且可控的数字孪生体对于机器人辅助手术中的Real2Sim至关重要，因为它们能够实现逼真的仿真、合成数据生成以及新姿态下的感知学习。我们提出 Instrument-Splatting++，这是一个单目3D高斯溅射 (3DGS) 框架，它将手术器械重建为具有高保真度且完全可控的高斯资产。我们的流程首先进行分部件的几何预训练，将CAD先验注入到高斯基元中，并为该表示赋予部件感知的语义渲染能力。在预训练模型的基础上，我们提出了一种语义感知的姿态估计和跟踪 (SAPET) 方法，从无姿态的内窥镜视频中恢复每帧的6自由度姿态和关节角度，其中一个纯粹从合成语义训练的夹爪末端网络提供了鲁棒的监督引导，而一个宽松的正则化抑制了奇异的关节运动。最后，我们引入了鲁棒纹理学习 (RTL)，它交替进行姿态细化和鲁棒外观优化，从而减轻纹理学习过程中的姿态噪声。所提出的框架可以执行姿态估计并从无姿态视频中学习逼真的纹理。我们在从 EndoVis17/18、SAR-RARP 和一个内部数据集提取的序列上验证了我们的方法，与最先进的基线方法相比，显示出卓越的光度质量和更高的几何精度。我们进一步展示了一个下游的关键点检测任务，其中来自我们可控器械高斯体的未见姿态数据增强提高了性能。

title: Human vs. NAO: A Computational-Behavioral Framework for Quantifying Social Orienting in Autism and Typical Development
summary: Responding to one's name is among the earliest-emerging social orienting behaviors and is one of the most prominent aspects in the detection of Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD). Typically developing children exhibit near-reflexive orienting to their name, whereas children with ASD often demonstrate reduced frequency, increased latency, or atypical patterns of response. In this study, we examine differential responsiveness to quantify name-calling stimuli delivered by both human agents and NAO, a humanoid robot widely employed in socially assistive interventions for autism. The analysis focuses on multiple behavioral parameters, including eye contact, response latency, head and facial orientation shifts, and duration of sustained interest. Video-based computational methods were employed, incorporating face detection, eye region tracking, and spatio-temporal facial analysis, to obtain fine-grained measures of children's responses. By comparing neurotypical and neuroatypical groups under controlled human-robot conditions, this work aims to understand how the source and modality of social cues affect attentional dynamics in name-calling contexts. The findings advance both the theoretical understanding of social orienting deficits in autism and the applied development of robot-assisted assessment tools.
tldr: This paper investigates how children with and without Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) respond to name-calling by humans and a NAO robot, analyzing behavioral parameters using computational methods. It aims to understand social orienting deficits and develop robot-assisted assessment tools.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了患有和未患有自闭症谱系障碍 (ASD) 的儿童如何对人类和 NAO 机器人发出的名字呼叫做出反应，并使用计算方法分析行为参数。旨在了解社交定向缺陷并开发机器人辅助评估工具。
summary_zh: 对自身名字的反应是最早出现的社交定向行为之一，也是自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）检测中最显著的方面之一。 典型发育的儿童表现出近乎反射性的对名字的定向，而患有自闭症谱系障碍的儿童通常表现出反应频率降低、潜伏期延长或非典型的反应模式。在本研究中，我们考察了不同个体对人类和NAO（一种广泛用于自闭症社交辅助干预的人形机器人）发出的呼名刺激的不同反应性。分析重点在于多个行为参数，包括眼神交流、反应潜伏期、头部和面部朝向变化以及持续兴趣的时长。采用基于视频的计算方法，结合人脸检测、眼部区域追踪和时空面部分析，以获得儿童反应的精细测量。通过在受控的人机交互条件下比较神经典型和神经非典型群体，这项工作旨在了解社交线索的来源和模态如何影响呼名情境中的注意力动态。研究结果既推进了对自闭症社交定向缺陷的理论理解，也促进了机器人辅助评估工具的应用开发。

title: Variable-Resolution Virtual Maps for Autonomous Exploration with Unmanned Surface Vehicles (USVs)
summary: Autonomous exploration by unmanned surface vehicles (USVs) in near-shore waters requires reliable localisation and consistent mapping over extended areas, but this is challenged by GNSS degradation, environment-induced localisation uncertainty, and limited on-board computation. Virtual map-based methods explicitly model localisation and mapping uncertainty by tightly coupling factor-graph SLAM with a map uncertainty criterion. However, their storage and computational costs scale poorly with fixed-resolution workspace discretisations, leading to inefficiency in large near-shore environments. Moreover, overvaluing feature-sparse open-water regions can increase the risk of SLAM failure as a result of imbalance between exploration and exploitation. To address these limitations, we propose a Variable-Resolution Virtual Map (VRVM), a computationally efficient method for representing map uncertainty using bivariate Gaussian virtual landmarks placed in the cells of an adaptive quadtree. The adaptive quadtree enables an area-weighted uncertainty representation that keeps coarse, far-field virtual landmarks deliberately uncertain while allocating higher resolution to information-dense regions, and reduces the sensitivity of the map valuation to local refinements of the tree. An expectation-maximisation (EM) planner is adopted to evaluate pose and map uncertainty along frontiers using the VRVM, balancing exploration and exploitation. We evaluate VRVM against several state-of-the-art exploration algorithms in the VRX Gazebo simulator, using a realistic marina environment across different testing scenarios with an increasing level of exploration difficulty. The results indicate that our method offers safer behaviour and better utilisation of on-board computation in GNSS-degraded near-shore environments.
tldr: The paper introduces a Variable-Resolution Virtual Map (VRVM) for autonomous USV exploration, addressing SLAM challenges in near-shore environments with limited computational resources and GNSS degradation by using an adaptive quadtree structure for efficient uncertainty representation and EM-based planning.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于无人水面艇(USV)自主探索的可变分辨率虚拟地图(VRVM)，通过使用自适应四叉树结构进行有效的不确定性表示和基于EM的规划，解决了在计算资源有限和GNSS退化的近岸环境中SLAM的挑战。
summary_zh: 无人水面艇（USV）在近岸水域的自主探索需要可靠的定位和扩展区域内的一致建图，但这受到GNSS性能下降、环境引起的定位不确定性和有限的机载计算能力的挑战。基于虚拟地图的方法通过将因子图SLAM与地图不确定性准则紧密耦合，明确地对定位和建图的不确定性进行建模。然而，它们的存储和计算成本随固定分辨率工作空间离散化而呈不良比例增长，导致大型近岸环境中的效率低下。此外，过度重视特征稀疏的开放水域区域可能会因探索和利用之间的不平衡而增加SLAM失败的风险。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种可变分辨率虚拟地图（VRVM），这是一种计算效率高的方法，它使用放置在自适应四叉树单元格中的双变量高斯虚拟地标来表示地图不确定性。自适应四叉树能够实现面积加权的不确定性表示，使粗略的远场虚拟地标保持故意的不确定性，同时将更高的分辨率分配给信息密集的区域，并降低地图评估对树局部细化的敏感性。采用期望最大化（EM）规划器，利用VRVM评估沿前沿的姿态和地图不确定性，从而平衡探索和利用。我们在VRX Gazebo模拟器中，使用一个真实的码头环境，在不同测试场景（具有增加的探索难度）中，针对几种最先进的探索算法评估了VRVM。结果表明，我们的方法在GNSS性能下降的近岸环境中提供了更安全的行为，并更好地利用了机载计算能力。

title: Trajectory Generation for Underactuated Soft Robot Manipulators using Discrete Elastic Rod Dynamics
summary: Soft robots are well suited for contact-rich tasks due to their compliance, yet this property makes accurate and tractable modeling challenging.
