Planning motions with dynamically-feasible trajectories requires models that capture arbitrary deformations, remain computationally efficient, and are compatible with underactuation. However, existing approaches balance these properties unevenly: continuum rod models provide physical accuracy but are computationally demanding, while reduced-order approximations improve efficiency at the cost of modeling fidelity. To address this, our work introduces a control-oriented reformulation of Discrete Elastic Rod (DER) dynamics for soft robots, and a method to generate trajectories with these dynamics. The proposed formulation yields a control-affine representation while preserving certain first-principles force-deformation relationships. As a result, the generated trajectories are both dynamically feasible and consistent with the underlying actuation assumptions. We present our trajectory generation framework and validate it experimentally on a pneumatic soft robotic limb. Hardware results demonstrate consistently improved trajectory tracking performance over a constant-curvature-based baseline, particularly under complex actuation conditions.
tldr: This paper presents a control-oriented reformulation of Discrete Elastic Rod dynamics for generating dynamically feasible trajectories for underactuated soft robots, demonstrating improved tracking performance compared to a constant-curvature baseline.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种面向控制的离散弹性杆动力学重构方法，用于为欠驱动软体机器人生成动态可行的轨迹，并展示了相对于恒定曲率基线改进的跟踪性能。
summary_zh: 软体机器人因其柔顺性而非常适合接触丰富的任务，然而，这种特性也使得精确且易于处理的建模具有挑战性。规划具有动态可行轨迹的运动需要能够捕捉任意形变、保持计算效率并与欠驱动兼容的模型。然而，现有的方法对这些特性进行了不均衡的权衡：连续体杆模型提供物理精度，但计算量大；而降阶近似提高了效率，但牺牲了建模保真度。为了解决这个问题，我们的工作引入了一种面向控制的软体机器人离散弹性杆（DER）动力学重构，以及一种利用这些动力学生成轨迹的方法。所提出的公式产生了一种控制仿射表示，同时保留了某些第一性原理的力-变形关系。因此，生成的轨迹既是动态可行的，也与底层驱动假设一致。我们提出了我们的轨迹生成框架，并在气动软体机器人肢体上进行了实验验证。硬件结果表明，在复杂的驱动条件下，与基于恒定曲率的基线相比，轨迹跟踪性能得到了持续改进。

title: Wake Up to the Past: Using Memory to Model Fluid Wake Effects on Robots
summary: Autonomous aerial and aquatic robots that attain mobility by perturbing their medium, such as multicopters and torpedoes, produce wake effects that act as disturbances for adjacent robots. Wake effects are hard to model and predict due to the chaotic spatio-temporal dynamics of the fluid, entangled with the physical geometry of the robots and their complex motion patterns. Data-driven approaches using neural networks typically learn a memory-less function that maps the current states of the two robots to a force observed by the "sufferer" robot. Such models often perform poorly in agile scenarios: since the wake effect has a finite propagation time, the disturbance observed by a sufferer robot is some function of relative states in the past. In this work, we present an empirical study of the properties a wake-effect predictor must satisfy to accurately model the interactions between two robots mediated by a fluid. We explore seven data-driven models designed to capture the spatio-temporal evolution of fluid wake effects in four different media. This allows us to introspect the models and analyze the reasons why certain features enable improved accuracy in prediction across predictors and fluids. As experimental validation, we develop a planar rectilinear gantry for two spinning monocopters to test in real-world data with feedback control. The conclusion is that support of history of previous states as input and transport delay prediction substantially helps to learn an accurate wake-effect predictor.
tldr: This paper investigates data-driven models for predicting wake effects between robots operating in fluids, showing that incorporating historical states and transport delay prediction significantly improves accuracy. They validate this in a real-world monocopter setup.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了用于预测流体中运行的机器人之间的尾流效应的数据驱动模型，结果表明，结合历史状态和传输延迟预测可以显著提高准确性。他们在现实世界中的单旋翼飞行器设置中验证了这一点。
summary_zh: 通过扰动介质来实现移动的自主空中和水下机器人，例如多旋翼飞行器和鱼雷，会产生尾流效应，对邻近机器人产生干扰。由于流体混沌的时空动力学，以及与机器人物理几何结构和复杂运动模式的缠绕，尾流效应难以建模和预测。采用神经网络的数据驱动方法通常学习一个无记忆函数，将两个机器人的当前状态映射到“受害者”机器人观察到的力。这类模型在敏捷场景中表现通常不佳：由于尾流效应具有有限的传播时间，受害者机器人观察到的扰动是过去相对状态的某种函数。在这项工作中，我们对尾流效应预测器必须满足的属性进行了实证研究，以准确模拟由流体介导的两个机器人之间的相互作用。我们探索了七种数据驱动模型，旨在捕捉四种不同介质中流体尾流效应的时空演变。这使我们能够反思这些模型，并分析为什么某些特征能够提高预测的准确性。作为实验验证，我们开发了一种用于两个旋转单旋翼飞行器的平面直线龙门架，以在具有反馈控制的真实世界数据中进行测试。结论是，对先前状态历史的支持作为输入和传输延迟预测，有助于学习一个准确的尾流效应预测器。

title: Mecha-nudges for Machines
summary: Nudges are subtle changes to the way choices are presented to human decision-makers (e.g., opt-in vs. opt-out by default) that shift behavior without restricting options or changing incentives. As AI agents increasingly make decisions in the same environments as humans, the presentation of choices may be optimized for machines as well as people. We introduce mecha-nudges: changes to how choices are presented that systematically influence AI agents without degrading the decision environment for humans. To formalize mecha-nudges, we combine the Bayesian persuasion framework with V-usable information, a generalization of Shannon information that is observer-relative. This yields a common scale (bits of usable information) for comparing a wide range of interventions, contexts, and models. Applying our framework to product listings on Etsy -- a global marketplace for independent sellers -- we find that following ChatGPT's release, listings have significantly more machine-usable information about product selection, consistent with systematic mecha-nudging.
tldr: This paper introduces 'mecha-nudges' - subtle changes in how choices are presented to AI agents, drawing from Bayesian persuasion and V-usable information theory, and applies it to Etsy product listings, finding evidence of increased machine-usable information after ChatGPT's release.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了“机器助推”——微妙地改变向人工智能代理呈现选择的方式，借鉴了贝叶斯说服和V可用信息理论，并将其应用于Etsy产品列表，发现ChatGPT发布后机器可用信息显著增加。
summary_zh: 助推是在不限制选项或改变激励措施的情况下改变人类决策者选择呈现方式（例如，默认选择加入与默认选择退出）的细微调整，从而改变行为。 随着人工智能代理越来越多地在与人类相同的环境中做出决策，对选择的呈现方式可能需要针对机器和人类进行优化。我们引入了机械助推：改变选择呈现方式，从而系统地影响人工智能代理，同时不降低人类的决策环境。为了形式化机械助推，我们将贝叶斯劝导框架与V-可用信息相结合，V-可用信息是香农信息的推广，是观察者相关的。这产生了一个通用的尺度（可用信息的比特数），用于比较各种干预措施、上下文和模型。 将我们的框架应用于Etsy（一个面向独立卖家的全球市场）上的产品列表，我们发现，在ChatGPT发布后，列表包含关于产品选择的更多机器可用信息，这与系统的机械助推相一致。

title: A Learning Method with Gap-Aware Generation for Heterogeneous DAG Scheduling
summary: Efficient scheduling of directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) in heterogeneous environments is challenging due to resource capacities and dependencies. In practice, the need for adaptability across environments with varying resource pools and task types, alongside rapid schedule generation, complicates these challenges. We propose WeCAN, an end-to-end reinforcement learning framework for heterogeneous DAG scheduling that addresses task--pool compatibility coefficients and generation-induced optimality gaps. It adopts a two-stage single-pass design: a single forward pass produces task--pool scores and global parameters, followed by a generation map that constructs schedules without repeated network calls. Its weighted cross-attention encoder models task--pool interactions gated by compatibility coefficients, and is size-agnostic to environment fluctuations. Moreover, widely used list-scheduling maps can incur generation-induced optimality gaps from restricted reachability. We introduce an order-space analysis that characterizes the reachable set of generation maps via feasible schedule orders, explains the mechanism behind generation-induced gaps, and yields sufficient conditions for gap elimination. Guided by these conditions, we design a skip-extended realization with an analytically parameterized decreasing skip rule, which enlarges the reachable order set while preserving single-pass efficiency. Experiments on computation graphs and real-world TPC-H DAGs demonstrate improved makespan over strong baselines, with inference time comparable to classical heuristics and faster than multi-round neural schedulers.
tldr: The paper proposes WeCAN, a reinforcement learning framework for heterogeneous DAG scheduling that aims to minimize makespan by addressing task-pool compatibility and generation-induced optimality gaps, achieving improved performance with fast inference.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了WeCAN，一个用于异构DAG调度的强化学习框架，旨在通过解决任务池兼容性和生成引起的优化差距来最小化完工时间，并在快速推理中实现性能提升。
summary_zh: 在异构环境中高效调度有向无环图 (DAG) 面临着资源容量和依赖关系的挑战。 实践中，对具备不同资源池和任务类型的环境的适应性需求，以及快速生成调度的需求，使这些挑战更加复杂。 我们提出 WeCAN，一个端到端的强化学习框架，用于异构 DAG 调度，解决了任务-资源池兼容性系数和生成诱导的最优性差距问题。 它采用两阶段单通道设计：单个前向传播产生任务-资源池分数和全局参数，然后使用生成映射构建调度，无需重复网络调用。 其加权交叉注意力编码器对由兼容性系数门控的任务-资源池交互进行建模，并且对环境波动具有尺寸无关性。 此外，广泛使用的列表调度映射可能因受限的可达性而导致生成诱导的最优性差距。 我们引入了一种顺序空间分析，通过可行的调度顺序来表征生成映射的可达集合，解释了生成诱导差距背后的机制，并为消除差距提供了充分条件。 在这些条件的指导下，我们设计了一个跳跃扩展实现，具有一个解析参数化的递减跳跃规则，它在保持单通道效率的同时扩大了可达顺序集合。 在计算图和真实世界的 TPC-H DAG 上的实验表明，与强大的基线相比，makespan 有所改进，推断时间与经典启发式算法相当，并且比多轮神经网络调度器更快。

title: Mind Your HEARTBEAT! Claw Background Execution Inherently Enables Silent Memory Pollution
summary: We identify a critical security vulnerability in mainstream Claw personal AI agents: untrusted content encountered during heartbeat-driven background execution can silently pollute agent memory and subsequently influence user-facing behavior without the user's awareness. This vulnerability arises from an architectural design shared across the Claw ecosystem: heartbeat background execution runs in the same session as user-facing conversation, so content ingested from any external source monitored in the background (including email, message channels, news feeds, code repositories, and social platforms) can enter the same memory context used for foreground interaction, often with limited user visibility and without clear source provenance. We formalize this process as an Exposure (E) $\rightarrow$ Memory (M) $\rightarrow$ Behavior (B) pathway: misinformation encountered during heartbeat execution enters the agent's short-term session context, potentially gets written into long-term memory, and later shapes downstream user-facing behavior. We instantiate this pathway in an agent-native social setting using MissClaw, a controlled research replica of Moltbook. We find that (1) social credibility cues, especially perceived consensus, are the dominant driver of short-term behavioral influence, with misleading rates up to 61%; (2) routine memory-saving behavior can promote short-term pollution into durable long-term memory at rates up to 91%, with cross-session behavioral influence reaching 76%; (3) under naturalistic browsing with content dilution and context pruning, pollution still crosses session boundaries. Overall, prompt injection is not required: ordinary social misinformation is sufficient to silently shape agent memory and behavior under heartbeat-driven background execution.
tldr: The paper identifies a security vulnerability in Claw personal AI agents where background execution silently pollutes memory, influencing user-facing behavior through ordinary social misinformation, without requiring prompt injection.
tldr_zh: 该论文发现Claw个人AI代理中的一个安全漏洞：心跳驱动的后台执行会悄无声息地污染内存，通过普通的社交错误信息影响面向用户的行为，而不需要提示注入。
summary_zh: 我们识别出主流 Claw 个人 AI 代理中一项关键的安全漏洞：心跳驱动的后台执行过程中遇到的不受信任的内容，可以在用户不知情的情况下静默地污染代理的记忆，并随后影响面向用户的行为。此漏洞源于 Claw 生态系统中共享的架构设计：心跳后台执行与面向用户的对话在同一会话中运行，因此从后台监控的任何外部来源（包括电子邮件、消息通道、新闻订阅、代码存储库和社交平台）摄取的内容，都可以进入用于前台交互的同一记忆上下文，通常用户可见性有限，且没有清晰的来源出处。我们将此过程形式化为一个暴露 (E) → 记忆 (M) → 行为 (B) 的路径：心跳执行期间遇到的错误信息进入代理的短期会话上下文，可能被写入长期记忆，并在之后影响下游的面向用户的行为。我们使用 MissClaw（Moltbook 的受控研究副本）在代理原生社交环境中实例化此路径。我们发现 (1) 社交可信度线索，尤其是感知到的共识，是短期行为影响的主要驱动因素，误导率高达 61%；(2) 常规的记忆保存行为可以将短期污染提升为持久的长期记忆，比率高达 91%，跨会话的行为影响达到 76%；(3) 在内容稀释和上下文修剪的自然浏览情况下，污染仍然会跨越会话边界。总而言之，不需要提示注入：普通社交错误信息足以在心跳驱动的后台执行下静默地塑造代理的记忆和行为。

title: Concept-based explanations of Segmentation and Detection models in Natural Disaster Management
summary: Deep learning models for flood and wildfire segmentation and object detection enable precise, real-time disaster localization when deployed on embedded drone platforms. However, in natural disaster management, the lack of transparency in their decision-making process hinders human trust required for emergency response. To address this, we present an explainability framework for understanding flood segmentation and car detection predictions on the widely used PIDNet and YOLO architectures. More specifically, we introduce a novel redistribution strategy that extends Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP) explanations for sigmoid-gated element-wise fusion layers. This extension allows LRP relevances to flow through the fusion modules of PIDNet, covering the entire computation graph back to the input image. Furthermore, we apply Prototypical Concept-based Explanations (PCX) to provide both local and global explanations at the concept level, revealing which learned features drive the segmentation and detection of specific disaster semantic classes. Experiments on a publicly available flood dataset show that our framework provides reliable and interpretable explanations while maintaining near real-time inference capabilities, rendering it suitable for deployment on resource-constrained platforms, such as Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs).
tldr: The paper presents an explainability framework for deep learning models used in natural disaster management, specifically flood segmentation and car detection, by extending Layer-wise Relevance Propagation and applying Prototypical Concept-based Explanations.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个用于自然灾害管理中深度学习模型的可解释性框架，特别是洪水分割和车辆检测，通过扩展逐层相关性传播并应用原型概念解释来实现。
summary_zh: 用于洪水和野火分割以及目标检测的深度学习模型，在部署于嵌入式无人机平台时，能够实现精确、实时的灾害定位。然而，在自然灾害管理中，其决策过程缺乏透明度阻碍了紧急响应所需的人工信任。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一个可解释性框架，用于理解广泛使用的 PIDNet 和 YOLO 架构上的洪水分割和车辆检测预测。更具体地说，我们引入了一种新颖的重分布策略，扩展了层级相关性传播 (LRP) 解释，以适用于 Sigmoid 门控的元素级融合层。这种扩展使得 LRP 相关性能够流经 PIDNet 的融合模块，覆盖整个计算图直至输入图像。此外，我们应用原型概念解释 (PCX) 以提供概念级别的局部和全局解释，从而揭示哪些学习到的特征驱动了特定灾害语义类别的分割和检测。在公开的洪水数据集上的实验表明，我们的框架提供了可靠且可解释的解释，同时保持了接近实时的推理能力，使其适合部署在资源受限的平台，例如无人驾驶飞行器 (UAV)。

title: UAV-DETR: DETR for Anti-Drone Target Detection
summary: Drone detection is pivotal in numerous security and counter-UAV applications. However, existing deep learning-based methods typically struggle to balance robust feature representation with computational efficiency. This challenge is particularly acute when detecting miniature drones against complex backgrounds under severe environmental interference. To address these issues, we introduce UAV-DETR, a novel framework that integrates a small-target-friendly architecture with real-time detection capabilities. Specifically, UAV-DETR features a WTConv-enhanced backbone and a Sliding Window Self-Attention (SWSA-IFI) encoder, capturing the high-frequency structural details of tiny targets while drastically reducing parameter overhead. Furthermore, we propose an Efficient Cross-Scale Feature Recalibration and Fusion Network (ECFRFN) to suppress background noise and aggregate multi-scale semantics. To further enhance accuracy, UAV-DETR incorporates a hybrid Inner-CIoU and NWD loss strategy, mitigating the extreme sensitivity of standard IoU metrics to minor positional deviations in small objects. Extensive experiments demonstrate that UAV-DETR significantly outperforms the baseline RT-DETR on our custom UAV dataset (+6.61% in mAP50:95, with a 39.8% reduction in parameters) and the public DUT-ANTI-UAV benchmark (+1.4% in Precision, +1.0% in F1-Score). These results establish UAV-DETR as a superior trade-off between efficiency and precision in counter-UAV object detection. The code is available at https://github.com/wd-sir/UAVDETR.
tldr: UAV-DETR is a novel DETR-based framework for anti-drone target detection that achieves superior performance and efficiency compared to RT-DETR by integrating a small-target-friendly architecture, feature recalibration, and a hybrid loss strategy.
tldr_zh: UAV-DETR是一个新颖的基于DETR的无人机目标检测框架，通过集成对小目标友好的架构、特征重新校准和混合损失策略，实现了比RT-DETR更卓越的性能和效率。
summary_zh: 无人机检测在众多安全和反无人机应用中至关重要。然而，现有的基于深度学习的方法通常难以在鲁棒的特征表示与计算效率之间取得平衡。在复杂背景和严重环境干扰下检测微型无人机时，这一挑战尤为严峻。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种名为UAV-DETR的新型框架，该框架集成了对小目标友好的架构和实时检测能力。具体而言，UAV-DETR采用了WTConv增强的骨干网络和滑动窗口自注意力（SWSA-IFI）编码器，在大幅降低参数开销的同时，捕获微小目标的高频结构细节。此外，我们提出了一种高效的跨尺度特征重校准和融合网络（ECFRFN）来抑制背景噪声并聚合多尺度语义。为了进一步提高准确率，UAV-DETR整合了一种混合的Inner-CIoU和NWD损失策略，以减轻标准IoU指标对小物体轻微位置偏差的极端敏感性。大量实验表明，UAV-DETR在我们的自定义无人机数据集上明显优于基线RT-DETR（mAP50:95提升6.61%，参数量减少39.8%），并在公开的DUT-ANTI-UAV基准测试中表现出色（精确度提升1.4%，F1-Score提升1.0%）。这些结果确立了UAV-DETR作为反无人机目标检测中效率和精度之间卓越权衡的地位。代码可在https://github.com/wd-sir/UAVDETR获取。

title: From Overload to Convergence: Supporting Multi-Issue Human-AI Negotiation with Bayesian Visualization
summary: As AI systems increasingly mediate negotiations, understanding how the number of negotiated issues impacts human performance is crucial for maintaining human agency. We designed a human-AI negotiation case study in a realistic property rental scenario, varying the number of negotiated issues; empirical findings show that without support, performance stays stable up to three issues but declines as additional issues increase cognitive load. To address this, we introduce a novel uncertainty-based visualization driven by Bayesian estimation of agreement probability. It shows how the space of mutually acceptable agreements narrows as negotiation progresses, helping users identify promising options. In a within-subjects experiment (N=32), it improved human outcomes and efficiency, preserved human control, and avoided redistributing value. Our findings surface practical limits on the complexity people can manage in human-AI negotiation, advance theory on human performance in complex negotiations, and offer validated design guidance for interactive systems.
tldr: This paper investigates the impact of negotiating multiple issues in human-AI negotiations and introduces a Bayesian visualization to improve human performance by reducing cognitive load, demonstrating improved outcomes and efficiency.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了人机谈判中多议题谈判的影响，并引入了一种贝叶斯可视化方法，通过减少认知负荷来提高人类的表现，实验证明该方法改善了结果和效率。
summary_zh: 随着人工智能系统越来越多地参与协调谈判，理解谈判议题的数量如何影响人类表现对于维护人类自主性至关重要。我们设计了一个基于真实房产租赁场景的人机谈判案例研究，并改变了谈判议题的数量。经验结果表明，在没有辅助的情况下，人类在三个议题及以内时表现保持稳定，但随着议题数量增加，认知负荷加重，表现会下降。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了一种新颖的基于不确定性的可视化方法，它由协议概率的贝叶斯估计驱动。该可视化方法展现了随着谈判的进行，相互可接受协议的空间如何缩小，从而帮助用户识别有希望的选项。在一个被试内实验（N=32）中，该方法提升了人类的谈判结果和效率，保持了人类的控制权，并避免了价值的重新分配。我们的研究结果揭示了人们在人机谈判中能够管理的复杂性的实际限制，推进了复杂谈判中人类表现的理论，并为交互系统提供了经过验证的设计指导。

title: TETO: Tracking Events with Teacher Observation for Motion Estimation and Frame Interpolation
summary: Event cameras capture per-pixel brightness changes with microsecond resolution, offering continuous motion information lost between RGB frames. However, existing event-based motion estimators depend on large-scale synthetic data that often suffers from a significant sim-to-real gap. We propose TETO (Tracking Events with Teacher Observation), a teacher-student framework that learns event motion estimation from only $\sim$25 minutes of unannotated real-world recordings through knowledge distillation from a pretrained RGB tracker. Our motion-aware data curation and query sampling strategy maximizes learning from limited data by disentangling object motion from dominant ego-motion. The resulting estimator jointly predicts point trajectories and dense optical flow, which we leverage as explicit motion priors to condition a pretrained video diffusion transformer for frame interpolation. We achieve state-of-the-art point tracking on EVIMO2 and optical flow on DSEC using orders of magnitude less training data, and demonstrate that accurate motion estimation translates directly to superior frame interpolation quality on BS-ERGB and HQ-EVFI.
tldr: This paper introduces TETO, a teacher-student framework for event-based motion estimation using knowledge distillation from an RGB tracker on real-world data, achieving SOTA results on point tracking and optical flow, leading to improved frame interpolation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了TETO，一个基于教师-学生框架的事件运动估计方法，它使用来自RGB跟踪器的知识蒸馏在真实世界数据上训练，在点跟踪和光流方面取得了SOTA结果，并改善了帧插值效果。
summary_zh: 事件相机以微秒级分辨率捕捉每个像素的亮度变化，从而提供RGB帧之间丢失的连续运动信息。然而，现有的基于事件的运动估计器依赖于大规模的合成数据，这些数据通常存在显著的模拟到真实（sim-to-real）的差距。我们提出了TETO（通过教师观测追踪事件），一种师生框架，仅使用约25分钟的未标注真实世界录像，通过从预训练的RGB追踪器进行知识蒸馏来学习事件运动估计。我们的运动感知数据管理和查询采样策略通过将物体运动与主要自我运动解耦，最大限度地利用有限的数据进行学习。由此产生的估计器联合预测点轨迹和稠密光流，我们将其作为显式的运动先验来调节一个预训练的视频扩散Transformer，用于帧插值。我们使用数量级更少的训练数据，在EVIMO2上实现了最先进的点追踪性能，在DSEC上实现了最先进的光流性能，并证明了准确的运动估计直接转化为在BS-ERGB和HQ-EVFI上更优越的帧插值质量。

title: Pose-Free Omnidirectional Gaussian Splatting for 360-Degree Videos with Consistent Depth Priors
summary: Omnidirectional 3D Gaussian Splatting with panoramas is a key technique for 3D scene representation, and existing methods typically rely on slow SfM to provide camera poses and sparse points priors. In this work, we propose a pose-free omnidirectional 3DGS method, named PFGS360, that reconstructs 3D Gaussians from unposed omnidirectional videos. To achieve accurate camera pose estimation, we first construct a spherical consistency-aware pose estimation module, which recovers poses by establishing consistent 2D-3D correspondences between the reconstructed Gaussians and the unposed images using Gaussians' internal depth priors. Besides, to enhance the fidelity of novel view synthesis, we introduce a depth-inlier-aware densification module to extract depth inliers and Gaussian outliers with consistent monocular depth priors, enabling efficient Gaussian densification and achieving photorealistic novel view synthesis. The experiments show significant outperformance over existing pose-free and pose-aware 3DGS methods on both real-world and synthetic 360-degree videos. Code is available at https://github.com/zcq15/PFGS360.
tldr: The paper presents PFGS360, a pose-free method for reconstructing 3D Gaussian splats from unposed 360-degree videos, using spherical consistency and depth priors for accurate pose estimation and novel view synthesis.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了PFGS360，一种无需姿态的方法，用于从无姿态的360度视频中重建3D高斯溅射，使用球面一致性和深度先验来实现精确的姿态估计和新视角合成。
summary_zh: 基于全景图的无指向性3D高斯溅射是3D场景表示的关键技术。现有方法通常依赖缓慢的SfM来提供相机位姿和稀疏点先验。 在这项工作中，我们提出了一种无位姿的无指向性3DGS方法，名为PFGS360，它可以从无位姿的全指向视频中重建3D高斯分布。为了实现精确的相机位姿估计，我们首先构建了一个球面一致性感知位姿估计模块，该模块通过在重建的高斯分布和无位姿图像之间建立一致的2D-3D对应关系（利用高斯内部深度先验）来恢复位姿。此外，为了增强新视角合成的保真度，我们引入了一个深度内点感知稠密化模块，以提取具有一致单目深度先验的深度内点和高斯离群点，从而实现高效的高斯稠密化并获得逼真的新视角合成效果。实验表明，在真实和合成的360度视频上，该方法显著优于现有的无位姿和有位姿3DGS方法。代码可在https://github.com/zcq15/PFGS360获取。

title: CCF: Complementary Collaborative Fusion for Domain Generalized Multi-Modal 3D Object Detection
summary: Multi-modal fusion has emerged as a promising paradigm for accurate 3D object detection. However, performance degrades substantially when deployed in target domains different from training. In this work, focusing on dual-branch proposal-level detectors, we identify two factors that limit robust cross-domain generalization: 1) in challenging domains such as rain or nighttime, one modality may undergo severe degradation; 2) the LiDAR branch often dominates the detection process, leading to systematic underutilization of visual cues and vulnerability when point clouds are compromised. To address these challenges, we propose three components. First, Query-Decoupled Loss provides independent supervision for 2D-only, 3D-only, and fused queries, rebalancing gradient flow across modalities. Second, LiDAR-Guided Depth Prior augments 2D queries with instance-aware geometric priors through probabilistic fusion of image-predicted and LiDAR-derived depth distributions, improving their spatial initialization. Third, Complementary Cross-Modal Masking applies complementary spatial masks to the image and point cloud, encouraging queries from both modalities to compete within the fused decoder and thereby promoting adaptive fusion. Extensive experiments demonstrate substantial gains over state-of-the-art baselines while preserving source-domain performance. Code and models are publicly available at https://github.com/IMPL-Lab/CCF.
tldr: This paper addresses the domain generalization problem in multi-modal 3D object detection by proposing a complementary collaborative fusion (CCF) approach, using techniques like query-decoupled loss, LiDAR-guided depth priors, and complementary cross-modal masking to improve robustness across different domains.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种互补协作融合（CCF）方法，通过使用查询解耦损失、LiDAR引导的深度先验和互补跨模态掩蔽等技术，解决了多模态 3D 对象检测中的域泛化问题，从而提高了在不同域中的鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 多模态融合已成为实现精确3D目标检测的一种有前景的范例。然而，当部署于与训练集不同的目标域时，性能会显著下降。在这项工作中，我们专注于双分支提案级检测器，并识别出限制其鲁棒跨域泛化的两个因素：1）在诸如雨天或夜间等具有挑战性的领域中，一种模态可能会经历严重的退化；2）LiDAR分支通常主导检测过程，导致视觉线索的系统性利用不足，以及在点云受损时的脆弱性。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了三个组成部分。首先，查询解耦损失为仅2D、仅3D和融合查询提供独立的监督，从而重新平衡跨模态的梯度流。其次，LiDAR引导的深度先验通过图像预测和LiDAR推导的深度分布的概率融合，利用实例感知的几何先验来增强2D查询，从而改善它们的空间初始化。第三，互补的跨模态掩码将互补的空间掩码应用于图像和点云，鼓励来自两种模态的查询在融合解码器中竞争，从而促进自适应融合。大量的实验表明，与最先进的基线相比，该方法取得了显著的增益，同时保留了源域的性能。代码和模型已公开，网址为https://github.com/IMPL-Lab/CCF。

title: PoseDriver: A Unified Approach to Multi-Category Skeleton Detection for Autonomous Driving
summary: Object skeletons offer a concise representation of structural information, capturing essential aspects of posture and orientation that are crucial for autonomous driving applications. However, a unified architecture that simultaneously handles multiple instances and categories using only the input image remains elusive. In this paper, we introduce PoseDriver, a unified framework for bottom-up multi-category skeleton detection tailored to common objects in driving scenarios. We model each category as a distinct task to systematically address the challenges of multi-task learning. Specifically, we propose a novel approach for lane detection based on skeleton representations, achieving state-of-the-art performance on the OpenLane dataset. Moreover, we present a new dataset for bicycle skeleton detection and assess the transferability of our framework to novel categories. Experimental results validate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.
tldr: PoseDriver introduces a unified, bottom-up framework for multi-category skeleton detection in autonomous driving, achieving state-of-the-art lane detection using skeleton representations and providing a new bicycle skeleton dataset.
tldr_zh: PoseDriver 提出了一个统一的、自下而上的框架，用于自动驾驶中的多类别骨骼检测。它使用骨骼表示实现了最先进的 lane 检测，并提供了一个新的自行车骨骼数据集。
summary_zh: 对象骨架提供了一种简洁的结构信息表示，捕捉姿态和方向的关键方面，这对于自动驾驶应用至关重要。然而，一个仅使用输入图像就能同时处理多个实例和类别的统一架构仍然难以实现。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为PoseDriver的统一框架，用于自底向上的多类别骨架检测，专门针对驾驶场景中的常见对象。我们将每个类别建模为不同的任务，以系统地解决多任务学习的挑战。具体而言，我们提出了一种基于骨架表示的车道线检测新方法，在OpenLane数据集上实现了最先进的性能。此外，我们提出了一个新的自行车骨架检测数据集，并评估了我们的框架向新类别的可迁移性。实验结果验证了所提出方法的有效性。

title: PhysSkin: Real-Time and Generalizable Physics-Based Animation via Self-Supervised Neural Skinning
summary: Achieving real-time physics-based animation that generalizes across diverse 3D shapes and discretizations remains a fundamental challenge. We introduce PhysSkin, a physics-informed framework that addresses this challenge. In the spirit of Linear Blend Skinning, we learn continuous skinning fields as basis functions lifting motion subspace coordinates to full-space deformation, with subspace defined by handle transformations. To generate mesh-free, discretization-agnostic, and physically consistent skinning fields that generalize well across diverse 3D shapes, PhysSkin employs a new neural skinning fields autoencoder which consists of a transformer-based encoder and a cross-attention decoder. Furthermore, we also develop a novel physics-informed self-supervised learning strategy that incorporates on-the-fly skinning-field normalization and conflict-aware gradient correction, enabling effective balancing of energy minimization, spatial smoothness, and orthogonality constraints. PhysSkin shows outstanding performance on generalizable neural skinning and enables real-time physics-based animation.
tldr: PhysSkin introduces a physics-informed neural skinning framework for real-time and generalizable physics-based animation across diverse 3D shapes, using self-supervised learning and a novel neural skinning fields autoencoder.
tldr_zh: PhysSkin 引入了一种物理信息驱动的神经蒙皮框架，用于跨各种 3D 形状的实时和可泛化的基于物理的动画，它使用自监督学习和一种新型的神经蒙皮场自动编码器。
summary_zh: 实现能够泛化到不同3D形状和离散化的实时物理动画仍然是一项根本挑战。我们引入了PhysSkin，一个解决此挑战的物理信息框架。秉承线性混合蒙皮的精神，我们将连续蒙皮场学习为基函数，将运动子空间坐标提升到全空间变形，而子空间由控制柄变换定义。为了生成无网格、与离散化无关且物理一致的蒙皮场，并使其能够很好地泛化到不同的3D形状，PhysSkin采用了一种新的神经蒙皮场自编码器，该自编码器由一个基于Transformer的编码器和一个交叉注意力解码器组成。此外，我们还开发了一种新颖的物理信息自监督学习策略，该策略结合了动态蒙皮场归一化和冲突感知梯度校正，能够有效地平衡能量最小化、空间平滑度和正交性约束。PhysSkin在可泛化的神经蒙皮方面表现出卓越的性能，并支持实时物理动画。

title: MultiCam: On-the-fly Multi-Camera Pose Estimation Using Spatiotemporal Overlaps of Known Objects
summary:
Multi-camera dynamic Augmented Reality (AR) applications require a camera pose estimation to leverage individual information from each camera in one common system. This can be achieved by combining contextual information, such as markers or objects, across multiple views. While commonly cameras are calibrated in an initial step or updated through the constant use of markers, another option is to leverage information already present in the scene, like known objects. Another downside of marker-based tracking is that markers have to be tracked inside the field-of-view (FoV) of the cameras.
  To overcome these limitations, we propose a constant dynamic camera pose estimation leveraging spatiotemporal FoV overlaps of known objects on the fly. To achieve that, we enhance the state-of-the-art object pose estimator to update our spatiotemporal scene graph, enabling a relation even among non-overlapping FoV cameras. To evaluate our approach, we introduce a multi-camera, multi-object pose estimation dataset with temporal FoV overlap, including static and dynamic cameras. Furthermore, in FoV overlapping scenarios, we outperform the state-of-the-art on the widely used YCB-V and T-LESS dataset in camera pose accuracy. Our performance on both previous and our proposed datasets validates the effectiveness of our marker-less approach for AR applications.
  The code and dataset are available on https://github.com/roth-hex-lab/IEEE-VR-2026-MultiCam.
tldr: The paper introduces a marker-less multi-camera pose estimation method for AR applications by leveraging spatiotemporal overlaps of known objects. They enhance an object pose estimator to create a scene graph that relates cameras even with non-overlapping fields of view and provide a new dataset for evaluation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于AR应用的无标记多摄像头姿态估计方法，通过利用已知物体的时空重叠。他们增强了一个物体姿态估计器，创建了一个场景图，即使在视野不重叠的摄像头之间也能建立关联，并提供了一个新的数据集用于评估。
summary_zh:
多摄像头动态增强现实（AR）应用需要相机姿态估计，以便在一个通用系统中利用来自每个摄像头的独立信息。这可以通过结合跨多个视角的上下文信息（如标记或物体）来实现。虽然通常在初始步骤中校准相机，或者通过不断使用标记来更新相机姿态，但另一种选择是利用场景中已有的信息，例如已知物体。基于标记跟踪的另一个缺点是，标记必须在相机的视场（FoV）内被跟踪。

为了克服这些限制，我们提出了一种恒定的动态相机姿态估计方法，该方法利用已知物体在时空上的 FoV 重叠进行实时估计。为此，我们增强了最先进的物体姿态估计器，以更新我们的时空场景图，从而在甚至非 FoV 重叠的摄像头之间建立关系。为了评估我们的方法，我们引入了一个多摄像头、多物体姿态估计数据集，该数据集具有时间上的 FoV 重叠，包括静态和动态摄像头。此外，在 FoV 重叠的场景中，我们在广泛使用的 YCB-V 和 T-LESS 数据集上，相机姿态精度方面优于最先进的方法。我们在先前数据集和我们提出的数据集上的表现验证了我们的无标记方法对于 AR 应用的有效性。

代码和数据集可在 https://github.com/roth-hex-lab/IEEE-VR-2026-MultiCam 上获取。

title: Multimodal Industrial Anomaly Detection via Geometric Prior
summary: The purpose of multimodal industrial anomaly detection is to detect complex geometric shape defects such as subtle surface deformations and irregular contours that are difficult to detect in 2D-based methods. However, current multimodal industrial anomaly detection lacks the effective use of crucial geometric information like surface normal vectors and 3D shape topology, resulting in low detection accuracy. In this paper, we propose a novel Geometric Prior-based Anomaly Detection network (GPAD). Firstly, we propose a point cloud expert model to perform fine-grained geometric feature extraction, employing differential normal vector computation to enhance the geometric details of the extracted features and generate geometric prior. Secondly, we propose a two-stage fusion strategy to efficiently leverage the complementarity of multimodal data as well as the geometric prior inherent in 3D points. We further propose attention fusion and anomaly regions segmentation based on geometric prior, which enhance the model's ability to perceive geometric defects. Extensive experiments show that our multimodal industrial anomaly detection model outperforms the State-of-the-art (SOTA) methods in detection accuracy on both MVTec-3D AD and Eyecandies datasets.
tldr: This paper proposes a novel Geometric Prior-based Anomaly Detection network (GPAD) for multimodal industrial anomaly detection, leveraging geometric information like surface normals and 3D topology to improve detection accuracy on geometric defects.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的基于几何先验的异常检测网络（GPAD），用于多模态工业异常检测，利用诸如表面法线和3D拓扑等几何信息来提高几何缺陷的检测精度。
summary_zh: 多模态工业异常检测的目的是检测诸如细微表面变形和不规则轮廓等复杂的几何形状缺陷，而这些缺陷难以在基于2D的方法中检测到。然而，目前的多模态工业异常检测缺乏对诸如表面法向量和3D形状拓扑等关键几何信息的有效利用，导致检测精度较低。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的基于几何先验的异常检测网络(GPAD)。首先，我们提出了一个点云专家模型来执行细粒度的几何特征提取，采用微分法向量计算来增强提取特征的几何细节并生成几何先验。其次，我们提出了一种两阶段融合策略，以有效利用多模态数据的互补性以及3D点中固有的几何先验。我们进一步提出了基于几何先验的注意力融合和异常区域分割，从而增强了模型感知几何缺陷的能力。大量实验表明，我们的多模态工业异常检测模型在MVTec-3D AD和Eyecandies数据集上的检测精度均优于当前最优(SOTA)方法。

title: A Bayesian Learning Approach for Drone Coverage Network: A Case Study on Cardiac Arrest in Scotland
summary: Drones are becoming popular as a complementary system for \ac{ems}. Although several pilot studies and flight trials have shown the feasibility of drone-assisted \ac{aed} delivery, running a full-scale operational network remains challenging due to high capital expenditure and environmental uncertainties. In this paper, we formulate a reliability-informed Bayesian learning framework for designing drone-assisted \ac{aed} delivery networks under environmental and operational uncertainty. We propose our objective function based on the survival probability of \ac{ohca} patients to identify the ideal locations of drone stations. Moreover, we consider the coverage of existing \ac{ems} infrastructure to improve the response reliability in remote areas. We illustrate our proposed method using geographically referenced cardiac arrest data from Scotland. The result shows how environmental variability and spatial demand patterns influence optimal drone station placement across urban and rural regions. In addition, we assess the robustness of the network and evaluate its economic viability using a cost-effectiveness analysis based on expected \ac{qaly}. The findings suggest that drone-assisted \ac{aed} delivery is expected to be cost-effective and has the potential to significantly improve the emergency response coverage in rural and urban areas with longer ambulance response times.
tldr: This paper introduces a Bayesian learning framework for designing drone-assisted AED delivery networks, optimizing drone station locations based on cardiac arrest data in Scotland and considering environmental uncertainties and cost-effectiveness.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于贝叶斯学习框架的无人机辅助 AED 递送网络设计方法，该方法基于苏格兰的心脏骤停数据优化无人机站点的选址，并考虑了环境不确定性和成本效益。
summary_zh: 无人机正日益普及，成为急救医疗服务 (EMS) 的补充系统。虽然多项初步研究和飞行试验已表明无人机辅助自动体外除颤器 (AED) 运送的可行性，但由于高昂的资本支出和环境不确定性，运行全面的运营网络仍然具有挑战性。在本文中，我们构建了一个基于可靠性信息的贝叶斯学习框架，用于在环境和运营不确定性下设计无人机辅助 AED 运送网络。我们提出基于院外心脏骤停 (OHCA) 患者生存概率的目标函数，以确定无人机站点的理想位置。此外，我们考虑了现有急救医疗服务 (EMS) 基础设施的覆盖范围，以提高偏远地区的响应可靠性。我们使用来自苏格兰的地理参考心脏骤停数据来演示我们提出的方法。结果表明环境变异性和空间需求模式如何影响城市和农村地区无人机站点的优化布局。此外，我们评估了网络的稳健性，并基于预期质量调整寿命年 (QALY) 使用成本效益分析评估其经济可行性。 研究结果表明，无人机辅助 AED 运送预计具有成本效益，并有可能显著提高救护车响应时间较长的农村和城市地区的紧急响应覆盖范围。

title: SpecXMaster Technical Report
summary: Intelligent spectroscopy serves as a pivotal element in AI-driven closed-loop scientific discovery, functioning as the critical bridge between matter structure and artificial intelligence. However, conventional expert-dependent spectral interpretation encounters substantial hurdles, including susceptibility to human bias and error, dependence on limited specialized expertise, and variability across interpreters. To address these challenges, we propose SpecXMaster, an intelligent framework leveraging Agentic Reinforcement Learning (RL) for NMR molecular spectral interpretation. SpecXMaster enables automated extraction of multiplicity information from both 1H and 13C spectra directly from raw FID (free induction decay) data. This end-to-end pipeline enables fully automated interpretation of NMR spectra into chemical structures. It demonstrates superior performance across multiple public NMR interpretation benchmarks and has been refined through iterative evaluations by professional chemical spectroscopists. We believe that SpecXMaster, as a novel methodological paradigm for spectral interpretation, will have a profound impact on the organic chemistry community.
tldr: The paper introduces SpecXMaster, an agentic reinforcement learning framework for automated interpretation of NMR spectra, aiming to remove human bias and improve accuracy in chemical structure determination.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SpecXMaster，一个基于强化学习代理的框架，用于自动解读核磁共振（NMR）谱图，旨在消除人为偏差并提高化学结构确定的准确性。
summary_zh: 智能光谱学是人工智能驱动的闭环科学发现中的关键要素，它充当了物质结构和人工智能之间的重要桥梁。然而，传统的、依赖专家的光谱解析方法面临着显著的挑战，包括易受人为偏差和误差影响、依赖于有限的专业知识以及解析结果在不同分析者之间的可变性。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了SpecXMaster，一个利用代理强化学习（RL）进行核磁共振分子光谱解析的智能框架。SpecXMaster能够直接从原始FID（自由感应衰减）数据中自动提取来自1H和13C谱的多重性信息。这种端到端流程实现了核磁共振谱到化学结构的完全自动化解析。它在多个公共核磁共振解析基准测试中表现出卓越的性能，并通过专业化学光谱学家的迭代评估进行了改进。我们相信，SpecXMaster作为一种新型的光谱解析方法论范式，将对有机化学界产生深远的影响。

title: Spiking Personalized Federated Learning for Brain-Computer Interface-Enabled Immersive Communication
summary: This work proposes a novel immersive communication framework that leverages brain-computer interface (BCI) to acquire brain signals for inferring user-centric states (e.g., intention and perception-related discomfort), thereby enabling more personalized and robust immersive adaptation under strong individual variability. Specifically, we develop a personalized federated learning (PFL) model to analyze and process the collected brain signals, which not only accommodates neurodiverse brain-signal data but also prevents the leakage of sensitive brain-signal information. To address the energy bottleneck of continual on-device learning and inference on energy-limited immersive terminals (e.g., head-mounted display), we further embed spiking neural networks (SNNs) into the PFL. By exploiting sparse, event-driven spike computation, the SNN-enabled PFL reduces the computation and energy cost of training and inference while maintaining competitive personalization performance. Experiments on real brain-signal dataset demonstrate that our method achieves the best overall identification accuracy while reducing inference energy by 6.46$\times$ compared with conventional artificial neural network-based personalized baselines.
tldr: This paper proposes a personalized federated learning framework using spiking neural networks for brain-computer interfaces, aiming to improve energy efficiency and personalization in immersive communication applications. It achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with significantly lower energy consumption compared to conventional methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种使用脉冲神经网络的个性化联邦学习框架，用于脑机接口，旨在提高沉浸式通信应用中的能源效率和个性化。与传统方法相比，该框架实现了最先进的准确率，并显著降低了能耗。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种新型沉浸式通信框架，该框架利用脑机接口 (BCI) 获取脑信号，以推断以用户为中心的状态（例如，意图和感知相关的舒适度），从而能够在强烈的个体差异下实现更个性化和稳健的沉浸式自适应。 具体而言，我们开发了一种个性化联邦学习 (PFL) 模型来分析和处理收集的脑信号，该模型不仅可以适应神经多样性的脑信号数据，还可以防止敏感脑信号信息的泄露。 为了解决在能量受限的沉浸式终端（例如，头戴式显示器）上进行持续的设备端学习和推理的能源瓶颈，我们进一步将脉冲神经网络 (SNN) 嵌入到 PFL 中。 通过利用稀疏的、事件驱动的脉冲计算，基于 SNN 的 PFL 降低了训练和推理的计算和能量成本，同时保持了具有竞争力的个性化性能。 在真实脑信号数据集上的实验表明，与基于传统人工神经网络的个性化基线相比，我们的方法实现了最佳的总体识别准确率，同时降低了 6.46 倍的推理能量。

title: LiZIP: An Auto-Regressive Compression Framework for LiDAR Point Clouds
summary:
The massive volume of data generated by LiDAR sensors in autonomous vehicles creates a bottleneck for real-time processing and vehicle-to-everything (V2X) transmission. Existing lossless compression methods often force a trade-off: industry standard algorithms (e.g., LASzip) lack adaptability, while deep learning approaches suffer from prohibitive computational costs. This paper proposes LiZIP, a lightweight, near-lossless zero-drift compression framework based on neural predictive coding. By utilizing a compact Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) to predict point coordinates from local context, LiZIP efficiently encodes only the sparse residuals.
  We evaluate LiZIP on the NuScenes and Argoverse datasets, benchmarking against GZip, LASzip, and Google Draco (configured with 24-bit quantization to serve as a high-precision geometric baseline). Results demonstrate that LiZIP consistently achieves superior compression ratios across varying environments. The proposed system achieves a 7.5%-14.8% reduction in file size compared to the industry-standard LASzip and outperforms Google Draco by 8.8%-11.3% across diverse datasets. Furthermore, the system demonstrates generalization capabilities on the unseen Argoverse dataset without retraining. Against the general purpose GZip algorithm, LiZIP achieves a reduction of 38%-48%. This efficiency offers a distinct advantage for bandwidth constrained V2X applications and large scale cloud archival.
tldr: The paper introduces LiZIP, a lightweight neural predictive coding framework for LiDAR point cloud compression, achieving superior compression ratios compared to industry standards like LASzip and Google Draco, particularly benefiting bandwidth-constrained V2X and cloud archival applications.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种轻量级的神经预测编码框架LiZIP，用于LiDAR点云压缩，与LASzip和Google Draco等行业标准相比，实现了更高的压缩率，尤其有利于带宽受限的V2X和云存储应用。
summary_zh:
自动驾驶车辆中激光雷达传感器产生的海量数据，为实时处理和车对万物（V2X）传输带来了瓶颈。现有的无损压缩方法通常需要折衷：行业标准算法（如LASzip）缺乏适应性，而深度学习方法则受到过高的计算成本限制。本文提出了一种基于神经预测编码的轻量级、近无损、零漂移压缩框架LiZIP。通过利用紧凑型多层感知机（MLP）从局部上下文中预测点坐标，LiZIP有效地仅编码稀疏残差。

我们在NuScenes和Argoverse数据集上评估了LiZIP，并与GZip、LASzip和Google Draco（配置为24位量化，作为高精度几何基线）进行了基准测试。结果表明，LiZIP在各种环境中始终能实现卓越的压缩率。与行业标准LASzip相比，所提出的系统实现了7.5%-14.8%的文件大小缩减，并且在不同的数据集上优于Google Draco 8.8%-11.3%。此外，该系统展现了在未见过的Argoverse数据集上的泛化能力，无需重新训练。与通用GZip算法相比，LiZIP实现了38%-48%的缩减。这种效率为带宽受限的V2X应用和大规模云存储提供了显著的优势。

title: Task-Agnostic Exoskeleton Control Supports Elderly Joint Energetics during Hip-Intensive Tasks
summary: Age-related mobility decline is frequently accompanied by a redistribution of joint kinetics, where older adults compensate for reduced ankle function by increasing demand on the hip. Paradoxically, this compensatory shift typically coincides with age-related reductions in maximal hip power. Although robotic exoskeletons can provide immediate energetic benefits, conventional control strategies have limited previous studies in this population to specific tasks such as steady-state walking, which do not fully reflect mobility demands in the home and community. Here, we implement a task-agnostic hip exoskeleton controller that is inherently sensitive to joint power and validate its efficacy in eight older adults. Across a battery of hip-intensive activities that included level walking, ramp ascent, stair climbing, and sit-to-stand transitions, the exoskeleton matched biological power profiles with high accuracy (mean cosine similarity 0.89). Assistance significantly reduced sagittal plane biological positive work by 24.7% at the hip and by 9.3% for the lower limb, while simultaneously augmenting peak total (biological + exoskeleton) hip power and reducing peak biological hip power. These results suggest that hip exoskeletons can potentially enhance endurance through biological work reduction, and increase functional reserve through total power augmentation, serving as a promising biomechanical intervention to support older adults' mobility.
tldr: This paper presents a task-agnostic hip exoskeleton controller for older adults, demonstrating significant reductions in biological hip work and augmentations in total hip power across various activities, improving mobility.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种针对老年人的、与任务无关的髋关节外骨骼控制器，该控制器在各种活动中显著减少了生物髋关节做功并增加了总髋关节力量，从而改善了老年人的移动能力。
summary_zh: 与年龄相关的活动能力下降通常伴随着关节动力学的重新分布，老年人通过增加对髋关节的需求来补偿踝关节功能的降低。矛盾的是，这种补偿性转移通常与年龄相关的最大髋关节功率的降低同时发生。尽管机器人外骨骼可以提供即时的能量益处，但传统的控制策略限制了以往针对该人群的研究，使其局限于诸如稳态步行的特定任务，这并不能完全反映家庭和社区内的活动需求。在此，我们实现了一种任务无关的髋关节外骨骼控制器，该控制器本质上对关节功率敏感，并在八位老年人中验证了其有效性。在一系列髋关节负荷大的活动中，包括水平行走、坡道爬升、爬楼梯和坐站转换，外骨骼以高精度匹配了生物功率曲线（平均余弦相似度0.89）。辅助显著降低了矢状面生物正功，分别降低了髋关节的24.7%和下肢的9.3%，同时增加了峰值总（生物力学+外骨骼）髋关节功率，并降低了峰值生物力学髋关节功率。这些结果表明，髋关节外骨骼可能通过减少生物功来增强耐力，并通过增加总功率来增加功能储备，从而成为一种有前景的生物力学干预手段，以支持老年人的活动能力。

title: Typography-Based Monocular Distance Estimation Framework for Vehicle Safety Systems
summary: Accurate inter-vehicle distance estimation is a cornerstone of advanced driver assistance systems and autonomous driving. While LiDAR and radar provide high precision, their cost prohibits widespread adoption in mass-market vehicles. Monocular vision offers a low-cost alternative but suffers from scale ambiguity and sensitivity to environmental disturbances. This paper introduces a typography-based monocular distance estimation framework, which exploits the standardized typography of license plates as passive fiducial markers for metric distance estimation. The core geometric module uses robust plate detection and character segmentation to measure character height and computes distance via the pinhole camera model. The system incorporates interactive calibration, adaptive detection with strict and permissive modes, and multi-method character segmentation leveraging both adaptive and global thresholding. To enhance robustness, the framework further includes camera pose compensation using lane-based horizon estimation, hybrid deep-learning fusion, temporal Kalman filtering for velocity estimation, and multi-feature fusion that exploits additional typographic cues such as stroke width, character spacing, and plate border thickness. Experimental validation with a calibrated monocular camera in a controlled indoor setup achieved a coefficient of variation of 2.3% in character height across consecutive frames and a mean absolute error of 7.7%. The framework operates without GPU acceleration, demonstrating real-time feasibility. A comprehensive comparison with a plate-width based method shows that character-based ranging reduces the standard deviation of estimates by 35%, translating to smoother, more consistent distance readings in practice, where erratic estimates could trigger unnecessary braking or acceleration.
tldr: This paper presents a monocular distance estimation framework using license plate typography for vehicle safety systems, achieving good accuracy and real-time performance without GPU acceleration.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种利用车牌排版信息的单目距离估计框架，用于车辆安全系统，无需GPU加速即可实现良好的精度和实时性能。
summary_zh: 精准的车间距估计是高级驾驶辅助系统和自动驾驶的基石。尽管激光雷达和雷达提供了高精度，但其成本阻碍了在大众市场车辆中的广泛应用。单目视觉提供了一种低成本的替代方案，但受到尺度模糊和对环境干扰的敏感性的影响。本文介绍了一种基于版式设计的单目距离估计框架，该框架利用车牌的标准化版式作为被动式基准标记来进行量化距离估计。核心几何模块使用稳健的车牌检测和字符分割来测量字符高度，并通过针孔相机模型计算距离。该系统包含交互式校准、具有严格和宽松模式的自适应检测，以及利用自适应和全局阈值的多方法字符分割。为了增强鲁棒性，该框架还包括使用基于车道的地平线估计进行相机姿态补偿、混合深度学习融合、用于速度估计的时间卡尔曼滤波，以及利用额外版式线索（例如笔画宽度、字符间距和车牌边框厚度）的多特征融合。在可控室内环境中，使用校准的单目相机进行的实验验证表明，连续帧中字符高度的变异系数为2.3%，平均绝对误差为7.7%。该框架无需GPU加速即可运行，展示了实时可行性。与基于车牌宽度的方法进行的全面比较表明，基于字符 Ranging 将估计的标准差降低了 35%，从而在实践中转化为更平滑、更一致的距离读数，其中不稳定的估计可能会触发不必要的制动或加速。

title: Estimating Flow Velocity and Vehicle Angle-of-Attack from Non-invasive Piezoelectric Structural Measurements Using Deep Learning
summary:
Accurate estimation of aerodynamic state variables such as freestream velocity and angle of attack (AoA) is important for aerodynamic load prediction, flight control, and model validation. This work presents a non-intrusive method for estimating vehicle velocity and AoA from structural vibration measurements rather than direct flow instrumentation such as pitot tubes. A dense array of piezoelectric sensors mounted on the interior skin of an aeroshell capture vibrations induced by turbulent boundary layer pressure fluctuations, and a convolutional neural network (CNN) is trained to invert these structural responses to recover velocity and AoA.
  Proof-of-concept is demonstrated through controlled experiments in Sandia's hypersonic wind tunnel spanning zero and nonzero AoA configurations, Mach~5 and Mach~8 conditions, and both constant and continuously varying tunnel operations. The CNN is trained and evaluated using data from 16 wind tunnel runs, with a temporally centered held-out interval within each run used to form training, validation, and test datasets and assess intra-run temporal generalization. Raw CNN predictions exhibit increased variance during continuously varying conditions; a short-window moving-median post-processing step suppresses this variance and improves robustness. After post-processing, the method achieves a mean velocity error relative to the low-pass filtered reference velocity below 2.27~m/s (0.21\%) and a mean AoA error of $0.44^{\circ} (8.25\%)$ on held-out test data from the same experimental campaign, demonstrating feasibility of vibration-based velocity and AoA estimation in a controlled laboratory environment.
tldr: This paper presents a deep learning-based method to estimate vehicle velocity and angle-of-attack from structural vibration measurements obtained by piezoelectric sensors, demonstrating promising results in hypersonic wind tunnel experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于深度学习的方法，通过压电传感器获得的结构振动测量来估计飞行器的速度和迎角，并在高超声速风洞实验中展示了有希望的结果。
summary_zh:
准确估计气动状态变量（如自由流速度和迎角）对于气动载荷预测、飞行控制和模型验证至关重要。本研究提出了一种非侵入式方法，该方法利用结构振动测量，而非皮托管等直接流量测量仪器，来估计飞行器速度和迎角。安装在气动外壳内壁上的密集压电传感器阵列捕获由湍流边界层压力波动引起的振动，并训练卷积神经网络（CNN）以将这些结构响应反演，从而恢复速度和迎角。

通过在桑迪亚高超声速风洞中进行的受控实验验证了概念验证，实验涵盖零及非零迎角配置、Mach~5和Mach~8工况，以及恒定和连续变化的风洞运行。使用来自16次风洞实验的数据对CNN进行训练和评估，每次实验中时间居中的保留间隔用于形成训练、验证和测试数据集，并评估运行内的时间泛化能力。原始CNN预测在连续变化条件下表现出更高的方差；短窗口移动中值后处理步骤抑制了这种方差并提高了鲁棒性。经过后处理，该方法相对于低通滤波参考速度的平均速度误差低于2.27~m/s（0.21%），迎角的平均误差为$0.44^{\circ} (8.25\%)$，均在来自相同实验活动的保留测试数据上获得，证明了在受控实验室环境中使用基于振动的速度和迎角估计的可行性。

title: MsFormer: Enabling Robust Predictive Maintenance Services for Industrial Devices
summary: Providing reliable predictive maintenance is a critical industrial AI service essential for ensuring the high availability of manufacturing devices. Existing deep-learning methods present competitive results on such tasks but lack a general service-oriented framework to capture complex dependencies in industrial IoT sensor data. While Transformer-based models show strong sequence modeling capabilities, their direct deployment as robust AI services faces significant bottlenecks. Specifically, streaming sensor data collected in real-world service environments often exhibits multi-scale temporal correlations driven by machine working principles. Besides, the datasets available for training time-to-failure predictive services are typically limited in size. These issues pose significant challenges for directly applying existing models as robust predictive services. To address these challenges, we propose MsFormer, a lightweight Multi-scale Transformer designed as a unified AI service model for reliable industrial predictive maintenance. MsFormer incorporates a Multi-scale Sampling (MS) module and a tailored position encoding mechanism to capture sequential correlations across multi-streaming service data. Additionally, to accommodate data-scarce service environments, MsFormer adopts a lightweight attention mechanism with straightforward pooling operations instead of self-attention. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves significant performance improvements over state-of-the-art methods. Furthermore, MsFormer outperforms across industrial devices and operating conditions, demonstrating strong generalizability while maintaining a highly reliable Quality of Service (QoS).
tldr: The paper introduces MsFormer, a lightweight multi-scale Transformer designed for robust predictive maintenance in industrial settings, addressing challenges related to multi-scale temporal correlations and data scarcity.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了MsFormer，一种轻量级多尺度Transformer，专为工业环境中的稳健预测性维护而设计，旨在解决与多尺度时间相关性和数据稀缺相关的挑战。
summary_zh: 提供可靠的预测性维护是一项关键的工业人工智能服务，对于确保制造设备的高可用性至关重要。现有的深度学习方法在此类任务上表现出具有竞争力的结果，但缺乏一个通用的面向服务的框架来捕获工业物联网传感器数据中的复杂依赖关系。虽然基于Transformer的模型显示出强大的序列建模能力，但它们作为稳健的人工智能服务直接部署面临着显著的瓶颈。具体而言，在实际服务环境中收集的流式传感器数据通常表现出由机器工作原理驱动的多尺度时间相关性。此外，可用于训练故障时间预测服务的数据集通常规模有限。这些问题对直接应用现有模型作为稳健的预测服务构成了重大挑战。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种轻量级的多尺度Transformer，称为MsFormer，旨在作为用于可靠工业预测性维护的统一人工智能服务模型。MsFormer结合了一个多尺度采样（MS）模块和一个定制的位置编码机制，以捕获跨多流服务数据的序列相关性。此外，为了适应数据稀缺的服务环境，MsFormer采用了一种轻量级的注意力机制，使用简单的池化操作而不是自注意力。在真实数据集上进行的大量实验表明，所提出的框架在性能上显著优于最先进的方法。此外，MsFormer在工业设备和运行条件下均表现出色，证明了强大的泛化能力，同时保持了高度可靠的服务质量（QoS）。

title: Double Coupling Architecture and Training Method for Optimization Problems of Differential Algebraic Equations with Parameters
summary: Simulation and modeling are essential in product development, integrated into the design and manufacturing process to enhance efficiency and quality. They are typically represented as complex nonlinear differential algebraic equations. The growing diversity of product requirements demands multi-task optimization, a key challenge in simulation modeling research. A dual physics-informed neural network architecture has been proposed to decouple constraints and objective functions in parametric differential algebraic equation optimization problems. Theoretical analysis shows that introducing a relaxation variable with a global error bound ensures solution equivalence between the network and optimization problem. A genetic algorithm-enhanced training framework for physics-informed neural networks improves training precision and efficiency, avoiding redundant solving of differential algebraic equations. This approach enables generalization for multi-task objectives with a single, training maintaining real-time responsiveness to product requirements.
tldr: The paper proposes a double-coupling physics-informed neural network architecture with a genetic algorithm-enhanced training framework to solve multi-task optimization problems for parametric differential algebraic equations, claiming improved precision, efficiency, and generalization.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种双耦合物理信息神经网络架构和结合遗传算法的训练方法，用于解决参数微分代数方程的多任务优化问题，声称提高了精度、效率和泛化能力。
summary_zh: 仿真和建模在产品开发中至关重要，它们被集成到设计和制造流程中，以提高效率和质量。通常，它们表现为复杂的非线性微分代数方程。日益增长的产品多样性需求推动了多任务优化，这是仿真建模研究中的一个关键挑战。本文提出了一种双重物理信息神经网络架构，用于解耦参数化微分代数方程优化问题中的约束和目标函数。理论分析表明，引入具有全局误差界的松弛变量可确保网络与优化问题之间的解等价性。一种基于遗传算法增强的物理信息神经网络训练框架提高了训练精度和效率，避免了微分代数方程的冗余求解。该方法能够推广到具有单一训练的多任务目标，并保持对产品需求的实时响应。

title: mmFHE: mmWave Sensing with End-to-End Fully Homomorphic Encryption
summary: We present mmFHE, the first system that enables fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) for end-to-end mmWave radar sensing. mmFHE encrypts raw range profiles on a lightweight edge device and executes the entire mmWave signal-processing and ML inference pipeline homomorphically on an untrusted cloud that operates exclusively on ciphertexts. At the core of mmFHE is a library of seven composable, data-oblivious FHE kernels that replace standard DSP routines with fixed arithmetic circuits. These kernels can be flexibly composed into different application-specific pipelines. We demonstrate this approach on two representative tasks: vital-sign monitoring and gesture recognition. We formally prove two cryptographic guarantees for any pipeline assembled from this library: input privacy, the cloud learns nothing about the sensor data; and data obliviousness, the execution trace is identical on the cloud regardless of the data being processed. These guarantees effectively neutralize various supervised and unsupervised privacy attacks on raw data, including re-identification and data-dependent privacy leakage. Evaluation on three public radar datasets (270 vital-sign recordings, 600 gesture trials) shows that encryption introduces negligible error: HR/RR MAE <10^-3 bpm versus plaintext, and 84.5% gesture accuracy (vs. 84.7% plaintext) with end-to-end cloud GPU latency of 103s for a 10s vital-sign window and 37s for a 3s gesture window. These results show that privacy-preserving end-to-end mmWave sensing is feasible on commodity hardware today.
tldr: The paper presents mmFHE, a system for end-to-end fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) of mmWave radar data, demonstrating its feasibility for privacy-preserving vital sign monitoring and gesture recognition on commodity hardware.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了mmFHE，一个用于端到端毫米波雷达数据全同态加密（FHE）的系统，证明了其在普及硬件上用于隐私保护的生命体征监测和手势识别的可行性。
summary_zh: 我们提出了mmFHE，这是第一个实现端到端毫米波雷达感知的全同态加密(FHE)系统。mmFHE在轻量级边缘设备上加密原始距离剖面，并在不受信任的云端同态执行整个毫米波信号处理和ML推理管道，而云端仅操作密文。mmFHE的核心是一个由七个可组合、数据无关的FHE内核组成的库，这些内核用固定的算术电路替换了标准的DSP例程。这些内核可以灵活地组合成不同的应用特定管道。我们在两个代表性任务上演示了这种方法：生命体征监测和手势识别。我们正式证明了从该库组装的任何管道的两个密码学保证：输入隐私，云端无法学习到任何关于传感器数据的信息；以及数据无关性，云端上的执行轨迹与被处理的数据无关。这些保证有效地消除了对原始数据的各种监督和非监督隐私攻击，包括重新识别和数据依赖的隐私泄露。在三个公开雷达数据集（270个生命体征记录，600个手势试验）上的评估表明，加密引入的误差可忽略不计：与明文相比，HR/RR MAE <10^-3 bpm，以及84.5%的手势识别准确率（明文为84.7%），且端到端云GPU延迟分别为：10秒生命体征窗口需103秒，3秒手势窗口需37秒。这些结果表明，今天在商用硬件上实现保护隐私的端到端毫米波感知是可行的。
